snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs/5 mtha'i65595720331090505 5 601955035 55 33135 tsā
lge/ /snga athi+-i yo gter indasgar i skor gos bsgrigs/ gugarma gu ru dgasnying po don gsum ༷༵༵༵ pod rsāg go/ 35 tshe
༄7/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs sgrig pod so lnga pa bzhugs so//
༄tshi/ /byang bdag pa chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal lam gu ru ral pa can ni/ la stod byang ngam ring gi phyogs su bod rab byung dgu pa'i lcags pho khyi lo/ spyi lo 1550lor sku bltams/ rig 'dzin legs ldan rdo rje dang / mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs mtshungs med kyi yongs 'dzin lnga dang / bcu phrag bzhi sogs ris med dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las gsar rnying bka' gter snyan brgyud sogs mdor na rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyang pa mthar phyin mdzad/ gtsang rong chung khams bu lung nas tshe sgrub 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus dang garma gu sa mtsho skyes rdo rje/ gter la gdams pa'i skor/ chos bdag la gdams pa'i skor sogs gter chos dang brtsam chos kyang ha cang mang po bzhugs yod/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las mthar phyin nas rgya bod hor yul sogs su zhabs kyi bcags nas skal ldan mang po smin grol gyi lam la dkod ོ/ daXrgyud 'dzin bu sprib | rigs sras ༷ga 'aldan ngag gi dasdong po dang rig 'dzin 'phrin las rnam rgyal sogs slob ma shon tu mang po bskyangs par mdzad/ mthar rab byung bcu pa'i dge byed chu pho stag spyi lo
༄༅/ /rgyal ba nyid las lhag pa'i lung mnga' zhing / /'phrin las mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa'i/ /o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga 'gyur byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs las glegs bam so lnga pa'i nang bzhugs/ dpal chos rgyal bkra shos stobs rgyal lam mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal gyis gter byon yang gsang garma gu ru dang ma rgyud snying po don gsum sogs la pod gcig bzhugs pa la/ yang gsang garma drag po'i brgyud 'debs dang sgrub skor gter gzhung bcas/3 (1) rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang gsang garma drag po'i las byang dang dbang chog gtor bzlog dang bcas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa rnam rol/14 (7) rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i yang gsang garma drag po'i bsnyen yig 'jigs pa med pa'i zhal lung /3(35) lha ri 'jigs med dpa' bos bsgrigs pa'i garma gu ru'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs las byang dang bcas pa 'phrin las rab gsal/9 (41) rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bla ma garma gu ru'i gyer sgom 'phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar/ 7(59) gnyags rigs kun bzang 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i bla ma garma gu ru'i gtor nag gi rim pa bca' gzhi dngos gshom dang bcas pa'i lag len mtha' dag gnam
lcags sprin 'dus/14 (73) yang gsang drag po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi 'don cha bkod pa mdzad pa po mi gsal ba/7 (101) gtsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i phrin las/2 (115)garma gu ru'i zor las skor/1 (119) 'gyur med padma mchog grub kyis mdzad pa'i ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi las byang khrigs su bsdebs pa/8 (121) ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi bla ma phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs gter gzhung ma/4 (137) mgo tshwa mchog sprul lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i snying po don gsum rgyun khyer /1 (145) gnyag rigs bde chen stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi dbang chog nag 'gros su bkod pa skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun bzang /10 (147) karma gu ru'i rgyun khyer/1 (167) bka' srung gsol mchod/1 (169) sku gsum rigs 'dus dbang bshad / 2 (171) bla ma sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi tshe dbang zab mo/7 (175) dpal dur khrod bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud/6 (189) dpal nag po chen po gsang mgon yab yum gyi lo rgyus/8(201) rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa dang mchod gtor bsdus pa/6 (217) dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las rtsa ba las bzhi lhun
༄༅/ /grub/49 (229) dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub dkyil las tshogs phran tshegs dang bcas pa/6 (327) dpal dur khrod bdag po'i mchod bstod/4 (339) 'khor lo'i man ngag la sogs la/2 (347)dpal dur khrod bdag po'i yab yum gyi rjes gnang /3 (351) dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgo nas rdzas sngags la bsten nas smyon pa 'dul thabs/2 (357) dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum/4(361) yig chung 'dod yon sprin phung /5 (369) dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen bsgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam kyi rgyud mang /10 (379) par byang smon tshig1 (399—400) bcas bzhugs/ chos nga nga nga nga 4 4 4 4 4 44 4 da nga nga 4 44
༄tsho/ /yang gsang garma drag po'i brgyud 'debs dang sgrub skor gter gzhung bcas bzhugs so/ /
༄7/ /bla ma garma gu ru'i brgyud 'debasabazhugs so/ /phul byung bde chen klong du g.yo med las/ /nag phyogs bdud sde 'joms phyir khros pa'i gar/ /ston mdzad bcom ldan garma he ru gar/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sel/ /log par 'khu ba'i 'byung po'i rgyal mtshan kun/ /cig char bsnyil ba'i phrin las lha'i 'khor 'o'i/ /drag sngags grub pa'i mthu ldan sra ha ster/ /gsol ba 'debs so:dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /bgrang yas sprul pa'i gar gyi rnam rol pa/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin padma kā ra la/ /gsol ba2 ljongs 'dir theg mchog bka' yi bsdu ba spor / /bde ba'i dpal ster ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /mi yi srid pa'i zol rten mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol bza 'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs rje'i rnam rol las/ /bod yul rgyal po'i tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan/ /rgyas
༄༅/ /mdzad tshangs pa lha yi me tog lacaX gsol bza gang gi skye sprul zlos gar grangs med las/ /ma rung log 'dren kun 'dul zab mo'i gter/ /lung bstan dus bzhin sgo 'byed dbang po'i sder / / gsol bca mtha' klas nges gsang rgya mcho'i tshogs spyi dang / /khyad par tshul 'di'i bka' babs dpral pa'i ngo / /sme ba'i rtags kyi ngo mtshar rig 'dzin cher/ gsol bca mi bzad 'bar ba drag po'i gzhal med du/ /zab mo'i chos kyi bka' babs rigs sngags sam/ /mthu stobs rgya mtsho'i dpal gyur rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsol ba 'debs: mtha' yas theg pa mchog gi chos tshul kun/ /rjen par ston mdzad dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /rig 'dzin zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rje la/ /gsol ba: ris med dam pa du mas rjes bzung zhing / /bslab gsum nus ldan tshangs spyod rdo rje 'dzin/ /rig
pa 'dzin pa padma phrin las la/ /gsol bcu g.yas ru gtsang rong kham bu lung zhes par/ /mi byed bsra bas rgyas btab gsang ba'i gter/ /gnas chos bka' yi bsrung mar bcas pa la/ /gsol ba: rdzas sngags ting 'dzin bcas pa'i rten 'byung gis/ /phrin las drag po'i srogs gtad yongs thob pas/ /bsrung bzlog bsad pa'i las kun bsgrub pa la/ /nam yang thogs pa med pa'i mthu ldan 31ga /'ja' tshon ltar bkra snang stong lha yi sku/ /ma 'dres gsal bar 'char ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /tha mal zhen bzlog phung byed 'dre srin kun/ /blta bar bzod dka'i nus mthu thob par shog /mi 'jigs rdo rje'i lte bar sngags phreng gis/ /'khor lo dus kyi me snyu ltar bu'i 'od/ /brjod bral nga ro drag po'i bdud dpung tshogs/ /thal bar brlag pa'i rigs lngags 'grub par shog /snang zhing srid pa'i chos kun sems kyi klong / /rang sar grol ba'i lhun grub kun tu bzang / /gdod nas 'khrul ma myong ba'i gnas lugs kyi/ rang sems sangs rgyas rjen par mthong bar thekhog /mdor na rtsa gsum lha yi 'khor lo yis/ dus las g.yel ba med pa'i thug rjes mthus / dgra bgegs 'o1ga 'dren sde las rnam rgyal zhing / ka dag ye 97la kun bzang 'grub gyur cig /zhesami nyag byang ba gter ston chosargyal dbang po'i sdes/ rong kham bu nasabazhesapa'i zab gter bla ma garma gu ru'i brgyud 'di yang / brag sna chos
༄tshi/ /rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyisabaskul ba'i ngor/ za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'am/ /ming gzhan zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rje shing sprel zla'i tshesabacur 'ol kha tsar sbyar ba'o// dge'o/ yang gsang drag po'i sman mchod kyi lhan thabasani/ 'phrin las khrag 'thung garma he ru ka /bya chen hasti padma thod 'phreng stsal/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /sngagasasbyor/ oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /'phrin las yongs grub rtsal dang ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /garma gu ru yang gsang drag po'i skur/ /rnam rol 'dus dang srung ba go cha'i lha/ /ma hā de wa gnas chos srung ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /cesapa'ang za hor gyisaban rdesasbyar/ sarba maṅgalaX/ spru/ garma ma hā gu ru'i bsgrub skor bzhugs so: rtsa ba'i bsgrub pa'o: snyigs dusanyon mongs dug lnga hrags: phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po langs: de phyir bar chad rkyen rnams mang : bar gcod rkyen las skyob pa'i phyir: bdud 'dul padma nga nyid bsgrub: (༷ las garma drag 21'i skugiX ljang nag du ba'i malngardzog lta bugiX phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyaraltoX phyag g.yon seng ldeng phur bu bsgrilaX mthing nag ber dang chos gos mnabaltoX sna tshogs rdo rje phreng ba dang ltoX bdud kyi mgo phreng do shal 'phyang ltoX 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i
steng caX padma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdudacaX dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng caX stangs stabs khros pa'i tshul du bzhugasacaX thugs gar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbusacaX hūṃX yig mtha' ru sngags kyis bskoracaXgnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang 3glom dbusaX gsal bar bcwasnom la drag sngags bzla'oX rtsoXrsha āXhūm̐X ༷༷ garma ma hā gu 〈co garma sirnyi hūm̐X rtsa ba'i snying po 'bum phrag gsum: bzlas pas bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel: de nasaskabs su 'di nyid bzla: rtsoXrsha āXhūm̐X ༷༷ garma ma hā gu ru garma siddhi hūm̐X gnod byed bdud bzhi'i snying la ram ram thul thul trig rbad trig rbadacaX ha la pa tiXtrig nan rbadacaX 'di ni gzir ba drag po'i sngags: drag po'i ltas dang bar gcod kyis: tsha bar nyen na bzlas pa las: gzhan du rang gi 'khor la gzan: rtsa ba'i sngags dang las kyi sngags: gsum du bzlasalhang seng ldeng gi: phur ba sor brgyad sngags la 'chang : de yi bar chad bgegs kun thub: phur ba lhar bskyed bdud bzhi'i gzugs: bag zan dug dang khrag gisasbrus: bkug bstim mdun du bzhag nas kyang : bu nyid lhar bskyed bsgom lung phogaX rdzas kun lag tu gtad par bya: rang dang 'dra ba'i bu la sbyin: mang du mi spel sam yā: mthun ni dgra bzhi lang ba dang : khyad par rang rgyud nyon mongs bdud: nang du 'khrug pas phyi rol bdud: rlung ltar langasatshe sgrub par gyis: sa1ma gcag21lhan749nga: sam yā: rgya rgya rgya: sbrul lor tshangs thob rgyal du shog ser la bris: bkra lhas/ dge'o// //
༄༅/ /yang gsang garma drag po'i las byang dang dbang chog gtor bzlog dang bcas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i bshan pa rnam rol bzhugs rbersha//
༄༅/ /gu ru padma sirnyi hūm̐X phyisarig 'dzin grub pa padma 'byung / /gtum drag srinapo'i gzugs kyisabadud sde'i dpung / /'joms mdzad yang gsang garma gu ru la/ /brgyud nas phrin las rgyun khyer rim pa bri/ /sngon 'gro la/ skyabasa'agro ni/ snyigs dus pho(na 31ngas dug lnga hrag /phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po langs/ /de phyir bar gcod rkyen rnams mang / /bar gcod rkyen las skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdud 'dul padmar rab khros pa/ /yang gsang drag por skyabs su mchi lan gsum/ sems skyed ni/ mtha' yas dgra bzhi langs pa dang / /khyad par rang rgyud nyon mongs bdud/ /nang du 'khrugs pas tpū rol bdud/ /rlung ltar langs tshe bsgrub par bgyi/ /sogs dkyusltar bya/ rang nyid yang gsang drag por gsal ba yi/ /thugs las khro mtshon me dpung rab tu 'phros/ /gnod byed bdud dpung ma lus rdul du rlog /lhag ma rnams kyang pha mthar gtor zhing bskrad/ /rdo
༄tshi/ /rje gur khang me dpung cher 'bar nang / /me 'bor rtsibs bcu rtsibs mchan ral gri dang / /rlung 'bor rtsibs bcu rtsibs bar chu gri dang / /shugs drag g.yas g.yon 'bor ba'i gur du gyur/rtsa sngagasasham bu can gyi mjug tu/ 6༷wa badzra 11 ta tsakra dzwa la ram rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐X hūm̐X phaṭa'oX tshogs zhing ni/ yang gsang drag po'i lha tshogs gshegs/ nyi zla padma'i sogs/ thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug nas len/ byin 'bebasani/hūm̐X a la la hocaX bha ga nywan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya twoX sa ma ya st+waṃX hūm̐XcaX rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas khang / /yang gsang padma drag po rtsal/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor rten dang sgrub rdzas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob/ /dbang chen bskur la byin gyis rlobs/ /gzi mdangs bkrag phyungs bdud rtsi spel/ /bdud
dang log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i dngos grub stsol/ rtsa sngagasamajug tu/ sa ma ya a we sha ya a ā/ mchod pa byin gyisarlabasapa ni/ thugs ga'i hūṃX las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis nyes skyon bsreg gtor bkrus/ /oX āXhūṃX gis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/ /gzeg ma 'dod yon lha mo dpag med spros/ oX āXhūṃX badzra dhu pe hūṃX/ badzra puspro hūṃX/ badzra ā lo ke/ badzra gharnye/ badzra ne wi du/ badzra shapta hūṃXltoX badzra sarba pā dza me gha hūṃX/ oX āXhūṃX sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃX hrī ṭhā/ oX āXhūṃX ma hā ba ling ta te dzwa ba ling ta ba la bha te gu hya sa ma ye swā hā/ oX āXhūṃX ma ha rakta sa manta maṇḍa la hūṃX phaṭa/ dngosagazhi ni/ hūṃX/ sna tshogs snang ba 'khrul ba'i chos/ /kun kyang sems kyai cho 'phrul ste/ /ngo bo gdod nas ka dag dbyings/ /chos sku thig le bde chen klong / /ye stong nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /rnam rtog 'ja' sprin ltar shar bar/ /chen 'dzin 'khrul pas bcings pa'i 'gror/ /lhun grub snying rje'i rang gdangs shar/ /longs sku'i rtsal las thugs rje'i 'od/ ma 'gags chu nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /rang rig yi ge mthing nag hūm̐X/ /sprul sku rgyu yi sa bon shar/ /hūm̐X las byung pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /gzhom med rdo rjes rab gtams pa/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na/ /sde brgyad sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /chu skyes steng du bdud bzhi po/ /lha bu
༄tshi/ /dkar po phung bdud ser/ /nyon mongs bdud dmar 'chi bdag nag /gan rkyal kha sbub spel ma rtswa /byi chings bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rgyu yig 'bar ba'i hūm̐X chen mthing / /thabs las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang nyid garma gu ru'i sku/ /yang gsang drag po mthing nag mdog /sbom zhing thung la gsus po che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis yan lag rags/ /ches cher rab khros gtum zhing rngams/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ /dmar zlum spyan gsum sdang mig bsgrad/ /smin ma sma ra ag tshoms 'bar/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes pa'i/ /sked pa dar nag sbrul gyis bcings/ /phyag g.yas gnam lcags ral gri ni/ /rtse la me dpung rab 'bar ba/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i yu ba can/ /g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu bsgril/ /rin chen rus rgyan sbrul rigs lnga/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon bskyangs nas/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i steng / /gshin rje nag po g.yas be con/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad/ /mgrin par padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /rta mgrin dmar po g.yas padma'i/ /yu ba nas 'dzin g.yon bhanta/ /thugs gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /sngon po'i lte bar phyag rdor ni/ /mthing
nag thugs gar rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten/ /lte bar g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i steng / /rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar/ /g.yas pa gri gug mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod khrag thugs gar 'dzin gru mor sbas yab kha ṭwāṃ tshul/ /dbu skra nag po sil bur phab/ /nu ma bha ga rab tu rgyas/ /gcer bu phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rting pa bha gar gtad/ /zhabs g.yon ro yi gdan la 'gyings/ /phyogs bzhir rigs kyi kha dog can/ /rang 'dra'i mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor/ /gsang gnas zhi steng me dbal smug /g.yas pa me yi tho ba dang / /g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu 'dzin/ /khro bo bzhi yi dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar/ /rus pa dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyi bor hūm̐X mdzad sku mdog sngo/ /thugs gar rang gi phyag rgya 'ching / /ltag par khro bo rnam par rgyal/ /sku mdog sngon po rdo rje g.yas mgrin par khro bo rta mgrin dpal/ /sku mdog dmar po padma g.yas/ /dpung ba g.yas la gshin rje gshed/ /sku mdog nag po be con g.yas/ /dpung pa g.yon la bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /sku mdog ljang khu rgya gram g.yas/ /g.yas pa'i brla la dbyug sngon can/ /sku mdog sngon po dbyug pa g.yas/ /brla g.yon gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /sku mdog dkar po dbyug pa g.yas/ /lte bar khro bo mi g.yo ba/ sku mdog
༄tshi/ /sngon po ral gri g.yas/ dpyi mtshams khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ sku mdog ser po 'khor lo g.yas/ gsang gnas khro bo stobs po che/ sku mdog nag po rdo rje g.yas/ g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad/ dar gyi stod g.yog stag shams dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul gyis brgyan/ me dpung 'bar pa'i klong na bzhugs/ spyan drangasapa ni/ hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐X/ laṅka pu ri srin po'i yul/ /sogs kyi spro na dkyusabazhin la/ gu ru garma drag po rtsal/ zhesapa/ yang gsang garma drag po rtsal du bskur/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sde brgyad sna lhanags smras rje'i steng / padma'i gdan la sogs gzhung ltar/ phyag 'tshal ni/ dpal chen thugs kyi sprul pa ma hā gu 〈sna /sogs dkyusabazhin/mchod pa ni/ hūṃX dwangs bsil mchod yon rab bkra'i chu skyes tshal/ /dri zhim bdug spos snang gsal nyi zla'i 'od/ /sna tshogs sman khyab ro brgya'i lha bshos spungs/ /sgra snyan rol mo phyi yi mchod sprin spro/ /khrag gi andha dbang po'i me tog dang / /bsur chen dud pa tshil chen mar me sbar/ /sha rus zhal zas thod rnga rkang gling sogs/ /dur khrod rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /oX garma ma hā gu ru sa pā ri wa ra andha nas/shabha'i / bar brjod/ nang mchod ni/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar pa'i a mṛ ta/ /dam rdzas gtor ma dmar chen rakta'i skyems/ /sde brgyad bdud bzhi bsgral pa'i sha khrag dang / /mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po'i mchod pa
'bul gong gi sngags sham du/ ma hā panyu ma hā ba ling ta/ ma hā mo sa/ ma hā rakta/ ma hā tsitta/ ma hā go ro tsa na/ ma hā kīX ni ri ti/ ma hā su kha/ sarba pu dza kha hrī/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dpal zhesasogs dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje phag mo rigs bzhi mkha' 'dzod dang / /yakṣa me dbal khro bo bcu la sogs/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /'dzab bzla ba ni/ oX āXhūm̐X / garma ma hā gu ru garma sirnyi ya manta ka hya gri wa badzra pā ṇi ḍa kī badzra yakṣa hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐XltoX hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐XltoX hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐XltoX hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐XltoX aXyaXmagiXdugiXruXtsatshaX naXnaXsaXmaXya4༷༷hūm̐Xphaṭa4༷༷ cesabazla zhing / mtshan ltas rtsub pa'i dussu drag sngagasasham can sbyar te bzla/ mjug chog la/ tshogs mchod ni/ byin rlabasanasazhal stob bar rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i ljagasasgrigs garma gu ru'i tshogs mchod ji ltar lhag ma bka' brgyad rig 'dzin zham lung bzhin/ hūm̐X/ ma nyes dpang du daskardzon ma21ga bzhugs/dgra bgegs ma gtong sku gzir cig /khrag 'thung drag po'i dmag dpung bskyed/ /dgra bgegs steng du gtor zor rgyob/ /mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad mā ra ya rbesnad/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang / las kyi sngags mang du bzla zhing gnod phyogs su bzhags/ chad hpho ni/ hrīX bskal pa dang por dur khrod gnas brgyad du/ /khrag 'thung yang gsang garma he ru gas/ /dregs pa dbang sdud srung ma dam btags tshe/ /sgrub pa po yi bar chad sel ba dang / /
༄tshi/ /dngos grub stsol bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di 'ordzongs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bskal ba bar ma khams lung lhang lhang du/ /slob dpon padma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis/ /zab gter sbas shing bdud rigs dam btags tshe/ /sgrub pa po yi bar chad sel ba dang / /dngos 'grub stsol bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di 'odzings bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bskal pa tha ma laṅka'i wo brang rtser/ /garma gu ru chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ /srin po ma rung dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /sgrub pa po yi bar chad sel ba dang / /dngos grub stsol bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /gtor ma 'di longs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan skyong dang / hūm̐X/ bdud 'dul garma drag po'i bro/ /dam sri'i snying la chems se chem sogs kyang rig 'dzin zhal lung ltar dang / gtang rag 'bul zhing bshags pa ni/ yig brgya brjod/ yang gsang garma drag po gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul/ /sogs garma gu ru'i ljagasasgrigs ltar gyi mchod cing bshags pa bya/ nyer bsdu ni/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang thim de nyid kyang / /gtso bo la thim lus dkyil lha tshogs rnams thugs ga'i hūm̐X la bsdus nas gtso bo yang / /nā da mthar yal ka dag klong du gyur/ /smon lam lhasabarjod ni/ dge 'di'i mthu yis sde brgyad zil gnon cing / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal
nas rang rig don gyi yang gsang drag po rtsal/ /mngon sum rang zhal tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun/ /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bdud 'dul yang gsang garma drag stu1 yis/ /spungags dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis gogag /dbang niX brub khung dngosadang / yang na rdul tshon gyisa'abrub khang mthing nag kha khyer mu ran dang bcas pa brisapa'i khar pad sdong lta bu'i snod nang du zan gyi chosa'abyung la bdud bzhi'i gzugs / lcags phur dar gyi cod pan btags la mkhri'o steng du gtor nag me ri sogs rgyan sprosagang rgyas caka liṃ dar nag gi gdugs phub pa bkod/ mdun du bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ g.yon du ka pa lar chang dang dam rdzas sbyor ba/ rgyab du gzung ma'i rten caka li'am dril bu g.yas su ral gri dang / g.yon du lcags phur/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod sman raka gtor gsum/ chosasrung gi gtor ma rnams bshamasaso/ /de lasastegs dma' bar zor gtor zur gsum nag po rgyan med/ rtser dbang phyug dang sked par bha gas brgyan pa/ las bum/ tshogs mchod/ rdor dril/rol mo sogs yo byad rnamasamangon par 'du bgyis/ bgegs gtor btang / phrin las gzhung bsrangs te gtor ma sgrub/ bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed la mchod bstod dang bzlas pa/ /las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bsgom bzlas/ 27ra ga|(ra dbang phyug nag lngardzo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa shin tu 9rdzos lkaṃng gtum pa/ ral pa dmar ser rgyab tu nyil zhing g.yas pho mtshan dang galngardzon lngardzo mtshan 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum gaskurdzon brkyangs gi me dpung dbus na bzhugs pa/ gsal btab/ dmigs
༄tshi/ /pa'i 'phro 'du dang bcas/ ad tra sad dra sogs bzla zhing nusaldan du bya/ slob ma khrusanang phyung / maṇḍal phul spyi dang bye brag gi chosabashad/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃX/ rje btsun bla ma dbo(ngas su garbershal/ /yang gsang garma drag 21 yi/ /dbang bskur dam pa bla na med/ /skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyisagasol ba gdab/ las byang ltar skyabasasems byed/ ho lhag pa'i lha dang mjal bas na/ /gegs byed ma rig mtshon pa'i phyir/ /re zhig chu bur mig g.yogs pa'i/ /dar dmar 'di ni 'ching bar bgyi/ oX tsakṣu bhanta wa ra mā na ya hūṃX/ gisamig dar phung / hūṃX/ rin chen sna tshogs srad bu la/ /brgyus pa'i me tog phreng ba 'di/ /lhag pa'i lha la 'bul ba'i ched/ /skal ldan 'di la sbyin par bya/ oX ratna puspro ma le traṃ/ zhesame tog gi cod pan gag/ ho yang gsang dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug na/ /dam tshig spyi dang bye brag dang / /khyad par bdud dpung 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /brtul zhugs drag po spyod nus sam/ zhesadri pa'i lan du/ kyai/ slob dpon ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /ji bzhin khas len dam bcas las/ /srog la bab kyang mi 'da' ba'i/ /yi dam brtan po bdag sgrub po/ /zhesabarjod/hūm̐X / khyod kyi tshul bzhin bsgrub nus na/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las nges rgyal zhing / /dam tshig gnyan las 'gal gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /sa ma ya i dan na ra gan/ zhesadam chu blud/
byin dbab pa ni/ ho/ rig 'dzin kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon/ /khyod kyi 'bangs su bdag mchi na/ /yang gsang drag po'i sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las byin dbab gsol/ /lan gsum kyisagasol ba gdab/bgegs bsangs/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ lte ba'i rdo rje phag mo'i thugs gar hrīXl gdan gyi g.yung drung gi yan lag bzhir ha ri ni sa/ slob ma'i rkang mthil rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can/ sum mdor me gru gsum lte bar chu zlum po rnam gsal btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rkang zhabs kyi rlung g.yos bas sum mdo'i me 'bar lte ba'i chu khol nas zegs ma 'thor ba'i rkyen gyis phag mo'i zhabs 'og gi g.yung drung drag tu 'khor bas de las g.yung drung rang 'dra ser po zhig chad pa slob ma'i snying kha dang / de las chad pa'i dmar po mgrin pa/ de las dkar po spyi bor chad de 'khod pa la sems bzung / de'i tshe bla ma mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros lho nub srin yul zangs ri nas ye shes kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa char gzhin babs pa'i dmigs pas sprod pa dang lhan du sbos sbyor rol mo dang bcas/ rtsa sngagasakyi shams/ sa ma ya a we sha ya a ā/ zhesabyin 'bebasamathar/ phaṭaXkyi sgra dang bcas te byin rlabasadabab bya 'bebasabyed thams cad sprosabral ka dag gi ngang du ngo sprod de cung zad mnyam par 'jog brtan byed du rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣṭha badzra zhesabarjod/ rdershaltoX 21ga med
༄tshi/ /dus nas bzang po yi/ las dang 'brel ba'i yi dam lhagiX gang yin de yi dbu gtsug tu/ rin chen me tog dbab par the/ga /oX puṣṭi badzra hoX zhesame tog lha la mmul ba'i stangs ka dang bcas bla mar phul/ e ma de ring dus bzang por/ /las dang 'brel ba'i lha dang mjal/ /bla med byang chub ma thob par/ /'bral ba med par rjes bzung zhig /cesame tog phreng bas dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rjesamig 'byed pa'i stangs ka dang bcas/ hoX dar dmar po yi mig 'ching 'di/ /bsal dang lhan gcig thog med nas/ /bsags dang ma rig sgrib g.yog kun/ /phye bas rdo rje'i mig bla na med/ he badzra maṇḍal pa shya/ zhesamig dar bsal/ kye ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /mthong ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib kun/ /dag par 'gyur bas nyer ltos shog /cesapa ltar bskul te lha ngo bstan/ dbang dngosagazhi'i don du maṇḍal phul/ hoX bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma yis dbang skur byin rlabs rmad po che/ /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub kun/ /de ring bdag la stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum gyisagasol ba gdab/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐X che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/ /bum pa zlum lngardzo 21sa kyi dbyings/ /ye ro|sa lnga dang ldan pa'i dbang / /skal ldan bu la bskur bar bya/ /rtsa sngagasamajug tu/ 6༷/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dzhai ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī aXhūm̐X / hūm̐X tsheX/ swā ī pa/ zhesaspyi bo/ dpral ba rna ltag g.yas/ rna
ltag g.yon rnams su bzhag te 'thung du bzhug /de ltar bum chusadabang skur bas lusathams cad gang nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs/ phung po lnga gnas 'gyur ye shesalnga mngon du byas te rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan par bsam/ gsang dbang ni/ bla ma yang gsang garma gu sa rig ma ye shesamatsho rgyal gnyisasnyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar thod par bskyil ba mgo bor bzhag la/ hūṃXltoX mtshan bzang dam rdzas ka pa lar/ /bla na med pa'i bdud rtsi mchog /byang sems dkar dmar dbang bskur bas/ /rtsa khams bde bas khyab gyur cig /cesabarjod cing bdud rtsi blud pasabade stong gi ye shesagasang dbang du ngo sprod/ sher dbang ni/ slob ma yang gsang drag por gsal ba la/ gzung ma ye shesamatsho rgyal lag tu gtad de/ hūm̐X/ yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gzung ma dang / /mnyam par sbyor ba bde ba che/ /bde chen ye shes dga' ba bzhi'i/ /bcu drug cha shas gang bar rtsodag /cesabarjod de/ snyoms par 'jug pas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi bde stong shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du ngo sprod do tshig dbang ni/ lha'i sku me long ngosasu 'char bcug la/ hūm̐X/ me 'ordzong nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ /sgyu ma lta bur snang bas na/ /blo 'das ka nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /gdod ma'i rang zhal blta bar byos/ /zhesabarda' sprad/gtor ma'i byin rlabasani/ hūṃX/ dam rdzas rmad byung gtor ma 'dis/ /lha mchog garma drag po rtsal/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi/ /dbang skur ma lus thob gyur cig /kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oX / zhesaspyi bor gnyug /rim pa
༄tshi/ /bzhin du/ wā ga a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:༷༷ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃX/ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃX swā/ garma a bhe ṣiñtsa hā/ zhesaganas lhag ma bzhir bzhag ste dbang bskur/ g.yas su ral gri gtad de/ hūṃX/ nyon 〈snangs dug lnga'i cho 'phrul mthus/ /phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po'i dpung / /phyir 'thag gnam lcags ral gri 'di/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bar gyis/ /oX badzra khaṅga dzwa la hūṃX/ g.yon du lcags phur gag de/ hūṃX/ log 'dren gnod byed dam sri rnams/ /sgrol byed gnam lcags phur bu 'di/ /bdud las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags su/ /skal ldan khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oX badzra kī laṃ kī la ya mā ra ya hūṃX phaṭa4༷༷ bla ma dang gtso bo'i thugs ga'i phyag na rdo rje'i thugs gar nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las mar me gcig las gnyis chad du byung ste slob ma'i zhal nas zhugs thugs gar 'khongad pa'i dmigs pa sprad/ dpon slob gnyisakas phreng ba la 'jusate sngags kyi rjesazlosbdun nam lnga gsum gang rung byas/ phreng ba mgrin par bzhag nas/ dzaXhūṃ rbaX rdershaX zhesabyin rlabs/ bsgral dbang ni/ bdud bzhi'i liṅga slob ma'i mdun du bsham/ spro na slob ma chas su zhugs/ tshogs tha ma'i bsgral las ltar slob busabasgral te ling ro cung zad zar 'jug pa sogs phyag len bzhin byed/ zer dbang ni/slob ma yang gsang garma gu rur gsal ba gnas 'gyur te dbang phyug nag po'i rnam pa can g.yas pas pho mtshan gyi chu sbub nas bskal pa'i me 'bar zhing / g.yon pa'i mo mtshan las chu klung
drag tu 'khyugs pa/ sku las bskal me'i tshadad zer tsha tsha 'a17 ba gsal gdabs/ zor sngags kyi rjesazlosalan gsum byed/ de nasagator ma dbang phyug tu gsal ba lag tu gtad de/ hūṃ/ drag 21 dbang phyug 9rdzos pa'i gnam lcags 17ra/ /phyi nang ban bon drang srong sde brgyad byad/ /rbad 'dre rbod gtong dgra bgegs dmag dpung rnams/ /tshar gcod drag po zor gyi dbang bskur ro/ /sngagasabarjod cing zor gyi tshul du 'phen du 'jug /slar yang gtso bor gnas bsgyur ba la yang gsang drag po'i gtor ma spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūṃ/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka /phrin las rig 'dzin pra bha ha sta'i zhabs/ /slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng gis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur byin chen phob shes rab yum chen jo mo mkhar chen bza'/ /mnga' bdag chen po tshangs pa lha'i me tog /gter ston mkha' 'gro phrin las yongs grub rtsal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /chos kyi bdag po thugs rje dbang grub rtsal/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyir 'bor lha yi tshogs chos kyi dbyings nas bdag la brtser dgongs te/ /snang stong sku yi byin rlabs lus la phob/ /grags stong gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la phob/ /rig stong thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la phob/ /bde stong ye
༄tshi/ /shes byin rlabs char du phob/ /dam rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi'i ro nus phob/ /gnas khang dkyil 'khor 'di la bkrag mdangs phyung / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa'i/ /re ba'i 'bras bu da lta nyid du ༄6ro/ /rtsa sngagasamajug tu/ a be sha ya/ btags nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin phab rjesaphyi nang gi bar chad las rgyal ba'i bka' bsgo zhing / lha tshogs mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas thim par bsam te/ dzaXhūṃ rbaX hoX zhesabyin rlabasagatang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ lhag ma/ chad tho/ /bstan skyong / bro brdung / nongs pa bzod par gsol zhing nyer bsdu smon lam lhasabarjod rnams lasabyang ltar bya'o/ dza/ gtor nag gi lasasbyor bya ba ni/ dud 'a39) g.yang gzhi'am gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du 'bru sna lnga'i ngar phye la dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i zan gyi chos 'byung gru gsum gyi steng du bdud bzhi phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i nang du phur pa'i rgya can las byung ba'i dgra 'dre dmag bzlog sogs spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi liṅga 'khor lo can phyag len ltar bris pa 'jug /khyad par dam sri sogs bgegs kyi rigs la 'byung bzhi'i nang gi me'i 'khor lo'i ling 'khor btum/ bdud bsnol steng lcags phur yang 'jug /de'i khar mazhi'i steng gtor nag gi rmad char bsad mnan gyi 'khor lo ji lta ba la lte bar ling ga'i tshab tu bzlog pa'i spel tshig bris pa brdzongs/ srung 'khor gyi lte bar srung ba'i spel tshig rtsibs la
bsnyen sngags mu 'khyud la dbyangs gsal dang rten 'brel snying po/ /mthar rdo ra me ris bskor ba ltebs chings can gtor gdugs kyi nang du 'dogs/ mtha' bskor du sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod dbang phyug gi zor gtor rtse mo'i dbang rten gyi nang du zer sngags man ngag ltar bsgril ba bcug /gtor ma'i khong seng du sngags kyis bsgrub pa'i yungs dkar nag gi thun 'jug /gter srung gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor/ gser skyems/ sgrol gri ṇḍa phod/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'du bgyis/ de nasaphrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs pa'i spyan 'dren gyi sngon du zer bskyed gsal 'debasapa ni/gsang ba mu stegs drag po'i gtor nag zor/ /yongs gyur padma nyi ma dgra bgegs steng / /skad cig rdzus skyes lha chen dbang phyug che/ /sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum dmar zlum 'khyil/ /smin ma sma ra glog stong lta bur 'khyug /dmar ser ral ba rgyab nyil skyid par slobs/ /nywa sul rags shing rgyan med gcer bu'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa pho mtshan mkha' la 'phyar ba yi chu sbubs nang nas bskal pa'i me rlung 'khrugs/ /sku yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ /ldan gyi tshwa tshwa khro bo grangs med 'phro/ /g.yon pa mo mtshan 'dzin pa'i mkha' nang nas/ /chu rlung drag po'i rba rlabs

rnams kyis/ /phyi nang ben bon sngags pa'i mthu byad can/ /rang gshed rang la phab nas dgra la bsgyur/ /mgrin par khro rgyal rta mgrin he ru ka /sprul pa yang sprul pho nyar bcas rnams kyis/ /rgyal btsan dam sri 'gong po'i dpung tshogs rnams/ /tshar gcod bar gcod cho 'phrul dgra la bsgyur/ /thugs gar gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nyar bcas rnams kyis/ /sa bdag klu gnyan gdon bgegs ma lus pa/ /tshar gcod byad dang rbod gtong dgra la bsgyur/ /lte bar yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /sprul pa yang : snang srid ma mo'i gdon tshogs ma lus pa/ /tshar gcod ltas ngan chags che dgra la bsgyur sku yi cha las shar ba'i khro bo bcus/ /sprul pa: /steng 'og phyogs mtshams gdon bgegs ma lus pa/ /tshar gcod bar gcod nyer 'tshe dgra la bsgyur/ /pho nya dbang phyug u ma de wa dang / /sprul pa =nad gdon bar chod rkyen ngan ma lus pa/ /gnam lcags zer gyi dgra bo'i steng du bsgyur/ /yang gsang garma drag po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshog dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /khyad par bdag sogs rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /gnod byed gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs/ /yang sgos dam sri gnod
༄༅/ /bgegs 'byung po'i dpung / /rbad 'dre rbod gtong byad ma mkhan po sogs/ /rnam par shes pa bla srog tshe gsum rnams/ /dbang med 'brub khang nag po'i nang khrid de/ /dmigs rten gzugs kyi ling ga 'khor 'o1 bcas/ /ming byang yi ger btab pa 'di nyid la/ /da lta nyid du 'gugs bstim phrin las mdzod/ 'brub khang dang liṅga bskyed la dgug gzhug bya/ bla 'gug/ lha dbye rnams rgyas par spro na tshe bdag nang khro bcu lta bu nasakha 'geng 'jug pa bde ba'i tshogs tha ma'i stob pa yan bya/ nub tha mar 'khor ling rnams hom la bsreg cing bzhesasgra drag po lan gsum byed/ bzlog bsgyur ni/ hūm̐X/ phrin las drag po yang gsang 〈sna zhing gtum/ /g.yas pa ral gri dgra bgegs maskyurdzo lus ga91ga /galngardzon pa gnam lcags phur bu snying la 'debs/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag mchod pa bzhes/ /mi mthun bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dgra bo'i srog 'phrog gshin rje gshed nag po/ /g.yas pa be con 'bar ba mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rtse la me dpung mched/ /sprul sku yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag mchod pa bzhes/ /byad ma rang gshed 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dbang chen dmar po rta skad phyogs bcu rtswa /bsgrags pa'i srid gsum zil gnon padma g.yas/ /g.yon pa dung dmar khrag gis bkang ba
bsnams / / sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i: rgyal bsen dam sri bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dregs pa kun 'dul gsang bdag mthing nag mdog /g.yas pa thabs chen rdo rje mkha' la gdengs/ /g.yon pa shes rab dril bu sku la brten/ /sprul pazo dgra bgegs bsgral pa'izo 'og phyogs gdon tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dmar mo phag zhal ngur ba'i sgras / / bdud rigs 'byung po'i snying rtsa 'dar bar mdzad/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa khrag gang 'dzin/ sprul pazo dgra bgegs bsgral: ma mo'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /yakṣa me dbal smug nag tho ba yis/ /gdon bgegs 'byung po'i spyi bo gtsug nas 'gems/ /dkar nag snying mdzes g.yon pas phur bu 'debs/ sprul pa yang za dgra bgegs sgral pa'i: sde brgyad gnod pa bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod / / spyi bo'i gtsug nas khro rgyal hūṃX mdzad nag /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs gtum po'i gzugs/ /thugs ga'i thad du rang gi phyag rgya 'ching / sprul pa: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /ltag par rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog sngo/ /g.yas pa khro bo rdo rdze rā gdengs 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas bgegs rnams gzir/ sprul paza dgra bgegs:
༄༅/ /shar phyogs dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /brla g.yas nī la daṇḍa khro bo rgyal/ /g.yas pas dbyug pa sngon po mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas bgegs rnams gzir/ sprul bza dgra bgegs: shar lho me lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /dpung g.yas bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshen rje nag /g.yas pa be con bdud dgra'i mgo la bsnun/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas bgegs la gzir/ sprul pa yangazo dgra bgegs: lho phyogs 'chi bdag gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /lte bar mi g.yo sngon po srin po'i gzugs/ /g.yas pa ral gri'i rtse la me chen 'bar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas bgegs rnams gzir/ sprul pa: dgra bgegs: lho nub srin po'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /mgrin par rta mchog dmar po he ru ka /g.yas pa 'jam mnyes padma'i yu ba 'dzin/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag rgyas bgegs rnams gzir/ sprul pazo dgra bgegs: nub phyogs klu dbang gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /brla g.yon gzhan gyis mi thub sku mdog dkar/ /phyag g.yas dbyug pa nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdig mdzub phyag rgyas: sprul pa yang zo dgra bgegs: nub byang rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /dpung g.yon khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang / /g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo
rje mkha' la gdengs/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub: sprul pa yang zo dgra bgegs: /byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /dpyi mtshams khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba ser/ /g.yas pa 'khor los dgra bgegs dum bur gcod/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub: sprul ba yang za dgra bgegs: byang shar dbang ldan gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /gsang gnas khro bo'i dbang phyug stobs chen nag /g.yas pa rdo rje gdon bgegs mgo la gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub phyag : sprul pa yang ca dgra gegs bsgral pa'i: 'og phyogs sa bdag gdon tshogs bzlog par mdzod/ /drag po zor gyi las mdzad ma hā de wa/ /g.yas g.yon phyag gis pho brgyud mo brgyud tshogs/ las la bkye nas tpū nang gshed du 'bebs/ /sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag mchod pa bzhes/ /ltas ngan bar chod bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /cesaling ro'i lhag ma rnams dang sman raka bcasastobasapa'i tshul du byed/ de nasaphur pa lcags khang ma'i gzhung che ba la chung ba nasabarnan pa ni/ hūṃX/ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur pa ni/ /bzlog bsgyur las la khyed rang mkhas/ /lci yang ri bo pang du long / /dka' yang bdud la rgyu zhags thob/ /rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la/ /yasakyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa bzlog /nye ba'i byol zor
༄tshi/ /gtong ba: ltag pa'i bdud du babs pa: dpral pa'i gshed du 'ber ba: pho sri mo sri langs pa: che sri chung sri langs pa: dam sri dbul sri gos sri: pha mes dur sri phung sri: bdud kyi than nag phyag brnyan:btsan gyi gzer thabs gtong bcu sa bdag byad du bcings pa: rgyal po'i smyo 'dre 'bog pa: gza' yi zhing ka dug rlangs: mu stegs ngan sngags thams cad: the'u rang srid la rku ba: sngags pas phur kha 'debs pa:bon gyis btse zor 'phen pa: sum pa'i gling chen sna bsgyur: mi nyag bon gyi 'bo le: lo gag zhing gang gshed bzhi: sa la zhag rtsis 'debs pa: gnam la bzla grangs 'debs pa: gza' dang skar ma ngan pa: lo gag zla gag zhag gagaza za gag bdun zur thams cad: dus tshod rtsis nas 'debs pacu gnam gyi dal kha babs pacu sa la dug nad langs pa: thog bab dal bab thams cad: byas nyes nyams grib thams cad: yul ma'i khyim mtshes dmod mo: g.yas na wo brgya'i mda' brdar: g.yon na mo brgya'i dug sbyor: mi nag skye bo'i ya ga: bran khol ngan pa'i dmod mchu bzlog /mdun nas langs shing sdod pa: rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'breng bzo mo ngan sog par sdig pa: smi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa: srod la bya pho mtsher ba: tho rengs sgo khyi ngu bcu 'ug pas ha ha rgod pa: srin bya thog khar 'tsher ba: log la wa spyang brgyal ba: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi: pha tshan nang
gi rgya 'asre: ma bu de ni byur 'askrezo dar tshan nang gi stong 'asre: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la: phas kyi phung 'dre sbad 'asre: byur gyi sna 'dren byed pa: lus la na tsha gtong ba: tshe la bar chad byed parngo lkog nas 'bu bzhin g.yeng bzo mgo la til brdung byed pa: kha nas dar bzhin 'jam pa: gting nas tsher bzhin rtsub pa: lus la sbrul ltar 'khyil: ngo la sprel ltar 'dzig pa: mi kha bra mchu thams cad: spyi ru chags che thams cad: sgos su nyams nga thams cadaza rbod gtong rbad 'dre thams cad: smi lam ngan pa thams cad: pho byol de ni g.yas su byol/ ma byol de ni g.yon du byol/ khyim mtshes gzhan gyi sa ru byol/ sdang dgra gdon bgegs de la bhyoX za bar byed pa'i 'dre la bhyo:༷༷ phung bar byed pa'i sri la bhyoX sbyor ngan btang pa'i ltag tu bhyoX cho 'phrul ngan pa dgra la bsgyuraX bzlog cing bsgyur pa'i las malnga(da cig /cesatshangasapa brgya byin lha'i gdon man tshe bdag ltar btang yang 'gal ba med/ thun gtor 'bul/ gser skyems btang / sgo dbye tshe bdag bzhin btang / gtor ma dpag tshogs lhag chad hpho dman ltosatshul du gtad/ gtor ma 'phen sar gser skyems kyi rjesasu/ hūm̐XltoX dbang phyug ma hā de wa yi/ /thabs shes mtshan ma me chu 'khrugs/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zor gtor 'di/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du 'phen/ /byad kha bzlog la phur kha bsgyur/ /bcol pa'i

༄༅/ /chos rgyal bkra shos stobs rgyal kyi/ /bka' drin las rnyed phrin las lha/ /yang gsang garma drag po yi/ /bsnyen sgrub las sbyor zab don 'grel/ /de yang yang gsang drag po'i bsnyen par chos rgyal mang ga'i mtshan can gyi gter byon garma gu ru'i bsnyen tshad sngon du song rjes sman raka gtor gsum gyis mtshon bdag bskyed la nye bar mkho ba ma gtogs/ mdun skyed kyi gshoms mi dgos/ lus gyi lha dang go cha'i lha rnams gsal 'debs pa tsam las so so'i thugs gar sngags 'khor mi 'god/ thugs ga'i phyag na rdo rje'i thugs gar nyi gdan gyi steng hūm̐X la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams mchod cing mnyes nas 'od zer rnams slar tshur thim pas dngos grub thob par bsam pa'i bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa mtshams rgyun tsam byed kyi cha bzhi la btang bas cha
༄tshi/ /gcig byed/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba zhi khro sogs skyabs yul rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu'i tshogs zhing gu ru dar nag ber chen/ drag po garma gu sa shin tu khros pa yang gsang garma drag po gsum gyi sku'i rnam par char chen po bzhin babs smin mtshams nas zhugs te lus kyi nang gang / de bzhin du gsung gi byin rlabs ā laṃ kā laṃ dang sngags kyi phreng ba'i rnam par byon nas mgrin par thim/ thugs kyi byin rlabs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par grangs med byung thugs gar snum pa sogs bdag byin rlabs/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor byas te/ mtshams cha bzhir bcad pa'i cha gnyis la 'di kho na bya/ 'od zer spro bsdu la brten nas bdag nyid sngar bas kyang gzi brjid nus pa che ba khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyi gnon pa'i skur bsam/
mtshams kyi cha bzhir rang gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ sde brgyad kyi srog yig rnams rang dbang med par bkug ste thugs ga'i sngags phreng gi srog yig la bsdu/ spyi bo'i 'jam dpal las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogs bcas bcom/ de dag gi nus mthu rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ mgrin pa'i rta 'grin pho nya 'phros/ klu gnyan sa bdag /thugs ga'i phyag rdor gyis gza' rgod gdon rigs/ yakṣa me dbal kyi rgyal bsen 'byung po rnams tshar gcod pa'i dmigs pa kha bsgyur/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga las rang 'dra'i sprul pa rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros/ lus kyi nang gang de nas phyir 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ snang srid thams cad yom yom mer mer shig shig gyur/ sngags kyis stong gsum gang ba dang bcas te bstan g.yo thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsam/ nad zhi bar 'dod na 'od zer dkar po 'phros te nad gdon bar chad thams cad ba mo la nyi ma shar pa ltar dag par bsam pa sogs phrin las bzhi'i dmigs pa byed/ 'di la bsnyen dus la ltos pa'i las sbyor dmigs pa zer/ bsnyen pa'i thog mthar tshogs dang mtshams kyi byed lugs zhib pa rnams bsnyen yig gzhan gyis khog phul pa'i dbang du byas te ma bris/ bsnyen pa thengs nas sgrub pa byed na/ gtor ma
༄tshi/ /bdud bzhi'i laṅga 'bor lo zor rdzas sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams/ thun bzhir bcad pa'i thor thun gyi tshe khro bo bcu las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa 'phros/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab pas bsrung pa'i las mdzad pa dang / khyad par me 'khor sogs kyi bsrung 'khor kyang ched du gsal btab ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sra zhing brtan pas bar mtshams med par gtam pas mthu byad dang gdon gyi gnod pa sogs gang gis kyang mi brdzi nang du gnam lcags rdo rje'i gzhal med khang gi lte bar yang gsang drag po'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X gi thig ler bla ma dang slob dpon/ khog par rang mtha' bskor du bsrung bya gzhan rnams kyi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa gsal btab/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gzhan gyi bla tshe 'gug pa sogs bsrung ba'i dmigs pa gtso bor 'don/ sngags kyang bsrung ba'i sham bu can btags nas bzla/ mthar thun gtor 'bul zhing thun mthar phrin bcol byed/ snga thun la byad dang gdon sogs gang yin pa gtso bor byas te phyir bzlog pa'i dmigs pa sngags shams can bzla zhing thun mthar gtor ma phul nas /slar zor du bskul te phyir 'phangs/ dgong thun la pho nya spros gnod byed rnams dgug bstim dang bsad sngags shams can gtso por bzla zhing thun bsgrub/ thun gzhan gsum la tshogs bsdus pa
re dgos kyang 'dir tshogs mchod rgyas pa dang / tshogs tha ma la brten nas bskul/ gser skyems dgug gzhug dgra la bla 'gugs/ lha dbye/ bsgral las/ zhal stabs kyi bar dang bzlog byang le tshan gnyis btang nas thun gtor 'bul zhing zor du 'phangs/ srod thun la dbang phyug sngags gtso bor bzla zhing zor sgrub/ thun zor yang 'phen/ sngags rgyun byed na mi gsum bzhis bskor res kyis thun drug tu byas nas bzla dgos / zor 'phen nub liṅga rnams phyung nas gdab las rgyas par byas rjes ling ro rnams dpal 'bar la bzhes sgra dang bcas bsregs pa yin no/ /sger du mnan pa dang hom sogs byed na mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len kyi las shes danas shing / dpe 'di ni nyams len snying por byed mkhan yin na ma gtogs kun la gsang zhing sba bar bya'o/ /dka' ba'i gnad kyi mdud 'grol 'di/ /lha lung dpal rdor sprul pa'i gar/ /'od gsal rang grol klong yangs kyis/ /'bad pa chen pos bskul pa'i ngor/ /o ṭi ya na'i rig 'dzin dpe/ nyer btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ za hor brnyes legs bkod pa'i/ yi ge'i 'du byed 'jam grags rbersha/ /gter mdzod rgya can garma drag po nasabris/
༄༅/ /garma gu ru'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs las byang dang bcas pa 'phrin las rab gsal bzhugs so//
༄tsho/ /na maXbakhra ma hā gu ru sirnyi ya/ dusagasum rgyal ba'i zhal tshab thod phreng dbal/ /snyigs dusaloga'adren bdud bzhi'i gshed ma rtswa /rab bzhengs lhag pa'i lha la nyer brgyud nas/ /phrin las rab gsal nyi 'od 'dir bkye'o/ /zhes pas mchodacing 'dir chos rgyal byang bdag dbang po'i sdes gcang rong kham bu lung nas spyan 'dren par mjad pa'i bla ma garma gu ru'i phrin las ngag gi dbang po'i chags khrig la kun mkhyen lnga pas gsal byed gnang ba las lhag par yodagos yang cung bsdus pa'i tshigs 'phrad cha shas gnyags ston rig sngags 'chang ba'i gsung nas legs char blangs te dkyus gcig tu nag 'gros mar bkod pa/ sbyor ba sogs dpe bris dang mthong rgyud ltar bshams/lon/ brgyud pa'i gsola'adebs ni/ bdud sde'i dpung 'alnga(mas garma he 〈co ka /phrin las /spyab pa pra chen hasti'i zhabs/ /dus garda/ma rgyal ba'i smyi gzugs lngardzod phreng rtsal/ /garbershal ba 'debs so bdud bzhi mthar byed thegag /zab gter bka' yi sdud po mkhar chen bza'/ /'jam dpal rdo rje khri 3/nga lde'u btsan/ /skye ba'i yang srid bkra shos stobs rgyal la/ /gadra la ba 'debs rbe
༄༅/ /bdud bzhi mthar: lung zin rig 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang / /bka' babs chos bdag chos dbyings rang grol rje/ /za hor kun mkhyen zil gnon bzhad rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi mthar byed: kun mkhyen rig 'dzin padma phrin las zhabs/ /grub dgon theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rig 'dzin bskal bzang padma dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi mthar byed shog /grub pa'i dbang phyug padma bshes gnyen dang / /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang mtshan/ /zla med drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud: gtsang rong khams bu lung zhes g.yas ru'i char/ /rgyas btab phrin las drag po gsang ba'i gter/ /gnas chos bka' skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdud: srung gtad dbang gis
rang rgyud yongs su smin/ /gang snang lha skur shar ba'i bskyed rim gsal/ /chos kun rig ngor 'phrod pas rang sar grol/ /'chug med tshul bzhin nyams su longs par rtsodag /nang du rang rgyud dug lnga bdud bzhi'i dpung ka dag dbyings su ye shes lngar dag nas/ /phyi rol 'khrul ngor shar ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /tshar gcod rten 'brel lhun gyis 'grub par shog /snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten par 'char/ /grags pa thams cad grags stong sngags kyi sgra/ /snang sems brjesad bral chos sku'i rang rtsal du/ /legs shar don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis thegag /cesapa 'di yang sngar rgyud 'debasazhig brtsam pa mang skyon nas phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i chosagrwa ba rnams kyisakhyer bde ba'i slad du za hor gyi ban rnyesasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs gragasapas sbyar ro/ /skyabasa'agro ni/ snyigs dus nyon mongs dug lnga hrag /phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po langs/ /de phyir bar chod rkyen rnams mang / /bar chod rkyen las skyobs pa'i phyir/ /bdud 'dul padmar skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum sems bskyed ni/ mtha' yi dgra bzhi langs pa dang / /khyad par rang rgyud nyon lngardzongs bdud/ /nang du 'khrugs pas phyi rol bdud/ /rlung ltar langs tshe bsgrub par bgyi/ /srung 'khor ni/ rang nyid garma gu rur gsal ba yi/ /thugs las khro mtshon me dpung rab tu 'phros/ /gnod byed bdud dpung ma lus rdul du rlog /lhag ma
༄tsho/ /rnams kyang pha mthar gtor zhing bskrad/ /rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung chen 'bar nang / /me 'khor rtsibs bcu rtsibs mtshan rgya gram dang / /rlung 'bor rtsibs bcu rtsibs bar chu gri dang / /shugs drag g.yas g.yon 'khor ba'i gur du gyur/ /oX āXhūṃ garma ma hā gu ru garma siddhi hūṃ/ gnod byed bdud bzhi'i snying ga raṃ raṃ thul thul trig rbad trig rbad ha la saṃ ti trig nan rbad/ oX badzra kro ta tsakra dzwa la raṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ sogs brjod / tshogs zhing ni/ yang gsang drag po'i lha tshogs rnams/ hūṃ garma drag rtsal lha lhutogs gshegs/ /nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chag sdig sgrib mtho 'o( bshags/ /gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang / /smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor bskor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /snying po sems can don du bsngo/ /yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /byin 'bebasani/ hūm̐X a la la ho:༷༷ bha ga lhan ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ya ho:༷༷ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ hūm̐X / rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas nas/ /garma ma hā gu ru rtsal/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /rnal 'byor rten dang sgrub rdzas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob/ /dbang chen bskur la byin gyis rlobs/ /gzi mdangs bkrag phyung bdud rtsir spel/ /
bdud dang log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /oX aXhūm̐X garma ma hā gu ru garma siddhi hūm̐X/ /sa ma ya ā we sha ya a ā:༷༷ mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /thugs ga'i hūm̐X las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus/ /oX āXhūm̐X gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ /zer ma 'dod yon lha mo dpag med spros/ /oX āXhūṃ/ badzra dhu pe hūṃ/ badzra puspro hūṃ/ badzra ā lo ke hūṃ/ badzra gharnye hūṃ/ badzra nai wi du hūṃ/ badzra shabha hūṃ/ badzra parba pu tsa me gha hūṃ/ oX āXhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hrī ṭha4༷༷ oX āXhūṃ ma hā ba laṃ ta te dzwa ba linta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ye swā hā/ oX āXhūṃ ma hā rakta sa manta maṇḍa la hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ lan bdun nam gsum brjod/ dngosagazhi ni/ hūm̐X rang gi rig pa hūṃ du bsam/ /hūṃ rgyu las skyes pa'i sngags brjod pas/ /drag po'i gzhal yas lhun gyis grub/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gdan du sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /chu skyes steng du nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stang stabs khros pa'i tshul du ni/ /hūṃ las garma drag po'i sku/ /ljang nag du ba'i mdog lta bu phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar/ /g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa sgril/ /mthing nag ber dang chos gos gsol/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / /bdud kyi mgo phreng do shal 'chang / /stangs stabs khros
༄tshi/ /pa drag po'i sku/ /dam tshig sems dpa' nyid du gsal/ /spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ 〉giX lang ka pu ri srin po'i yul/ /gtum drag rngams pa'i dur khrod nas/ /srin po'i rgyal po yal ge can/ /gu ru garma drag po rtsal / / log 'dren ma rung bsgral slad du/ /gnas 'dir myur ba nyid du byon/ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal badzra sa ma ya dza dza4༷༷ dzaXhūṃ baṃ ho:༷༷ spro na/ hūm̐X bzhengs shog padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs4༷༷sogs / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ cesapa'i bar brjod/ hūṃ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / /padma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stangs stabs khros pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūṃ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i ma hā gu 〈sna /drag po'i phrin las mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /ma rungs dus mtha'i dmag dpung 'joms pa'i lha/ khro rgyal phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ma hā gu ru a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ sgo lnga'i longs spyod smyi yi mchod pa dang / /dug lnga rnam dag rang byung dag pa'i rdzas/ /bde chen yongs rdzogs gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams/ /bdud 'dul padma'i sku la mchod pa 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen po skyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ garma ma hā gu ru mo sa rakta kai ni ri ti a mṛ ta ba lenta ma
hā sarba pu tsa khā hi/ zhesargyas par 'dod na/ hūṃ rab gtsang dag byed mchod yon zhabs bkru'i rdzing / /rnam bkra'i me tog dri zhim bdug spos sprin/ /mun sel sgron me byung ba'i bde ba bskyed/ /ro ldan bza' bca' snyan 'gyur rol mo'i tshogs/ /rab mdzes gzugs dang snyan 'jebs glu gar dbyangs/ /mngar ba'i dri bsrung ro brgya ldan pa'i zas/ /'jam gnyen reg bya bkra shos rtags brgyad sogs/ /srid zhi'i 'byor pa nam mkha'i khams kun 'gengs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa kun gyi rab 'phags pa'i/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas 'bul/ /oX badzra andha sogs shapta pañtsa kā garma gu ṇa sapta ma hā ratna pu tsa ho/ /rba rlabs 'phyur pa'i dmar chol dbang po yi/ /me tog tshil chen ga bur spos zhun me/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus spungs pa'i mchog /rkang gling thod rnga'i rol lo tshar du dngar/ /rngams dang brjid pa bsdom pa drag po'i rdzas/gshin rje'i mdun sa bzhin du bkang ste 'bul/ /oX ma hā shā shā na ambha/ sogs/ shapta pra titstsha swā hā/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa rdzas kyi mchog /sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ /dag mnyam rtog pa rang byung lha la 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sirnyi stsal du gsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ phrin las khrag 'thung garma he ru ka /pra chen ha sti padma thod phreng rtsal/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan
༄tshi/ /la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos 'grub stsol/ /oX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi/ /phrin las dngos 'grub rtsal dang ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /rig 'dzin zil gnon drag rtsal rdo rje la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ oX na ma: /kun gzigs bla ma padma phrin las rje/ /byams pa theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje thog med la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod: oX na maXsarbaca grub pa'i gtsug rgyan padma bshes gnyen dang / /khyab bdag padma ngag dbang kun bzang zhabs/ /bka' drin 'khor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la / bdud rtsi sman mchod: oX ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal/ /drag po'i las byed bka' sdod ma hā de wa/ /bdud btsan klu gsum dam can bsrung ma la/ bdud rtsi: oX za dngosa'agrub blang ba ni/ slar yang rig 'dzin smra ba'i 'bab stegs khar/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i ro mchog myong ba yis/ /yang gsang sku gsung thugs kyi dngos 'grub rnams/ /thogs pa med par myur du stsal du gsol/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta ka ya siddhi oX / waka siddhi āX tsitta siddhi hūṃ/ sa ma ya a la la ho/ gtor ma rakta thams cad sgrol mchod rnams rim par 'bul ba ni/ khyad par rmad byung dam rdzas 'dod yon lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig mchog gi rten/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i
gtor ma'i longs spyod rgyan/ /phrin las grub pa'i rig 'dzin lha la 'bul/ /ma hā ba linta khā hi/ bde chen ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /padma rakta chags pa chen po'i tshogs/ /ma lus gcig bsdus 'khor skyon dag pa'i rdzas/ /phrin las grub pa'i rig 'dzin lha la 'bul/ /ma hā rakta la khā hi/ hūṃ thabs kyi rdo rje bde chen waṃ kyi dpal/ /shes rab padma e yig rnam thar gsum/ /thabs shes gnyis med dga' bzhi mnyam sbyor ba/ /zag med rdzu 'phrul lam gyi mchod pa 'bul/ /oX padma yo kki ni badzra pra we sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ hūṃ yang dag pa yi ye shes rdo rje yi/ /'khor ba'i bag chags gtan nas bcom byas te/ /gnas ngan sgrib pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba mkha' gsang dbyings su bsgral mchod 'bul/ /ma traṃ ru tra prañtsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ti hūṃ e yaṃ spha ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rdze 'dus pa'i dpal ma rung 'dul mdzad garma drag po rtsal/ /'gro ba snyigs ma'i sdug bsngal skyobs pa'i lha/ /drag po'i phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhesadang / hūṃ chos nyid 'gyur med bde chen ngang nyid la/ /'gags med 'gro la rjes chags snying rje'i gar/ /mi srun bdud kyi sde dpung kun 'joms pa/ /che ba'i che mchog garma drag po rtsal/ /ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum/ /lta bar bzod dka'i gzi
༄tshi/ /byin mtshungs pa med/ /gsang phod mthing ka snam sbyar gnyen zhu gsol/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis bdud bzhi gzir la 'dud/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rjes las bzhi sgrub/ /g.yon pa phur bus log 'dren snying nas 'bigs/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba bdud bzhi yi/ /mgo phreng khrag 'dzag do shal 'dzin la bstod/ /sgeg dang dpa' dang 'jigs su rung ba'i sku/ /rgod dang gshed dang rngams dang ngar ldan gsung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba chen po'i thugs/ /khro bo'i gar gyi nyams dgu rdzogs la bstod/ /gzhom med gnam lcags rdo rje gur khang byas/ /rab brjid lhun sdug margad ri bo la/ /nyin mor byed pa'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /log 'dren sreg byed me dbus 'gying la bstod/ /sku las me mtshon khro bo'i tshwa tshwa 'phro/ /mi srun bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs ma lus/ /'joms pa'i mthu ldan gnam lcags rdo rje'i thogs/ /'bebs mdzad khro bo'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs gar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbus/ hūṃ yig mtha' ru sngags kyis bskor / /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i khang sgrom dbus/ /gsal bar bsgom la drag sngags bzla/ /oX āXhūṃ garma ma hā gu ru garma sirnyi nyu4༷༷ rtsa ba'i snying po brgya stong ci rigs mthar/ rgyun gyi lasabyang skabs la sngags kyang rtsa sngags zhabs su/ gnod byed bdud bzhi'i snying la raṃ raṃ thul thul/ trig rbad trig rbad/ ha la pa ti
trig nan rbad rbad/ bdun nam nyer cig tsam du bzla/ spro na dbang phyug las sngagasakyang gtong nasalang yod pa ltar bdun tsam bzlas/ thun mtshamasamachod bstod ni/ hūṃ lha mchog garma drag 21 gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lhamags mchod 'bul/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā panyu ma hā rakta/ ma hā bha linta la khā hi/ rjesasu bstod pa 'di skad do/ hūṃ dpal chen thugs kyi sprul pa phrin las bdag /log 'dren gdug pa kun 'dul ma hā gu sa byin rlabs mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal ldan pa/ ma rung log 'dren 'dul la phyag tshal bstod/ /bar 'dir spyi dgosasrung ma dang gter srung ma gter srung bdud btsan klu gsum gyi bskang ba sbyar/ tshogs 'bor ni/ raṃ yaṃ khegiX 'bru gsum sngags kyi byin gyisarlabs/ oX āXhūṃ/ 'dod yon sna tshogs spel/ dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam tshig can/ /chos skyongs srung ma gter bdag rnams/ /ma lus yud kyi gnas 'dir byon/ /laṅka pu ri srin po'i yul/ /zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas/ /srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /'dod yon tshogs la spran 'dren gshegs dag pa'i zhing khams so sor nas/ /sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /thugs rje dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs/ /chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams
༄tshi/ /nas/ /mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub rtsal/ /chos bdag bu mchog nyer gcig rnams/ /tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /garma ma hā gu ru de wa ḍa ki ni zhing ka ra sa ma ya dza dza4༷༷ de ltar tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ dang po mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūṃ thug rje'i phrin las gcig bsdus ma hā gu rtswa /longs spyod rdzogs sku khrag mthung khro bo'i lha/ /dpa' bo ḍā ki chos srung gter bdag dang / /rig 'dzin rgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog thun dngos grub bu mchog bdag la stsol/ /gha na tsakra putstsha khā hi/ bar ba mchod cing nyam chag bshags pa ni/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa'i dbang gyur te/ /tshor dang ma tshor ma rig mun pas bsgribs/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags kun/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /khrag mthung lha tshogs rnams kyis bzod par bzhes/ /garma ma hā gu ru sarba sa ma ya hūṃ/ tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/྅snra dri dzaXdzaX mchog gsum sku gsum byin rlabs bden pa dang / /dbang phyug 'jig rten dregs pa'i nus mthu yis/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan byas pas/ /dkon mchog spyi dgra rig 'dzin sku dgra dang skye 'gro 'tshe byed zhing bcu ru ṭa dang / /bod khams phung byed mtha' dmag gdug pa'i tshogs/ /gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po dam sri'i rigs/ /bsgral byar 'os pa'i bla srog 'dir khug cig /rtsa
sngagasasham bur phyag rgya bcas pas/ badzra e ku sha dza4༷༷dzaX badzra pā sha hūṃ/ badzra sbo ṭa baṃ/ badzra gaṇḍa ho/ pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ā be sha ya agiX hūṃ sku stod yang gsang khros pa'i gzugs/ /sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i dbal / / log 'dren dgra bgegs dam sri yi/ /snying la btab po mā ra ya/ /oX āXhūṃ garma ma ha gu ru garma siddhi hūṃ/ gnod byed bdud bzhi'i snying la raṃ raṃ thul thul/ trig rbad trig rbad/ ha la sa ti trig nan rbad cesapa'i mthar/ oX badzra kī laṃ kī la ya dam sri ru tra zhing bcu mā ra ya rbad/ ral grisagatub dusadrag sngags 'dren/ zhal stabasani/ hūṃ srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /yang gsang garma drag po stsal/ /gnam sa tsam du zhal phyes shig /gangs ri tsam gyi mche gtsigs la/ /glog dmar tsam gyi ljags brkyang cig /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa bzhes/ /oX āXhūṃ garma ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūṃ/gnyostod byed dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag 〈cos pa la khā raṃ khā hi/ bar 'dir rtsa gsum bskang ba sbyar 'di kha'i bskang ba blta sgo sngags 'chang gsung gar dusamachod pa spyan gzigs bshams pa/ dmigs pasakyang 'thus/ dbang bzlog pa sbyin sregs sogs las sbyor rnams skabs 'dir bya/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdusabyin gyisabarlabs nas lhag ma btang ba ni/ hūṃ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du/ /yang gsang drag po'i lha tshogs gnyan/ /bar du lhag mas mi mchod du/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes/ /tha
༄tsho/ /ma gcig tu mi sre rtswa /chos rnams ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig /dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams/ /'dir byon sha khrag mchod gtor bzhes/ /sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel bar/ /brtsol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ gtor zor 'phang zhing / hūṃ ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs/ /dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku bzur cig /khrag 'thung drag po'i dmag dpung skyed/ /dgra gegs steng du gtor zor rgyab/ /mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad mā ra ya rbershad/ rtsa sngagasal las kyi sngags mang du bzla zhing gnod byed phyogs su 'phang / bdun pa sngon gyi chad tho bsgrags/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la/ /'og min chos dbyings gnas mchog dam pa ru bcon ldan dpal chen he ru ka dpal gyis/ /snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs bzhin/ /mchod gtor 'di zhes bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bskal ba bar ma rgya gar gnas chen du/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad rnams kyis/ /khro bo'i rang rang dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ /bka' skyong pho brgyad mo brgyad dam btags tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangasazo mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol pa'i phrin las: bskal ba tha ma chos 'khor bsam yas su/ /padma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs grogs dgu yi/ /zhi khro dang po'i dkyil 'bor zhal phyes tshe/ /snang srid
dregs pa sde brgyad dam btags tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las: lnga brgya tha ma zangs mdog dpal ri rtswa /gter ston rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yongs grub kyis/ /phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ /dam can rgya mtsho dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i phrin las: bod skyong bstan ma phyi ltar dbye/ bod khams skyong ba khas blangs bstan ma'i tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ /kha rag khyung btsun la drasnags gnod sbyin bzhi/ /gangs kyi g.yu bun la sogs sman mo bzhi/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /sngon tshe thugs dam zhal bzhes ci bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di 'ordzong byams pas grogs mdzod cig /dgu pa dam sri steng du bro/ bdud 'dul garma drag po'i bro/ /dam sri'i snying la chems se chem/ /khro bo khro mo rol pa'i bro/ /dgra bgegs snying la chems se chem/ /khro bo rnams kyai bro brdung bas/ /khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so/ /shar du zhi ba'i bro brdung bas/ nad gdon bar chad zhi bar shog /lho ru rgyas pa'i gro: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog /nub tu dbang gi bro brdung : lha 'dre mi gsum dbang sdud shog /byang du drag po'i broca dgra bgegs dam srid zhi bar shog /sngags mjug tu/
no༅༅/ /shinti/ puṣṭiX/ pa shaṃ/ ma ra ya phaṭa4༷༷ dngosagrub blangs bar spro na/ tshe bdag gi dpal ldan rdo rje tshig 'phrad/ kha bsgyur bas chog /gtang rag gi mchod pa ni/ yang gsang garma drag po 'khosar bcas la/ /khyad par mchod pa pañtsa a mṛ ta sogs dang / hūṃ dpal chen thugs kyai sprul pas: bstod cing nong pa bshags/ bzod gsol dang / brtan la brtan bzhugs 'di ni/ srung 'khosar gzhal yas khang sam de nyid kyang / /gtso bo la sam de yang hūṃ la bsdu/ /nā da mthar yal ka dag klong du gyur/ smon lam lhasabarjod/ dge 'di'i mthu yis sde brgyad zil gnod cing / /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal nas/ /rang rig don gyi yang gsang drag po rtsal/ /mngon sum rang zhal tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cig /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'a91 chos skyong kun/ /skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bdud 'dul yang gsang garma drag po yis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis phregag /gzhan yang shisapa brjod pa'i mthar brgyan no/ /smrasapa/ rigs 'dusam hā gu ༄ drag po'i gzigs/ /log sde bdun pa pha mthar byed pa dang / /bstan 'gro'i chu skyesabazhad pa khyab gcig tu/ /ngom par bskal bzang smin grol bdud rtsir spyod/ /gaho lhag pa'i lha yi sgrub pa phrin las la/ /lhan thabs gsar sprosa'adi'ang rang nyid kyi/ /bgyid par bdun bdar bab skyong ba sde dge pa'i/ /mdun sar brda' spyod bka' rgya bskul/ /de'i rten 'brel gtso sbyor lha ri pa/ /'jigs med dpa' bosashing 'brug dbo zla ba'i/ /dkar phyogs bzang po gnyisapa'i dusadage bar/ /rgyal khab

༄tshi: :mchod bstod 'dzab bzlas dngosagazhi'i khrigs/ dang po rten dang brten pa ni/ rang gi rig pa hūṃ du bsamagiX rgyu las skyes pa'i sngags brjesad pas4༷༷ drag po'i gzhal yas lhun gyis khru/bltoX gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nang ltoX gdan du sna tshogs rdo nde dang ltoX chu skyes steng du nyon mongs bdudagiX dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng ltoX stangs stabs khros pa'i tshul du nigiX hūṃ las garma drag po'i skugiX ljang nag du ba'i mdog lta bugiXphyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyaraltoX phyag g.yon seng ldeng phur bu sgril4༷༷ mthing nag ber dang chos gos mnabaltoX sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba dang ltoX bdud kyi mgo 'phreng do shal 'phyang ltoX stangs stabs khros pa drag po'i skugiX dam tshig sems dpa' nyid du gsal4༷༷ gnyisapa ye shesaspyan drangasal/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lang ka pu ri srin po'i yul4༷༷ gtum drag rngams pa'i dur khrod nas4༷༷ srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can4༷༷ gu ru garma drag po rtsal4༷༷log 'dren ma rung bsgral slad dugiX gnas 'dir myur ba nyid du byon4༷༷ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal4༷༷ badzra sa ma ya dza dza4༷༷ dzaXhūṃ rba hoX gsum pa rten la bzhugs su gsol ba/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng ltoX padma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdudagiX dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng ltoX stangs stabs khros pa'i tshul du bzhugs4༷༷ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal4༷༷ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan4༷༷ bzhi pa gusaphyag 'tshal ba ni/ dpal chen thugs kyi
