༄༅: :bshams te/ galasathod pa'i nang du ni/ 'dod yon dpag med legs bshams la/ 'byung ba'i yi ge gsum gyisasbyangs/zhesapa ltar/ raṃ yaṃ khegiX 'bru gsum sngags kyi byin gyisarlabs/ ñtsaXrsha āXhūṃ hrīXye shesa'adod yon sna tshogs spel/ gnyisapa tshogs la spyan drangasab ni/dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs4༷༷ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam tshig can4༷༷ chos skyong bsrung ma gter bdag rnams4༷༷ ma lus yud kyi gnas 'dir byon4༷༷ lang ka pā ri srin po'i yul4༷༷ zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog nas4༷༷ srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can4༷༷ 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs4༷༷ dag pa'i zhing khams so so nas4༷༷ sprul sku'i 'a11 ba'i don mdzad pagiX rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs bcas rnams4༷༷thugs rjes dadurdzongs la gnas 'dir gshegs4༷༷ chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing mchog nas4༷༷ mkha' 'gro 'phrin las yongs grub stsalaltoX chos bdag bu mchog nyer gcig rnams4༷༷ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol4༷༷ garma ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍā gi ni sarba ging ka ra sa ma ya dza dza4༷༷ gsum pa thog mar mchod pa ni/ hūṃ thugs rje'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus ma hā gu 〈coX longs spyod rdzogs sku khrag 'thung zhi khro'i lhagiX dpa' bo ḍa gi chos bsrung gter bdag dang ltoX rig 'dzin rgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul4༷༷ mchog thun dngos grub bu mchog bdag la stsolaltoX ga ṇa tsakra pā dza khā hi: bzhi pa bar du nyams chag stags pa ni/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa'i
dbang gyur tagiX tshor dang ma tshor ma rig mun pas bsgribs4༷༷ rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag kun4༷༷ 'dod yon tshogs kyis mchod pas mthol zhing bshags4༷༷ khrag 'thung lha tshogs rnams kyis bzod par bzhes4༷༷ garma ma hā gu ru sarba sa ma ya hūṃ/ lnga pa tha ma bsgral zhing stabs/ hūṃ snra tri dza dzaX mchog gsum sku gsum byin rlabs bden pa dang ltoX dbang phyug 'jig rten dregs pa'i nus mthu yis4༷༷ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyar ldan byas pas4༷༷ dkon mchog spyi dgra rig 'dzin sku dgra dang ltoX skye 'gror 'tshe byed zhing bcu'i ru tra dang ltoX bod khams phung byed mtha' dmag gdug pa'i tshogs4༷༷ gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po dam sri'i rigs4༷༷ bsgral byar 'os pa bla srog 'dir khug cigagiX badzra e gu sha dza4༷༷ badzra pa sha nyu4༷༷ badzra slo ḍa rbaltoX badzra gharnye ho:༷༷ pra be sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ a be sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ a be sha ya agiX phung byed dgra bgegs kyi snying srog la raṃ raṃ thul thul trig rbad trig rbadagiX ha la pā ti trig nan rbadagiX phur pa btab cing mtshon chasabasgral: ma la yi ri mp+ya dang : srin yul gnas nas gu ru'i tshogs: spyan drangasazhal du gsol bar bsam: nywa dpal chen 'khosar bcas zhal phyes shigagiXzhal ni ho khung gdangs pa 'dragiX tshems ni hom shing brtsegs pa 'dragiX ljags ni hom gzar brkyang ba 'dra ltoX dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung po 'diljoX dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du bstabs4༷༷ rdul phran tsam yang
༄tshiltoX ltoXmed par rol4༷༷ oX āXhūṃ garma mahā gu ru garma sirnyi nyu4༷༷ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi:༷༷ drug pa mar gnas lhag ma bag ba ni/ nyu4༷༷ dang po phud kyi mi mchod dugiX garma gu ru'i lha tshogs gnyan4༷༷bar du lhag ma'i mi mchod dugiX ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes4༷༷ tha ma gcig du mi bsre 〈coX chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcigagiX dpal gyi bka' gnyan lhag bdud rnams4༷༷ 'dir byon sha khrag mchod gtor lhag ma bzhes4༷༷ sngon gyi dam tshig ma g.yel b.raltoX bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzodagiX oX ma ha shrī he ru sa ma ya dho bi kro ta sarba ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi:༷༷ oX āXhūṃ utstsha ta badzra a tiṣṭha sa mu kra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷hūṃ hūṃ nyu4༷༷ hrīXhrīXhrī4༷༷ bhyo bhyo bhyo:༷༷ a ra li dza4༷༷ bdun pa sngon gyi chad tho bsgrags/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la4༷༷ 'og min chos dbyings gnas mchog dam pa rtsaX bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka dpal gyis4༷༷snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tsha4༷༷ so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshigs khas blangs bzhin4༷༷ mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX bskal pa bar ma rgya gar gnas chen dugiX grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po brgyad rnams kyis4༷༷ zhi khro rang rang dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas4༷༷ bka' skyongs pho brgyad mo brgyad dam btags tshegiX so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs bzhin4༷༷ mchod gtor 'di bzhes
bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX bskal pa tha ma chos 'khor bsam yas sugiX padma 'byung gnas rdze 'bangs grogs dgu ya4༷༷ zhi dang khro dra'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas4༷༷ snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad dam btags tshegiX so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs bzhin4༷༷ mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzodagiX lnga brgya tha ma zangs mdog dpal ri 〈coX gter ston rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yongs grub kyis4༷༷'phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas4༷༷ dam can rgya mtsho dam la btags pa'i tshegiX so so'i gzugs bstan dam tshig khas blangs: mchod gtor 'di bzhes bcol ba'i: nyu ma nyes pang du dkon mchog bzhugs4༷༷ dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku zur cigagiX khrag thung drag po'i dmag dpung bskyedagiX dgra bgegs steng du gtor zor rgyobaltoX mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad mā ra ya sod/ rtsa sngagasadang lasakyi sngags mang du bzla zhing gnod byed kyi phyogs su 'phang / brgyad pa bod skyongs bstan ma brngan pa spyi ltar byed/ dgu pa dam sri'i steng du bro/ bdud 'dul garma drag po'i brogiX dam sri'i snying la chems se chemagiX khro bo rnams kyi bro brdung pas4༷༷ khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs sogiX shar du zhi ba'i bro brdung pas4༷༷ nad gdon bar chad zhi bar shogagiX lho ru rgyas pa'i bro brdung pas4༷༷ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shogagiX nub tu dbang gi bro brdung pas4༷༷ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang
༄༅ltoX ltoXbasdus phregagagiX byang du drag po'i bro brdung pas4༷༷ dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar thekhogagiX sngagasamajug tu/ shinti:༷༷ puṣṭiltoX pa shegiX mā ra ya phaṭa4༷༷ dgu pa bshags shing gag rag gag yig brgya'i mjug tu/ lha mchog garma drag po gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod 'bul/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol 'ordzo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a :: ma hā rakta: ma hā ba linta khā tigiX hūṃ dpal chen thugs kyi sprul pa phrin las bdagagiX log 'dren gdug pa kun 'dul ma hā gu 〈coX bdud sde 'dul mdzad garma drag po'i skugiX byin rlabs mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal ldan pagiXma rung 'o(ga 'dren 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstodagiX mwa pa dkyil 'bor nyer bsdu ba/ gnam lcags khang sgroms gdan bcas sku la thimagiX sku yang rdo rje de nyid sngags 'khor dang ltoX sngags phreng hūṃ la de yang zhabs kyu nas4༷༷ nā da'i bar bsdus ka dag dbyings su dgagiX bcu gcig smon lam gdabasapa/ dge 'di'i mthu yi sde brgyad zil gnon cing ltoX bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rab rgyal nas4༷༷ rang rig don gyi garma drag po rtsal4༷༷ mngon gsum rang zhal tshe 'dir 'grub gyur cigagiX bcu gnyisapa shisapa brjod pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyongs kun4༷༷ skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can4༷༷ bla ma rig 'dzin garma gu ru yigiX phyogs dus
kun tu khyab pa'i bkra dzesas regag: cesasogs lhasabarjod kyisarim pa ci rigs bya'o/ /gdul dka' 'gro la zhesapa'i lha'i me tog /slar yang byang ba rig ldan chosargyal ched/ /sngagasa'achang yongs kyi 'khor bsgyur dbang po'i sde'i/ /bka' gter bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs snyigs dusa'abyung po'i gnyen phor cher khrosapa/ /garma gu ru'i gtum drag tsha ba'i dbal/ /dusakyi me dpung khengs pa thung du rgyu/ /byed pa'i ngar de sde brgyad su yi bzod/ /sna tshogs rnam pa'i phyag mtshan nyer gdengs pa/ /las bzhi thogs med bsgrubasamang dkar phyogs rnams/ /'tshul dang chabasagacig phur bu'i bdud bzhi'i snying / /phug par nag po'i dpungs rnams gdong pa dmar/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul srid me chu sbubasanas/ /skal ba'i me lce tshangs risaphul pa che/ /bskal bsanyer brgyad bzhesadang cig char du/ /bkra lhas mi nor yongs 'phel de rmad byung / /de phyir phrin las gab dkrugs 'thor pa rnams/ /bsgyur don dam pa'i dgongs don 'khrul med du/ /rabasasdebasadage ba'i dusagasum rgyal kun gyis/ /bdag nyid rnga yab gling par rjesa'adzin shog /cesabla ma garma gu ru'i gyer sgoms phrin las gzi 'od stong 'bar zhesabya ba 'di nyid dkon mchog 'byung gnas thog chen mda' ltar 'phen pa sogs lang gro'i sngags 'chang rim par byon pas gdung las rta nag grel bar phub nas chen mosagasung gisabaskul zhing / chosargyal gter bdag gling pas kyang legs pa rgyu mtshan mdzad pas/ rnam g.yeng gi rigs zhen 'gying pas nyer char pho brang gnad byung ba sngags btsun ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'i bskul bsamatshams sbyor gyisarkyen byas gter gzhung ljagasa'agrigs gnyisadang bla ma'i gsung rgyun gyisalegs par brgyan de ma nor gyi sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyisadamar ser can gyisalo dbyug gu zla ba'i gral tshesal sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni
༄7: :dpal grogs sngagasaram pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /dge'o/ / 4/ yang gsang drag po'i sman mchod ni/ 'phrin las khrag 'thung garma he ru ka /pra chen ha sti padma thod phreng rtsal/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal khri dre nga lde'u btsan la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ kha hrī/ phrin las yongs grub rtsal dang ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /padmas rjes bzung rdo rje thog med la/ /bdud rtsi: sarbazo rig 'dzin chen po padma phrin las dang / /chos kyi rgyal po 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling / /ngag dbang klu grub ngag dbang 'jigs med zhabs/ /bdud rtsi: sarbaza 'gyur med mchog grub padma tshe dbang rtsal 'jigs med go cha bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas dang / /brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la4༷༷ bdud rtsica sarbacu karma gu ru yang gsang drag po skur/ /rnam rol lus dang bsrung ma go cha'i lha/ /ma hā dhe wa gnas chos srung ma la/ bdud rtsilnga sarba panyul kha hrī/ ces pa'ang za hor gyi brnyesasbyar/
༄༅/ /bla ma garma gu ru'i gtor nag gi rim pa bca' gzhi dngos gshom dang bcas pa'i lag len mtha' dag gnam lcags sprin 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /na mo gu ru garma ma hā sirnyi ya/ /rgyal ba kun gyisamathu stobasanusapa'i dpal/ /'phrin las sgrub pa bdud 'dul ma hā gu rsā /gang dang dbyer med drin chen chosakyi rje/ /padma mchog grub snying dbusa'o mtshor bsnyen/ /nang du rnam rtog 'khrul ba'i rang mdangasalas/ /phyi rol nyon mongs bdud bzhir shar ba'i dpung / /gcig char gzhom phyir drag po'i gtor nag gis/ /ngag 'don cung zad sprosate 'dir bshad do/ /de la 'dir bla ma garma gu ru'i gtor nag gi rim pa bca' gzhi gshom pa dang bcas pa'i lag len mtha' dag gnam lcags spu gri ltar 'du byas te/ sngon 'gro bdag bskyed las byang gi gzhung bsrangs te 'dzab kyi bar song / dngosagazhi gtor zor la gnon byed dgra bgegs rnams tha ma ji lta ba bzhin dgug gzhug nyer gcig gam bdun gyisamathar phur bu sgrol bzhin bsgral ba'i srang ka dang bcas sgril pa'i tshig dmigs bya/ gtor ma ngo bo bdud rtsi la rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung por bsam pa de nyid/ mdun du garma drag po'i lha tshogs spyan drangasapar phul zhing / slar yang drag po'i lha tshogs kyi rang bzhin du bdag mdun chabs gcig par gsal gdab pa ni/
༄tsho/ /hūṃ/ bdag mdun drag po'i gtor ma ni/ /bdud 'dul garma drag po'i sku/ /ljang nag du ba'i mdog lta bu/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan rnams rdzogs/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rtags/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon/ /g.yon pa seng ldeng phur pa gdengs/ /shes rab snying rjes sgrol pa'i phyir/ /zhing bcu'i ru tra sgrol ba'i rtags sku smad phur pa'i dbal dang ldan/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog ltar gyur/ /zhesagasal btab la/ spyan 'dren ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lang ka pu ri srin po'i yul/ /gtum drag rngams pa'i dur khrod nas srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /gu ru garma drag po rtsal/ /log 'dren ma rung bsgral slad du/ /gnas 'dir myur ba nyid du byon/ /garma ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaXdzaX/
dzaXhūṃ peṃ ho/ zhesapa'i mjug tu spro na/ hūṃ/ bzhengs shig padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dgongs shog phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams/ /zhesapa nas/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol cesapa'i bar song rjes/ bzhug gsol ba ni/ 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / /padma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stangs stabs 'bros pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal/ /badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i ma hā gu rtswa /drag po'i phrin las mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /ma rung dus mtha'i dmag dpung 'joms pa'i lha/ /khro rgyal phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma hā gu ru a ti pu ho pra ti dzaXho/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ sgo lnga'i longs spyod phyi yi mchod pa dang / /dug lnga rnam dag rang byung dag pa'i rdzas/ /bde chen yongs rdzogs gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams/ /bduda'adul padma'i sku la mchod pa 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen po bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ garma ma hā gu ru me sa rakta kem ni ri ti a mṛ ta ba linta ma hā sarba pu tsa khā hi/ zhesargyas par 'dod na/ rab gtsang dag byed mchod yon zhabs bkru'i rdzing / /rnam bkra'i me tog dri zhim bdug spos sprin/ /mun sel sgron me byung ba'i bde ba bskyed/ /ro ldan bza' bca' snyan 'gyur rol mo'i tshogs/ /rab
༄tshi/ /mdzes gzugs dang snyan mdzes glu dbyangs gar/ /mngar ba'i dri bsung ro brgya ldan pa'i zas/ /'jam mnyen reg bya bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs/ /srid zhi'i 'byor pa nam mkha'i khams kun 'gengs ngo mtshar bkod pa kun gyi rab 'phags pa'i/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas 'bul/ /oX badzra yolha:nas/ shapta pañtsa garma gu ru sapta ma hā ratna pu tsa ho/ rba rlabs 'phyur ba'i dmar chol dbang po yis/ /me tog tshil chen ga pur sbos zhun me/ /mkhris pa'i dri chab sha rus spungs pa'i chog /rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo tshar du dngar/ /rngams dang brjid pa sdom pa drag po'i rdzas/ /gshin rje'i mdun pa bzhin du bskang de 'bul/ oX ma hā shā shā na ambhaka kakaka/ shapta pra titstsha swā hā/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa rdzas kyi mchog /sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga/ /dag mnyam rtogs pa rang byung lha la mchod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi siddhi stsal du gsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ 'phrin las khrag 'thung garma he ru ka /pra chen ha ti padma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /phrin las yongs grub rtsal dang ngag gi dbang / /rgyal kun ngo bo chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /rig 'dzin zel gnon drag rtsal rdo rje la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grubaza gter bdag
gling pa gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang klu sgrub mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag /bka' drin 'bor med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod: ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal/ /drag po'i las byed bka' sdod ma hā de wa/ /bdud btsan klu gsum dam can bsrung ma la/ /bdud rtsi sman mchod: ka ya wa ka tsitta sarba siddhi oX a hūṃ hrī4༷༷ khyad par rmad byung dam rdzas 'dod yon lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig mchog gi rten/ /zag med bdud rtsi gtor ma'i longs spyod rgyan/ /phrin las grub pa'i rig 'dzin lha la 'bul/ ma hā ba linta khā hi/ nyu4༷༷ bde chen ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu/ /padma rakta chags pa chen po'i tshogs/ /ma lus gcig bsdus 'khor skyon dag pa'i rdzas/ /phrin las grub pa'i rig 'dzin lha la 'bul/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ hūṃ thabs kyi rdo rje bde chen waṃ gyis dpal/ /shes rab padma e yig rnam thar gsum/ /thabs shes gnyis med dga' bzhi mnyam sbyor ba/ /zag med rdzu 'phrul lam gyis mchod pa 'bul/ oX padma yo gi ni badzra pra be sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ hūṃ 'gro drug sa yi ye shes rdo rje yis/ /'khor ba'i bag chags gtan nas bcoms byas te/ /gnas ngan sgrib pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba mkha' gsang dbyings su bsgral mchod 'bul/ /ma traṃ ru tra pra bhañtsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ti hūṃ a yaṃ spha ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ dus gsum rgyal
༄tshi/ /ba'i thugs rje 'dus pa'i dpal/ /ma rungs 'dul mdzad garma drag po rtsal/ /'gro ba snyigs ma'i sdug bsngal skyobs pa'i lha/ /drag po'i phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dgra bgegs ru ṭa bsgrol ba'i las mdzod cig /zhes dang / hūṃ/ chos nyid 'gyur med bde chen ngang nyid las/ /'gags med 'gro la rjes chags snying rje'i gar/ /mi bsrun bdud gyi sde dpung kun 'joms pa che ba'i che mchog garma drag por bstod/ /ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing gtum/ /lta bar bzod dka'i gzi byin mtshungs pa med/ /gsang phod mthing ka snam sbyar gnyen zhu gsol/ /sku smad phur bu'i bdud bzhi gzir la bstod phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje las bzhi sgrub/ /g.yon pa phur bu'am log 'dren snying kha 'big /sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba bdud bzhi yis/ /mgo 'phreng khrag 'dzag do shal 'dzin la bstod/ /sgeg dang dpa' dang 'jigs su rung ba'i sku/ /rgod dang gshe dang rngams pa'i ngar ldan gsung / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba chen po'i thugs/ /khro bo'i gar gyi nyams dgu rdzogs la bstod/ /gzhom med rdo rje gnam lcags gur khang dbus/ /rab brjid lhun sdud ma rgad ri bo la/ /nyin mor byed ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ /log 'dren bsregs phyed me dbus 'gying la bstod/ /sku las me mtshon khro bo'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /mi bsrun bdud
dang bdud kyi phyogs ma lus/ /'joms pa'i mthu jag gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog /'bebs mdzad khro bo'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzlas dmigs ni/ thugs gar mthing nag rdo rje'i dbus/ /hūṃ yig mtha' ru las sngags ni/ /mgar gyi ldan me lta bur 'phro/ /'bar ba drag po sku ru gsal/ /zhesating 'dzin gsal nas sngags kyi sham bur/ gnod byed bdud bzhi'i snying la raṃ raṃ thul thul/ trig rbad trig rbad/ ha las ti trig nan rbad cesabatab pa ci mang bzlasashing / bsrung bzlog mi dmigs sngagasagazhung du sger gsal ma gsung kyang rgya can yang gsang drag por gsal zhing mi rung ba min phyir dmigs gsal spro na/ khyab bdag bla ma padma mchog grub kyi gsung gi gnang ba zur du gsal ba bzhin blangs pas mchog go / zor bsgrub pa ni/ bka' bstod dbang phyug gi zor gtor la dmigs nas/ bdag dang drag po'i zor gtor ni/ mi zad dbang phyug chen po'i sku/ shin tu che ba gyen du 'grengs/ 'bras bus klu yi yul du zug /skyed pa mi yi yul du bsdoms/ /mgo bo lha yi yul du 'khyong / /chu sbur bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /sku yi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /zhun gyi me stag khro bo 'phro/ /sngags zlas me yi 'od zer gyis/ /gnod byed thams cad tshig par gyur a tra sad tra so le peṃ/ ghu laṃ bhi bhyo/ utna utna/ thun chog thun chog rarno thun chog ba so ba so ti ra ta nag po sarba thub waṃ/ byad stems ma ra ya bzlog yar bzlog mar bzlog tshal par gas mā
ra༅༅/ /ra ya badzārshag cesamang du bzlasashing thun la'ang sngagasaso/ /bar 'dir tshogs thog ma dang bar ma gnyisasong nas/ tha ma la rten nas bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ste/ liṅga zur pa ga:ga bshamasal/ bskul ba ni/ hūṃ/ gnam lcag gzhal yas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad garma drag po rtsal/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bgegs tshogs bdud dpung ma lus dgra la bsgyur/ /ma hā de wa srid pa'i mes po che bskal pa'i me rlung bar snang khams 'khrugs pas/ /nad gdon bar gcod rkyen ngan ma lus pa/ /gnam lcags zor gyi dgra rba'i steng du bsgyur/ /bdud 'dul garma drag po'i lha tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshog dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod/ /bla ma'i sku dgra rnal 'byor yongs la 'tshe/ khyad par bdag sogs rgyu sbyor yon bdag la/ /gnod byed gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs/ /yang dgos log 'dren dam sri 'byung po'i dpung / /rbad 'dren rbod gtong byad ma mkhan po sogs/ /rnam par shes pa bla srog tshe gsum rnams/ /thar med 'brub khung nag po'i nang 'khrid de/ /bdud bzhi gzugs brnyan dmigs bya'i khog pa rtswa /ming byang yi ger btab pa 'di nyid la/ /da lta nyid du gug bstim phrin las mdzod/ /zhesadang spro na/ hūṃ/ phrin las grub pa garma drag po rtsal/ /'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po dus la
babs ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i shar ba'i tshe/ /bod kyi sems can las ngan spyod dus 'dir/ /khri srong lde'u btsan gdung brgyud tha dag la/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sngon gyi las dang rkyen gyis dbang bsgyur te/ /chos rgyal dmangs su 'bebs pa mi skyob na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam gang la mdzad/ /'gro drug sdug bsngal skyob par mi mdzad na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gdul bya gang la dgongs bod kyi rje 'bangs thugs rjes ma skyobs na/ /padma 'byung gnas mthu rtsal gang la bskyed/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad mi bsrung na/ /chos skyongs bka' bsrung dam bca' ci la dgongs/ hūṃ bzhengs lhag zhing khams so so'i gnas nas bzhengs/ /dgongs shig snyigs ma'i sems can don la dgongs/ /gshegs shog bod kyi rje 'bangs don la gshegs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha yi tshogs padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong srung ma dam can gzhi bdag rnams/ /mthu rtsal dpung bskyed bdag gis bsam pa bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug / bdud kyi sprul pas 'dzam gling khyab par nyul/ /bod yul 'di na sdug bsngal khrag mtsho rdol/ /khri srong lde'u btsan gdung brgyud dmangs su 'bebs/ /dben gnas dgon pa rnams su jag choms byed/ /
༄tshi/ /dmag dpung 'jigs pas sems can gyod la 'bebs/ /bdud dang 'gong pos sde dpon kha lo bsgyur/ /dam chos tshul bzhin byed du bar gcod byas/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung du ma ster ro/ /dam can bka' srung mchod du ma ster ro/ /chos rgyal mnga' thang rgyas su 'bangs 'go rgod/ /bod khams sems can de ru dmag 'khrugs dar/ hūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /khro bo 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog /'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje glog ltar 'khyug /byin rlabs mthu rtsal drag po thog ltar 'bebs/ /bdud dang 'gong po dam sri sha za dang / /'phung byed gdon gyis rigs rnams thal bar rlog /dug lnga rang brgyud byol nyog 'khrugs pa'i mi/ /bdud kyi sde dpon rgyal phran chom la phob/ /las ngan brngams sems me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /dmag dpon dmag mi rang gshed rang la phob sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa'i gdon bgegs dang / /chos rgyal dmangs su 'bebs pa'i dgra bo dang / /bod khams phung bar byed pa'i 'gong po rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs kun yid kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa smyo ru chug /ngag gi smra ba lkug bzhin brgyal du chug /rdos bcas lus kyi phung po myur du sgrol/ /bdag cag bar gcod 'di las thar bar mdzod/ /bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus
sgrub par mdzod/ /cesabaskul gser skyems byin rlabasagater mdzod ma dang / rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud ma sogs gang rigs btad rjesagazu dpang gsol ba ni/ hūṃ/ dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /khyad par khrag 'thung garma drag po rtsal/ /bstan bsrung rgya mtshor bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /sgrib bral ye shes spyan gyi nye bar dgongs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la rab bzhugs rig 'dzin bdag /khas blangs sdom gsum mig gi 'bras ltar bsrungs/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo gzhung bzhin nyams len btang / /dgra dang bgegs kyis nye bar 'tshe byed na/ /yi dam zhi khros gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /chos skyongs srung mas dkar nag las shan phye/ /dam can rgya mtshos brnag pa'i dgra bo sgrol/ /dam bca' dus las la g.yol ra zlar rlog /tshe 'di'i che thabs rnam g.yengs rgyang du bsring / /snying nas byang chub sgrub la lhag par zhol/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i nyin byed 'da' byed pa dgra dang bgegs kyis nye bar: yi dam zhi khros gzu dang : chos skyong srung mas dkar nagazo dam can rgya mtshos brnagazo dam bca' dus las ma g.yel ra: ngal ba khyad bsad bla ma yun du bstan/ /dka' bar ma brtsegs bsnyen bsgrub mtha' 4 phyon/ /chos bsrung lus dang dri ma ltar brten pa/ /dgra dang bgegs kyis nye bar 'tshe byed na/ /yi dam khro bos gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /chos skyong srung mas dkar nag
༄tshi/ /las shan phye/ /dam can rgya mtshos brnag pa'i dgra bo sgrol/ /dam bca' dus las ma g.yel ra zlar rlog /gzugs byang ming rus btab pa'i dgra bo 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan bshog bla ma'i sku dgra dang dge 'dun sde bcom skye 'gro yongs la 'tshe/ /rig 'dzin bsrung mar bcas pa brnyes byas na/ /rtags mtshan mi ston sngon gyis dam bca' 'gal/ /chos nyid bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /khrag mthung khro bo'i 'bor lo ston mdzad nas/ /log 'dren gdul pa'i dgra sde mi sgrol na/ /'jigs rung khro bor ston la ngo re nongs/ /bden pa'i tshig gi smreng du gsol ba la/ /ye shes spyan la rdzun gtam su yis nus/ /de phyir mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed la/ /mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las myur du mdzod/ /'brub khung bskyed chog ni/ phaṭa4༷༷ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du e las lcags sregs kyi khang sgrom gru gsum bang rim dgu pa kha khyer dog cing gting zab pa/ 'og na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khol ba/ log la zhe sdang gi me rlung 'tshub pa/ steng na gti mug gi mun pa thibs pa/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs shing nad dang dug gi rlangs pa 'phyo ba / than dang ltas ngan gyi cho 'phrul mi zad pa 'khrugs pa/ las byed gshin rje'i dmags tshogs seng ltar rngam pa/ stag ltar 'phyo ba/ srin po ltar khros pa/ sha za ltar rgyug pa/ rgyob rgyob dang gsod gsod kyi
sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pas gang bas srid pa'i las kyi btson khang drag po'i de'i nang du yi ge :'i tri dud kha yongs su gyur pa las/ dgra'am bgegs de nyid lus gcer bu rid cing mdog nag dran pa nyams pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag pa gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ tshigs shing stim pa ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi: chos kyi bka'aje dge 'dun: gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang / snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang / chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang /khyad par dpal chen khrag 'thung garma drag po las byed dbang phyug ma hā de wa gter bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyir dgra khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dam tshig gcig gi 'dus pa rnams la snga dgra lag gi brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzug pa'i gzugs can gyis dgra/ gzung med gnod byed kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig bsgrub sngagasakyi gsham du/ oX sarba birgha
༄༅/ /sha hūṃ a garsha ya dza4༷༷ snra yaṃ dza4༷༷ tri yaṃ dza4༷༷ oX badzra e ku sha dza4༷༷ oX badzra pa sha hūṃ/ oX badzra slo ḍa baṃ/ oX badzra gharnye ho:༷༷ pra be sha ya phaṭa4༷༷ a be sha ya ā:༷༷ zhesaso so'i phyag rgya dang bcasa'agugs/ pho nya 'gyed pa ni/nyu4༷༷ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /log 'dren bar gcod dgra bgegs rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag rdul du bshog nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum smod dang / /bla ma la brnyas sems can 'tshegiX bdag gi sgo ba kun bkugs la/ /liṅga 'di la myur du chug /bsrung skyob mgon dang bral bar mdzod/ /badzra ang ku sha dza4༷༷ badzra pa sha hūṃ/ badzra slo ḍa rbaltoX badzra ghandhe ho:༷༷ bla 'gugs ni/ bhyoX bla 'gugs sprul pa gnod sbyin gser gyi stagagiX lcags kyi dom spyang byu ru'i khyi mo dang ltoX khyung chen gser gyi 'phar ba zangs kyi dredagiX gang mtshams gzugs su grub pa khyed rnams kyis4༷༷ bla tshe 'khyams po 'phyo ba'i dus drug la4༷༷ bla rtags 'bri dang sha ba sgo ba lugagiX ra khyi bya dang gla ba bong bu sogs4༷༷ gang tu rdzus kyang da lta nyid du khugagiXbsgrubasapa sngags kyisamajug tu/ dgra bo'i bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grimagiX sha ma du ti thul thul4༷༷ phyogs myogs yod yod/ sha ma du ti khug ling myong ling shag ling thum tsan munti bhyo dza4༷༷ zhesabakugs/ de nasalha dang dbye ba ni/ gu
gul gyi dud pa byas lhang / bya 'ug gi sgro thog nas dmigs pa dang bcas/ bhyoX dbye byed las kyi wo nya'i tshogs4༷༷ las ngan sdig can dgra bo 'diljoX srung zhing skyob par byed pa yigiX ye shes 'jig rten lha yi tshogs4༷༷ phrol zhig phye zhig rnam par phyegiX dgra bla spyi dra'i gtsug nas phrol4༷༷ srog lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol/ yul lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrol4༷༷ mo lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol4༷༷ rig 'dzin srung ma rgyab nas phrol4༷༷ mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang sprodagiX ma ma trag raka ma ra ya phye phye mṛ tri de wa sarba u tsa ta ya phaṭa4༷༷ cesabya 'ug pa'i sgro byabo/ /de nasanyesapa sgrags pa ni/ hūṃX dug lnga'i dbang gyur dgra bgegs khyod/ /rang gis nyes byas rang la smin/ /bdag gis snying rjes bsgral par bya/ /byang chub thob par khyod smon cigagiX thun rdzasakyisabrab pa ni/ hūm̐X/ gtum drag dpal ldan pho nya'i tshogs/ /rno ngar thun rdzas mtshon cha'i char/ 'bebs pa dgra bgegs steng du bhyo:༷༷ rjes shul tsam yang med par mdzod/ rtsa sngagasagyi mthar las sngags btagasapas brdeg /phur gdab ni/ phur bu rang gi thal mo bar du bzung la/ rang gis sor mo lnga rigs lnga yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya ho/ rjes su chags pa'i rnyuXr bas snyom par bzhugs pa'i mkha' la sras mchog garma ke la ya sku stod srin po khros pa'i nyams can ljang nag phur bu bsgril ba/ lte ba man chad chu sprin gyi kha nas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dbal zur gsum du rno ba khong seng
༄tshi/ /du dregs ba'i dmag tshogs las la rngams zhing dus me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ oX garma kī la ya kā ya waka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa me/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ de nyid la thim pas khams gsum dus gcig du sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ hūṃ khro rgyal khrag thung chen po yigiX sras mchog garma kī la ya/ bsgril bas lha yang skrag byed pagiX btab pas dgra bgegs smos ci dgos4༷༷ zhing bcu tshangs pa'i log 'dren tshogs4༷༷ sgrol cig ye shes klong du sgrol4༷༷ bsgrub sngagasakyi stam bu: karma zhi la ya hūṃ phaṭa4༷༷ gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi srog la raṃ raṃ/thul thul/ trig rbad trig rbad/ ha la sa ti trig nan rbad/ ces tshe khrusakyi tshongs pa ltar snying khar btab nas bsgral/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams/ ma rtogs 'khrul pa snying re rje/ /snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /thugs rje'i thabs kyis sbyor ba yi/ /phung po bsgral pa'i zhing du bcas/ /rnam shes yum gyi mkha' la spar/ /ye shes sems par byin rlabs te/ /rig pa chos kyi dbyings su 'phangs khyod ni rgyal ba'i sras su bskyed/ cesabarjod 'bor bar mi ldog pa'i phyir gnas khar phur pa btab rdeb pa ni/ hūṃ drag po sgrol mdzad phur bu yis/ /lus kyi 'khrul pa rtsad gcod phyir/ /lte ba'i dkyil du kī la ya/ /

ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag gnyis kyi gurnye dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa rgyan gos thams cad dkar po ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong 'bor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma ya dza dza4༷༷ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshi gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs drang srong mchog/rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du/ /'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ asne ye de wi e hya hi sa ma ya dzaXdzaX hūṃ gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub mdzad cing / /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'bar ba'i gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol/ padma kā ma la ye st+waṃ/ oX ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa'i dbyangs dag byed pa ste / /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin/ /de yi bdag cag 'khor bcas la bgegs rnams med cing zhi bar mdzod/ hūṃ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sems can don la dam tshig dgongs/ /gzi brjid che zhing thugs rjer ldan/ /bdag cag gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho:༷༷ pra titstsha ho:༷༷ hūṃ asne'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /bdag sogs sems can sdig sgrib sbyang slad du/ /sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /mi gtsang skyon gyi dri ma dag gyur cig /oX asne ye
༄tshi/ /de ba pra wa sarka ra pra ti tstsha swā hā/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ yon chab ji snyed yod pa rnams/ asne'i sku la mchod pa 'bul/ 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oX asne ye a ha ra pu tsa me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni: me tog jingu asne'i spyan: 'gro ba'i: puspro pu tsaza 'jig rten khams ni: bdug spos: asne'i shangs: 'gro ba'i: dha: pā tsaza 'jig rten khams: snang gsal drizoasne'i spyan: 'gro ba'i: a lo ke pā tsaza 'jig rten khams ni: dri chab jingu asne'i sku: 'gro ba'iza gandhe pā tsaza 'jig rten khams: zhal zas: asne'i ljags: 'gro: ni wi du pā tsaza 'jig rten khams: rol mo:asne'i snyan: 'gro: oX asne ye shalta: nyu asne chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub phyir/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /byon skems yam shing lan gsum/6༷wa asne ye swā hā/ 6༷wa asne ye na maXs manta badha nam purṇa hrigi mant+ra 6༷wa āXhūṃ/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug khyad par du mtha' yi dmag dpung sogs krerdzod khams phung bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad shinti ku ru swā hā/ me lha'i mtshan sngags/ 6༷wa asne ye swā hā yam sgang 6༷wa badzra dzñā na arma ye swā hā/ mar khu la/ khiX/ asne ye de wa shri sosmra de swā hā/ til la / 6༷/ sarba pā peṃ da ha na badzra ya ha bya ka byaswā hā/ dur ba sbyin/ 6༷wa badzra a yu
ṣe swā hā/ me tog la/ oX badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ ku sha zung sbyar/ oX a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ yungs par / oX ma hā sa ma la swā hā / zho zan oX badzra gasma ri yi swā hā/ gos zung 'bul/ oX badzra wastu ye swā hā/ oX badzra pukhreg sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ srid pa rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyi dngos grub byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog /dam pas srid pa byed par shog /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog/'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /rig pa sgrub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcangs/ /bgrang phreng 'dzin cing rigs sngags gsung / /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gundhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes me yi bdag nyid 'byung ba chen po me yi rang bzhin asne chen po khyod kyi bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sreg pa dang / bsod nams spel ba dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i
༄tsho/ /phyir/ mchod rdzas zhal du stob pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oX prokṣa ṇaṃ pra titstsha ye swā hā/ me lha'i ye shes pa steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs dam tshig me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ sna tshogs snang ba 'khrul pa'i chos/ kun kyang sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /ngo bo gdod nas ka dag dbyings/ /chos sku thig le bde chen klong / /ye stong nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /rnam rtog 'ja' sprin ltar shar ba/ /zhen 'dzin 'khrul pas bcings ba'i 'gror/ /lhun grub snying rje'i rang gdangs shar/ /longs sku'i rtsal la thugs rje'i 'od/ /ma 'gag chu nang zla gzugs bzhin/ /rang rig yi ge hūṃ dkar po/ /sprul sku rgyu yi sa bon shar / hūm̐X las byung ba'i sngags brjod pas/ /gzhom med rdo rjes rab gtams pas/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /sde brgyad sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /chu skyes steng du bdud bzhi po/ /lha bdud dkar po phung bdud ser/ /nyon mongs bdud dmar 'chi bdag nag /gan rkyal kha sbub spel ma rtswa /byi chings bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rgyu yig 'bar ba'i hūṃ chen dkar/ /babs las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshul 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /rang rig garma gu ru'i sku/ /yang gsang drag po sku mdog dkar/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rbu pa 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor
rtsibs bzhi'i /steng / gshin rje nag po g.yas be con/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad/ /mgrin pa padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /rta mgrin dmar po g.yas padma'i/ /yu ba nas 'dzin g.yon bhanta/ /thugs gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /sngon po'i lte bar phyag rdor ni/ /mthing nag thugs gar rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten/ /lte ba g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i steng / /rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar/ /g.yas pa gri gug mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod phrag thugs gar 'dzin/ /rtse mor sbas yab kha ṭwāṃ tshul/ /dbu skra nag po bsil bur phog /nu ma bha ga rab tu rgyas/ /gcer bu phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /g.yas pa rting pa bha gar gtad/ /zhabs g.yon ro yaṃ gdan la 'gyings/ /phyogs bzhir rigs kyi kha dog can/ /rang 'dra'i mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor/ /gsang gnas zhing steng me dbal smug /g.yas pa me yi tho ba dang / /g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu 'dzin/ /yan lag bzhi ka dbu skra dang / /smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar/ /rus pa dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /smyi bor hūṃ mdzad sku mdog sngo/ /thugs gar rang gi phyag rgya 'chang ltag par khro bo'i rnam par rgyal/ /sku mdog sngon po rdo rje g.yas/ /mgrin par khro bo rta mgrin dpal/ /sku mdog dmar po padma g.yas/ /dpung pa g.yas la gshin rje'i gshed/ /sku mdog nag po be
༄tshi/ /con g.yas/ /dpung pa g.yon la bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram g.yas/ /g.yas pa'i brla la dbyug sngon can/ /sku mdog sngon po dbyug pa g.yas/ /brla g.yon gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /sku mdog dkar po dbyug pa g.yas/ /lte ba khro bo mi g.yo ba/ /sku mdog sngon po ral gri g.yas/ /dpyi mtshams khams gsum rnam par rgyal/ /sku mdog ser po 'bor lo g.yas/ /gsang gnas khro bo stobs po che sku mdog nag po rdo rje g.yas/ /g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /dar gyi stod g.yog stag sham dang / /rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul gyis brgyan/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /kun kyang sku mdog dkar ba'i mdangs/ /'od zer dkar po 'phro bar gyur/ spran drangs pa ni/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lang ka pu ri srin po'i yul/ /gtum drag rngams pa'i dur khrod nas/ /srin po'i rgyal po yal gam can/ /yang gsang garma drag po rtsal/ /log 'dren ma rungs bsgral slad du/ /gnas 'dir myur ba nyid du byon/ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaX dzaXhūṃ peṃ hoX btsos su gsol ba ni/ sde brgyad sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng / /padma'i gdan la nyon mongs bdud/ /dkar ser dmar nag bzhi bsnol steng / /stangs stabs khros pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ ma hā gu ru garma drag po rtsal badzra sa ma yā tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ni/ dpal chen thugs kyi
sprul pa ma hā gu rtswa /drag po'i phrin las mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /ma rungs dus mtha'i dmag dpung 'joms pa'i lha/ /khro rgyal phrin las rdzogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ ma hā gu ru a ti pu ho/ pra titstsha ho/mchod pa ni/ hūṃ dngas bsil mchod yon rab bkra'i chu skyes tshul/ /dri zhim bdug spos snang la nyi zla'i 'od/ /sna tshogs sman chab ro brgya'i lha bshos spungs/ /sgra snyan rol mo phyi yi mchod sprin spro/ /khrag gi ambha dbang po'i me tog dang / /gsur chen dud pa tshil chen mar me sbar/ /sha rus zhal zas thod rnga rkang gling sogs/ /dur khrod rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ oX garma ma hā gu ru sa pa ri wa ra a :: nas shapta'i bar brjod/ nang mchod ni/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta/ /dam rdzas gtor ma dmar chen rakta'i skyems/ /sde brgyad bdud bzhi bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang / /mnyam sbyor bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ oX garma ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal sa pa ri wa ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba linta/ me sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na zhing ni ri ti ma hā pu dza sarba pā tsa khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje 'dus pa'i dpal/ /ma rungs 'dul mdzad garma drag po rtsal/ /'gro ba snyigs ma'i sdug bsngal skyob pa'i lha/ /khro rgyal phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jam dpal gshin rje rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje phag mo rigs bzhi mkha'

༄༅/ /gtsang rong gter gsar bla ma zhi drag gnyis kyi gter srung mchod pa'i phrin las bzhugs/ sku gsum rigs 'dusa'achi med tshe yi lha: phrin las drag po garma gu ru la/ gusapas btud nas gang desazab chosakyi/ gter srung mchod pa'i rim pa bri bar bya/ de yang sku gsum rigs 'dusamatsho skyesardo rje dang garma gu ru gnyisakyi gter srung mchod thabasagater ston rin po che'i dusacung zad sbasatshul gnang ba rgyun 'byams su song ba'i yi ge sogs mi 'dug rung garma gu ru bsgrub par 'tshub cha'o rnam pa'ang tho rengs yong 'dug pas rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po yan chad srung ma 'khor tshogs dang bcasate mchod bar mdzad pa rjesa'ajug rnams kyi ma ngesaba'i mchod gtor chad skyon du 'dug pas kham bu lung gi rong btsan kha ba dkar po dang / klu mo lcam mo 'bum gza' gnyisal gtor ma bsngo dgosagasung ba rje bla ma padma dbang gi zhal lasaposashing / lhang lhang gyi bdud la gtor ma chad na 'tshub yong / kho bosadangosasu 'grub pas/ bdud btsan klu gsum gyi mchod gtor 'bul bar byed pa la/ bdud la bdud bshosanag po zlum po rtse mo zur bkug pa/ rong btsan la btsan bzhosazur gsum dmar po klu la klu gtor dkar po sbrul gyisa'agyur pa gsum ka la mtheb kyusabaskor ba/ mchod pa sogs bshams te byin gyisabarlabs pa ni/ thugs nas 'phros pa'i raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum gyis/ /mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag bsregs gtor bkru/sa/ /a dang khiXwa las bhanta rin chen 〈snad/ /sha khrag dang ni bdud rtsi'i khu/ sman gyur/ 6༷/ āXhūṃ/ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren ni/ lhang lhang mtshams phug gnas dang kham bu lung / /gnas chos bsrung bar ñtsarsha rgyan chen po yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bdud btsan 'i/ gsum pophyo/ /thogs pa med

༄tshi/ /lnga yi dus/ /gdug pa can rnams 'khrugs pa'i dang / /sa bdag klu'i nad yams dar/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /mi rnams bsod nams longs spyod chung / /rang bsags dngos po spyad dbang med/ /pha dang bu 'gras longs spyod nyams/ /de dus bcom ldan bstan pa 'di/ /dpa' bo bdag gis bsrung bar bgyi/ /zhes gsol ba dang / de nas dpal chen he ru gas/ legs so dur khrod bdag po khyod/ /srog gi snying po bdag la phul/ zhes gsungs pa dang / tarya thā/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ zhes mdongs gsol du phul lo/ dur khrod bdag po gsang ba snying po'i 'khor lo'i rgyud las gling gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ste/ /dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ste/ /'di yi bsgrub pa'i
thabs bstan pa/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag gam/ /lha khang la sogs dben gnas su/ /maṇḍal mda' gang rgya phyed brtsigs/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum mtho gang bru/ /mi rta khrag gis chag chag gdab/ /zur la mchog phur re re gzugs/ /steng du thod pa dum gcig par/ /ri bong lug dang g.yag rgod sha /dkar gsum mngar gsum lhang thog 'bru/ /sna tshogs zhal zas ma lus pa/ /rin chen lnga dang dar zab ras/ /stag gzig la sogs mi nor rnams/ /dngos grub blang phyir thod par bkang / /de steng dur khrod bdag po ni/ /rab ni rin chen lnga la byas/ /'bring ni ba so rus pa la/ /tha ma sa la rin chen brdar/ /yar ngo'i skar ma rgyal la ni snga dro dang ni dus su bya/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /dbu la rin chen sna tshogs dang / /thod skam lnga yi brgyan pa'o/ /rgya phyed rin chen do shal brgyan/ /keng rus gar byed mche ba gtsigs/ /phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba bsnams/ /gaskurdzon pas thod khrag zhal du gsol/ /bskyangs bskum tshul gyi legs par gnas/ /sna lhamags sgrub rdzas steng na bzhugs/ /dar dkar dam/ra zerab yang 'dugadag la sngags bris la/ /bud med ma reg gser dngul gnyis/ /de yi thugs gar bzhugs par bya/ /de ni mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rten/ /steng nas dar dkar nag zerab yang 'dugagur khang phub/ /sgrub pa thon nas bang mdzod sba/ /dus bzang mchod gtor
༄tshi/ /dbul bar bya/ /dngos grub gang 'dod gsol ba gdab/ /sna tshogs 'bru sna rin chen brdar/ /ga bur bzang drug chu yis bkru/ /sngar dang 'dra ba'i sku byas la/ nang gi rten du bzung bar bya/ /dur khrod ro ras sku bris te/ /phyi rten dam tshig lus la bcangs/ /dkon mchog yi dam chos skyong la/ /mchod bstod dngos grub gsol bar byed/ a mṛ ta dang sha lnga dang / /chang dang sna tshogs zas kyi ni/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum mchod de nas mtshams bcad bshags pa bya/ /yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags nas/ /de rjes tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi dang / /shu n+ya ta yi stong bar bsgoms/ /de nas bdag nyid hūm̐X las ni/ /he ru gar bsam mdun du ni/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsam/ /gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas/ / oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khum lhas swā hā/ de yi mtshan rtags lha yi ston/ /mgon po dngos su 'byung 'gyur na/ /gang 'dod dngos su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang 'dod dngos grub thams cad 'byung / /ratna'i tshogs pa 'byung gyur na/ /nor gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /shing thog byung na zas rnams 'du/ /ba dang ma he byung gyur na/ /dkar thog thams cad 'phel bar gyur/ /til dang 'bras la spyod gyur na/ /'bru rnams thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dung 'bud rnga brdung shin tu bzang / /nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon/ /rtsod pa 'gyed dang zas ngan
za brnye sngags pa byung gyur na/ /mgon po khros pas bskang bshags bya/ /gsang ba snying gi 'bor lo'i rgyud las/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bdag nyid bsrung dang gnas bsrung dang / /yul khams grong khyer bsrung ba dang / /shes rab 'phel ba la sogs pa/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin lha dang sbyar/ /gzhan gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa dang / /dngos grub la sogs gang bsgrub kyang / /dkyil 'bor rdzas rnams gong du bstan/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang rtsa ba'i sngags/ /sgrub pa chen po'i rtags thon nas/ /las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig go/ /sgrub pa gang bsgrub myur du 'grub/ /gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ /las tshogs mdor bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gzhan gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa ni/ /kham pa thal chen rgyu dag la/ /yab yum sku byas ye shes bstims/ /mchod gtor gsol ba gdab par bya/ /tshes brgyad nya dang stong gsum la/ / padma nag po'i du bas bdug /gzas pa po yi ming rus can/ /brub khung nang du gzhug par bya/ /steng du tshwa tshwa nag pos mnan/ /yungs dkar thal chen dug khrag gsum/ /rtsa ba'i sngags dang drag sngags 'di/ /a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ /che ge mo'i rigs sngags bzlog mā ra ya rbad/ /dus bzhir thun gyis brab par bya/ /rigs sngags bzlog par the tshom med/ /yab yum
༄tshi/ /zhal ni dgra phyogs bstan/ /liṅga dug shing tsher mas sreg /thal ba dam nyams phyogs su gtor/ /gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ /rigs sngags bzlog pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs chen po/ /dam tshig ldan pas dang du blangs/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin rgyun mi bcad/ /dkyil 'khor rdzas rnams gsang zhing sba/ /bud med sme can khyi dang gsum/ /de dag mi 'phrad dam tshig yin/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /'bru sna tsan dan chus sbyar te/ /rab tu gnas dang mchod pa dang / /chang phud gtor ma phul nas ni/ /zhag bdun bar du sgrub par bya/ /sku de bang mdzod phugs su gzhug dus bzang gsum la mchod bya ste/ /gsol ba gdab la dngos grub blangs/ /thun mongs rdzas dang zas nor 'du/ /gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ /dngos grub blangs pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /dkar gsum dag la byas gyur na/ /dkar gyi dngos grub thob par gyur/ /mkhar ba'i sku gzugs zhing dkyil gzhugs/ /lo tog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mya/ thab 'og mda' gang 'og tu ni/ /gru gsum mtho gang brus la gzhugs/ /zas kyi dngos grub ma lus 'phel/ /chom rkun 'ching pa'i man ngag ni/ /chu'am gseg ma la sogs la/ /dbyug tho'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas/ /
bdag dang rdzas la phyogs bcur gtor/ /chom rkun bcings bar gsol ba gdab/ /mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi nas/ /yab yum gar byed 'gro bar bsam/ /gnas su phyin te ting 'dzin glod/ /de yi 'jigs pa kun las thar/ /rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog /gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya/ /de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la dur khrod kyi/ /bdag po sha za yab yum mchod/ /e dam bha liX ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ /zhes pa lan lnga dag gis phul/ /gsol nas phrin las gang dgos byed/ /keX rus gzugs can khro bo yi/ /phyag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon zhags pa/ /bsnams pa shon tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /mche ba can gyis stong gsum gang / /thams cad zil gyis gnon byed cing / /yan lag dbang po bcings bar bsam/ /zhing lpags stag lpags gang rung la/ /sku bris dpung g.yon btags pa ni/ /mthong ba'i mi rnams dbang du 'gyur/ /dur khrod ras la sku bris te/ /dmag dpon spyi bor btags pa la/ /gsang sngags 'bum bzlas zhabrugs pa rgyal/ /tsan dan shing ngam shug pa la/ /dri bzang dag gis sku bris la/ /sgo steng bzhugs na rims nad bsrungs/ /dur khrod ras la bris nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor steng du bla bre bya/ /rang gzhan gnyis gyi bar chad bsrung / /gser gyis bris pa'i yab yum sku/ /pha ma gnyis la
༄༅/ /bsnol mar btags/ /lte ba bsgyur la rigs brgyud 'phel/ /yab yum sku ni rgyab yol nang / /sbas na tshogs rdzogs 'bor g.yog 'dud/ /snying gar hūm̐X la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros sems can sgrib pa sbyangs brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig bzlas/ /shes rab 'phel bar the tshom med/ rmya/ bdag gzhan lam du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /nyungs dkar dag la nyer gcig bzlas/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du/ /yab yum gnyis kyi gang bar bsgoms/ /byi bo brgya yang 'gugasapar 'gyur/ /thal chen thar nu re lcags la/ /thang phrom nyung dkar lnga po la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni khri phrag gcig /bzlas pa'i bye ma dang bsres la/ /zhing la gtor na lo legs 'byung / / mya/ bsrung skud mdud pa nyer gcig la/ /sngags ni brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /gang la btags na bsrung bar 'gyur/ /stag gzig la sogs gcan gzan gyis/ /bdag la sogs pa gnod gyur na/ /sha ba'i rgyu'i phye len mkhar/ /mthing gi shog bu sngon po la/ /gser gyi yi ge sngags bris la/ / mun pa'i gling du sbas gyur na/ /gcan gzan gdug pa kha 'chings 'gyur/ oX/ gcan gzan kha chings gcan gzan kha sdoms/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /'di la the tshom mi bya'o/ /dar dkar gro ga shing shun la/ /dam nyams bu chung ming bris te/ /mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ gcan gzan wa yi thod pa rtswa
rtog pa'i snying khrag dam nyams kyi/ /dri ma gang rnyed thod par blug /bdag nyid dur khrod bdag por bsgom/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la bstim/ /gcan gzan stag gi mche bas dkrugs/ /zhag bdun gyis ni las kun 'grub/ /che ge mo'i bu la mā ra ya rbad/ 'di'i dam tshig bstan pa ni/ sri'u gso bar mi bya'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zhal las shes/ /sngags bzlas dkrugs na ling thog sel/ /rtsub pa'i rtsa ba dkrugs pa'i brun/ /byang tshar 'bru mar la sbyar bas/ /lpags nad ma lus sel bar byed/ /gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ /las tshogs rgyas pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /de nas dpa' bo chen po yi bdag gi las rnams gang bsgrub kyang / /gdung ba chen po'i skad kyis ni/ /bstod cing bskul ba 'di skad do/ / hūm̐X/ dur khrod chen pe'i gnas mchog nas/ /keX rus thod pa'i gur khang nas/ /rakta'i rba klong dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni/ / gti mug spangs phyir keng rus sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /zhe sdang 'joms phyir thod dbyug 'phyar/ /'dod chags mtsho skem thod khrag 'thung / /g.yas pa'i thod dbyug 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i klad pa 'joms/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gis/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi snying khrag 'thung / /'bar ba'i keX rus mche
༄༅/ /ba gtsigs/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod par byed/ /dbu la rin chen phrog zhu gsol/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter dang ldan/ /mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa yin/ /sku la rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /gnyis med shes rab yum chen mo/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /gad mo sgrogs shong khros stobs tshul/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing / /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i dbang phyug ste/ /rigs sngags bzlog pa'i mthu bo che/ /rang rtags srog snying sgra sgrogs shing / /dpal ldan yab yum thugs rje can/ /khyod kyi sprul pas gar yang khyab/ /rtsa gsum lha gnas man chad nas/ /na rag dmyal khams yan chad du/ sprul pa bye ba dpag med 'gyed/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyod kyi 'bor/ /stong phrag brgyad cu khyod kyi bran/ /'dir gshegs brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di/ /khro rngams stabs kyi bzhes su gsol/ /dgra bgegs 'dul phyir mthu ma chung / /rnal 'byor skyong phyir thugs ma ring / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang ma zhan/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul/ /thugs dam dbang gi gshegs su gsol/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor la skyabs ma chung / /'gro ba bsrung cig thugs rje can/ /
bdag gis mchod cing bstod pa'i tshe/ /dkor khang bsrung zhing bar chad sel/ /yon bdag bsrung zhing skyabs pa dang / /rnal 'byor bsam pa sgrub pa dang / /chos skyong thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /bsod nams chen po bskyed pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /gtor ma byin rlabs bka' bsgo bya/ /slob mas maṇḍal yon du 'bul/ /gsang ba snying gi 'bor lo'i rgyud las/ /bka' bsgo bstod cing bskul ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ /de nas dpa' bo he ru gas/ / gsang ba'i snying gi rgyud 'di nyid/ /dur khrod bdag po khyod la gtad/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /dam tshig can la dngos grub byin/ /dam nyams rnams la chad pa chod/ /zhes gsungs te 'khor thams cad yi rangs te/ chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang la gzhugs so/ /gsang ba snying gi 'bor lo'i rgyud las / / yongs su gtad pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ /bla ma bai ro tsa na rakṣa ta la brgyud cing 'jim lo tswa bas bsgyur ba'o/ /
༄khu/ /dpal nag po chen po gsang mgon yab yum gyi lo rgyus bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /byams mgon bla ma ri khrod pa/ /he ru ka bzhin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dpa' bo bran 'khol des bdag la/ /bsod nams chen po'i bskal bar stsol/ /kun gyi thun mong tsam min te/ /rtse mo'i dben gnas nyams dga' bar/ /snying po'i gdams pa zab gnad can/ /snod ldan seng ge'i 'o ma bzhin/ /bka' bsgo phyi bzhin 'brang bar bsngags/ /de slad 'da' dka' rdo rje'i tshig /nus pas rnams gsal gzugs sku yang / /ye shes shugs kyis khar byon nas/ /snyan pa'i grags spel bdag gi dpal/ /phyin chad du yang de 'dra bar/ /dam bzhag nan gyis bka' yig chad/ /ji ltar mthun pa'i grogs mdzad pas dge tshan mang ba'i spro ba skye/ /mthar ni byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dam bzhag rdzas gtad lung bstan phyir/ /bka' babs gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes nye bar bsdus pa'i tshigs bcad kyi
༄tshi/ /don spros nas/ dpal ngam ring byams pa gling gi 'dus pa dang po brgya phrag lnga'i mtshan gyi thog ma'i rgyun ltar/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan de/ skyabs mgon bla ma dam pa 'dis thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs mtha' dag bcad rjes/ bu le gangs kyi ra ba dang mus na sogs ri khrod rnams su bcud len/ dka' spyad dam pa'i sgo nas bsnyen sgrub sogs mthar phyin pa'i tshe/gzhi dgon gyi bsam gtan spyil bur rgyud kyi gleng gzhi ltar/ dpal chen po he ru ka de nyid kyis mdzad pa bzhin du o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gi dur khrod la sogs pa/ gnas yul nyer bzhi'i skyongs ba kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa dpa' bo chen po yab yum gyi zhal dngos su bstan nas khas blangs dam bcas bstan bsrung spyi las khyad par du che ba'i/ bran 'bol du bdag gir mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i 'dzin pa chen po
des rjes su bzung tshul ni/ bdag rang lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i tshe/ thog mar zhal mjal ba'i phyi lo de la mchog grub kyi kā pa la bzang po sbar khyim du son pa/ de'i nang du longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bca' bar bzhed nas nor lha rnam sras kyi sgrub skor cha tshang zhig gnang bar gsol ba btab pas/ jo bo a ti sha o rgyan chen po'i rnam 'phrul dngos kyi phyag gi bgyi bas ngo mtshar du bskrun pa'i mchod rten bzhugs shing / chos sbyin rgya cher mdzad pa'i tshwa sna gtsug lag khang zhes/ skyes mchog du mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas kyi g.yas phyogs spang brag gi steng shes rab khrims ldan gyi tshogs rnams lhan cig par 'dug pa'i dgon par rje btsun 'di'i gzhugs gnas gsar bar yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus bzang po la babs pa'i tshe/ thod chang sogs tshogs mchod dgyes dgur rol ba'i mtshams su bstan bsrung 'di'i lo rgyus zhal gzigs la sogs pa'i che brjod zhib mo sngon chad su gang la mtshan tsam yang bshad pa med la/ ster ba 'phang ba'i chos skyong zhig yin na yang da lam skal ldan las 'phro 'dzoms pa yin pas/ dpal dur khrod gyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba byed pa yin/ 'di khyed la byed dgos pa'i yid ches zhig ma 'gyangs par yong / spyir btang nor lhar longs spyod kyi dngos grub stsal ba la/ rnam sras dang mnyam du chug la khyad par mthu rtsal dang nus stobs rdzu
༄khu/ /'phrul myur mgyogs kyi brtse gdung sgos su 'di che ba zhig yod pa yin/ g.yi la zhes sgrub skor lag ris su shu ba dang / mchod yul zhal thang gcig kyang bri dgos pa'i bslab bya sogs dgyes bzhin du dgos pas dpyad nas bsod nams chen po'i skal bar stsal ba yang shes rlom kun gyi thun mong spyod yul du gyur pa rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa'i cha tsam nges par gzhan gyi rgyas skabs bsre bslad can gyi yig sna gsar bu ji snyed pa de dag gi steng nas thos lo lta bu yang min te/ bde ldan rtse zhes dgon ma mo'i dben gnas kyi gong ga la bar/ 'khon rigs sngags 'chang kun nas dkar pa'i gos bzung can gsum gyi thog ma pa dga' bzhi'i lam las grub pa mchog brnyes gang de'i bka' 'bum du phyi rab bsdus te bzhugs pa snying 'khor gsang ba'i gnad bsdus kyi rgya gzhung dang / paṇa grub lo tswa ba'i gsungs rgyun mang po'i gdams pa zab gnad can mtha' dag gi don mthil phyin du bkrol nas brgyud 'dzin snod ldan gyi bu 'byung ba dang / gzhan du yang gsang bar gdams shing mi nub bstan pa'i btsas su gces spras kyis shig par dpyod ldan dam pa seng ge'i mtshan gyi yig snar bcas pa ngang pa'i rgyal pos chu las 'o ma bsdu ba ltar dril te/ sngon gyi babs so chen po rnams kyi tshul bzhin du khyad par gyis bka' bsgos pa'i tshe kho bos phyi bzhin du lus dang grib ma ltar 'bral ba
med par 'brang bar bsngags shing / de nas ring du ma lon par bris thang grub nas rab tu gnas pa zhu ba'i pho nya rta rkang zhig ched du/ slad kyi bzhugs gnas der btang bas lhag par rab gnas bkra shis kyi me tog char ltar babs/ gtor 'bul gyi dgyes pa bskyed rjes/ sku'i mdun de khar ras nam thang gsar ba gcig la zur sgril du gsol/ ja nag rtse zhus lhag gi khug ma dang mnyams por bcug rjes su brtse ba chen po'i gsung gis/ ye shes sems pa'i dngos su bzhugs nges pa byas yod pas/ de zhal ma 'byed par phyir myur du song / lhong tshad che ba tsam snang yang nyes skyon du mi 'gyur zhes bsgos pas/ rta pa des dgon khrod du skyur srid la cung zad 'gor/ byis pa snga 'gros su rdzongs la ras dril kha ma 'byed zhes nan tan cher bgyis kyang / gling mtshams kyi ri thang mtshams der ltad mo chen po de 'dra yod e yin bsam/ rgyab khur kha bshig nas thang ka mngon 'phral/ rtse zil 'jigs shum tsheg khrol chen po mod la byung nas thang sgril lhag ma nus zer/ sngar bzhin ras la dril khur phyin pa'i rjes/ mig mthong rje nye la rta bas kyang snyegs pho brang chen po'i mdun du slobs 'tshams / rgyab khur na thang ka med par rig nas ras ras dril bshig nas kha phye kyang ja khug las ma byung / ha las de 'phral du phyir log pa'i lam du yang ma rnyed/ slar drung du phyin nas thugs dam brtags pa zhu bar
༄༅/ /gsol bas brtags skud la mdud pa 'dor mi dgos/ da nang lhong tshad che bar 'dug byas par bzhin da skyon med ngas kyang gtor ma zhig 'bul/ ya gir kyang gtor 'bul la brtson pa bskul ma gyis/ zhag gsum khongs su ma 'gyings par dur khrod bdag po rang byon yod gsung gnang 'dug kyang / rtsis che bas blo ma bde bar log chu lho byang sogs skor mtha' dag du rtsad gcod mi btang 'dug pa/ de skabs kho po gang khrod pa chen po'i gnas rdo rje gdan la yod thog gnas tshul gyi yi ge slob byung 'phral lam gtor dang chab gcig tu bka' stsal ba bzhin gtor 'bul rgyas par byas ngam ring su yong / dur khrod wo brang gi bde gsal 'og tu gdan la 'khod pa dang / rtse mthun du bris thang rnyed nas spyan drangs mi slobs pa dang zhal 'dzom ste/ de yang pho nyas bslab bya las 'da' bar brtsam pa'i blun spyod kyi bya ba la chos skyong khros pa ltar gyur kyang / ngo bo phyi bzhin du 'grogs shig par bka' bsgo rdo rje gsung tshig bden grub kyi nus pas dpa' bo chen po dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum rnams gsal 'debs gdos bcas gzugs sku snang ba ba yang / ye shes sems dpa' thugs rjes mngon sum du bzhugs par brtul zhugs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa de nyid/ rnyed tshul de nyid ya ga chos sdings pa'i dge bdun zhig ngam rings nas phyir yong pa/ /de la'i gag ṇi yod sar lham sgrogs grol
bas sgre rings yid yengs pa lta bu'i khams seng ba snyams pa'i had de ba de la/ g.yon phyogs kyi grog nang la rgyang tsam zhugs phyin pa'i phug gad steng na/ thang ka hri le yod pa mthong nas rnyed pa'i dga' spro'i dang / lam la phyir log lung stong du 'khyams 'dug snyams pa'i 'jigs shum pa de'i mu nas brang khang du slebs 'phral/ smig rtse'i mchod gral du bzhag kho rang de nub gral rogs kyis chang la bos/ sang snga bar tshogs la 'tshogs pa'i thog chos khrims pa dang mi snas rtsad bcad 'phral tshogs dkyil der langs nas rnyed tshul rnams dang / kha sang kyang sems 'chos pa 'dra ba des blo yang ma bde/ sngar kha phye ba yang med/ rnyed nyes na rku lags pa'i dpe yin pas/ 'di kha ma yin ri mna' dag 'bul bka' bkyon med pa dgos zer/ rtab rtab po'i sgo nas mi sna khrid/ khyim nang gi mchod gral nas blang chog pa byung zer/ rtsad chod pas der yod kun kyang ngo mtshar du gyur sang snga bar zhabs drung du bsnyags nas phyin pas gzims khang gi sgor dam tshig dang ldan pa'i nye gnas byams tshul pa bris thang spyan 'dren la gnang / mjal ba'i mod la thang ga phyag gis bsdams pa mgor bzhag nas mi la mi lab pa ltar nye bar 'go ba'i bka' bsgos shing / de'i tshe bka' las chos skyong mngon sum las la 'khol nus pa mal lo dang gnyan lo khyung po la sogs pas kyang 'di dang 'di 'dra par sngon byung ji
༄tshi/ /bzhin du/ da lam rdzu'aphrul gyi nam mkhar 'phur khyed rang gi mdun du byon nas 'phrin las bsgrub po zhes gsungs byon pa dang / khyad par med pa yin pas yid ches par gyis gsungs shing dgyes nyams che bar mdzad phyogs der snyan pa'i gtam gyis dur khrod kyi bdag po'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi ngo mtshar grags pa yang gsar du spel bar sgrogs pa'i byed po bzhin gyur pa la/ rje btsun ri khrod pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gsang mgon yid bzhin nor bu 'di la mthil phyin pa'i khungs chod de/ rjes gnang gdams skor bris sku sogs la phyag nas zhu bar gsol ba 'debs mi ji snyed 'du bar 'gyur ba las/ zhu nan gal che 'ga' dang 'ga' la rjes gnang skabs su sku rtsed kyi tshul du nga la chos skyong de 'dra zhig sngar nas yod pa yin te/ kho po'i ming nas phyung ste kho bo la rtsal grub zhes dang / ci rigs la khyed chos skyong dur khrod bdag po zhes pa bris thang 'phur ba'i kha skad go ba de 'dra zhig 'dod par 'dug ste da e yong mi shes/ khyed rang 'di dang 'di 'gab zhes gur zhal phyag drug sogs go bsgyur du mdzad par snang / yang zhi dgon gyi po ta la gong ma na bzhugs skabs zhig dpa' bo yab yum gyi sku dang dam rdzas zhal 'bag sogs rab gnas zhu bar phyin dus/ da phyin 'di 'dra'i rigs kun la khyod rang gis rab gnas byas chog mod chos bdag po la sprad zin/ 'on
kyang rgad po'i lag pa la reg pa la dgyes par 'dug pas gsungs shing dam bzhag dang lhan gcig phyag gi bdar nas kho bor bstod par mdzad/ dur khrod bdag po'i chos bdag tu nyid rang bskos zin pa yin pas gzhan dang mi 'dra yi gsung gnang ba sbyin/ grol mchog zhabs kyi chos lugs byang rtse'i gnas bdag drag shad la yod par gnang ba'i lo rgyus de kun 'phros pa phul bas/ de la dgos pa khyad par can cig yod pa yin mod / gzhan ngam ring gi gnas khang du bde mchog gi chos sgo phye bar bka' phebs dus rjes gnang thengs gcig kyang thob/ bsngags brjod dang thugs rtsis shin tu che/ stag tshan chung ba'i dogs pa med/ gsang rgyud gyi lung rgyun de nges par 'di nas brgyud pa zhig zhus zhes lung bstan pa sogs kyang bdag gi dpal du gyur lags/ ye shes dngos bzhugs nyid ngo mtshar bya lam las nye bar byon pa nas bzung ste/ phyin chad kyang spyir gnas gang dang gang du yang rgyun du bcad rgya dam po kho na brten nas bzhugs pas sgo drung nas sbos sna bas bris thang spyan drangs ba phyag du blangs nas/ ye rang gi 'jigs po ba yin nam gsungs dgyesadagyes ltar mdzad / sku drung der sdod rin nyin par dbu sngas su phud dud che bar 'jog pa dang / phyir yong dus da dur khrod bdag po yang spyan drangs mdzod gsungs / rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'tshams pa skabs sbyar gyis bka' bsgo dam
༄tshi/ /bzhag re nges par ma mnyel ba bka' drin skyong / de 'dra kho na bar dkyus bzhin sgrigs su chug mjal bar phyin res kyi rjes gnang lan re ni/ nges par mi gnang ba mi srid la/ skabs 'gar mchod bshams bcas thog re nas kyang lan du ma brgyud mar gnang ba yang byung / khyad par po ta la gong ma de nyid du thengs gcig dam bzhag mdzad pa dang chabs gcig sku 'phar zhing cung zad g.yo ba/ gzi mdangs chen po dang bcas pa sngar bas kyang ngo mtshar che ba'i nan tan gyi bka' mchid las/ nga rgan po la 'phreng mi dgos phyi bzhin du rgyug gsungs brten la phyag gis bsnun pa'i tshe/ rtse zil chen pos sku zhog der yod kyang phyir khyed khyed byed dgos pa byung bas mtshon pa sogs brjod par dka' zhing / ji ltar stsal pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du gyur pa ni/ thob pa'i mod phyi nub kyi gtor ma 'bul bar mchod g.yog pas phyin pa'i sngon rjes su skas la khrol khrol zer go bar 'bor ba dag gi nyams dang / rmi lam sogs sgo mtshungs par keng rus gar byed rgyu yin 'dug zer ba'i sa lab sogs dang por lhongs dang 'tshubs che ba rim gyis 'dres zab mthun pa'i grogs mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul ji snyed pa byung ba rags tsam las zhib du bris bar ga la lang / de yang sngon du 'di byed dgos pa'i yid ches ma 'gyang bar yong gsungs pa ni/ byang 'brog thag ring gi byes su khrims 'jags po de'i slad 'gro
dgos byung ba la stod hor smad hor pha bde gong 'og sog po cha dkar sogs nye gnas shin tu che ba kun gyi blor mi chud ba lta bu la yang / ya nga bag tsha mi dgos dur khrod bdag po la blos khol la rgyug gsungs/ ngas kyang phrin las bcol gtor ma nang nub tu 'bul gsungs/ de phyin phye phud gsar du bsngags ma phul ba'i rgyun gtor re yang gar bzhugs su 'dzug pa bka' drin bskyangs ba'i mthus/ mdor na dge ba dang mi dge ba'i ltas dang snga rtags mtshan ma dngos su ston pa 'byung ba'i gnod pa las skyobs pa/ nad gdon bar chad bzlog pa/ dngos sprul mang po'i 'phrin las sgrub pa zur tsam yid ches su bsdoms nas bkod pa yin gyi/ spro ba bskyed phyir snyan ngag gi phul sbyar/ byi ba la glang po'i dpes sgro btags pa ni min la/ lo bdun gyi bar der phyogs bgrod ci bgyid mtha' dag gi 'gro dus byin rlabs zhu bar slebs nas bka' drin bsab par phyed kyi mjal ba'i rnam pa kun tu dgyes bzhin pa kho nas rigs las/ rta'i lo chu 'dus phyogs su 'gro dgos shar bas po ta la gsar par bzhugs thog phyin/ shin tu brtse ba'i zhal ta mang po dang sngar bzhin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor steng bris thang khyad par can bkram pa'i gtor bshams rgyas pa la thugs dam bzlas pa yun ring du mdzad pa'i mthar ni/ rjes su gnang ba thun mong ma yin pa dpyis phyin par byang chub snying po'i bar du
༄tshi/ /'bral ba med pa sogs yid ches bskyed nus su byin gyis brlabs/ khyad par du sngon gyi rgyun gtor phab rta can dang po'i mda' dar dang bcas pa 'jug snod chas phyin spyan lam phebs par mdzad nas/ da 'di yang khyer gsugs pa dang lhan cig tu/ bris thang sgril ma dang gtor ma dung mgron dpe phyag zhabs thams cad bdag gi smyi gtsug tu nan gyis bzhag nas/ dam tshig gi sngags kyis mngon par sna drangs te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma padma badzra rtsal zhes sogs rgya bod mkhas grub brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa rim pa'i mtshan nas smos pa sogs dam bzhag pa smyi las khyad par du nga rgan po la 'phreng mi dgos/ rdo rdze slob ma chen po 'di yi phyi bzhin du lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du mchog thun mong gi phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i sdong grogs rgya chen po sangs rgyas dam tshig rjes dran mdzod/ zhes pa dang /a mṛ tas mngon par spags pa'i dngos grub kyi rdzas phyag gis stsal rjes/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum khyed rang gi phyi bzhin mngags pa ltar song yod do/ /zhes dang / gtor ma byin te 'di 'gro phyogs su phul gsungs pa'i bar der/ de gong po ta la gong ma'i rgyun de lta bu'i thugs rjes gzigs byin bskyed pa'i dbang gis/ skabs der zhu rogs gnyis kyang thod la lus/ de nas sku lhod kyis glod par brtsam nas sngar bzhin rigs
brgyud la spel ba dang / gal che dus chos skyong 'di la blo lings kyis kol zhes sogs sngar ltar g.yel ba med pa'i chos bdag tu gnyer gtad lung bstan pa'i tshe/ sku 'khor bas sku snyung ba cung zad ches dogs bslab bya de tsam gyis 'thus pa 'dra lags zhes zhus yin gnang ba'i lan ltar du/ rgad po'i tshe dang chos 'go mthar phyin/ thos bsam bsgom sgrub 'chad nyan gyi khur kyang mi chung ba tsam byas/ de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad grogs dang phrin las ci dgos 'dis ma bslu bar byas pa yin/ da lam khams log mi yong gsungs ba ltar sku shin tu bde nyams dang ldan pa'i rigs las byin rlabs zhus nas sgo phyir yong dus kyang zhal 'dzum dang ldan pas dur khrod bdag po yab yum khyed rang dang 'bral med du song yod do/ /yang yang gsungs zhal dkyil dran pa'i me long la 'phos pa yin par kho bo cag byes lam der yod ring / grub mchog nyid kyi gzugs sku'i sprul pa chos dbyings mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du re zhig bsdus zhes thos la/ ched du smos pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir/ dur khrod kyi bdag po 'di la rang rang gi bka' drin rjes su nod pa ji snyed yod pa rnams dang mi 'dra ba babs so 'di ni/ spyir yang da lta bstan bsrung sngon grags phal cher bdag 'dzin du mdzad pa'i sgrub ched 'di yis cha 'dra las phul phyin du yod pa ma yin gyi/ des na gzu bor spyod pas dpa' bo dur khrod
༄tshi/ /kyi bdag po'i chos bdag gzhan las khyad par du 'phags tshul chos srung snyan pa'i dung sgra chen po srid gsum gang ba mngon par don ldan nyid du sgrogs pa zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shos stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes longs spyod kyi lngang gnas rgya bod tshams kyi trā 'dus chen po dar rtse mdo gangs chu'i 'gram gu ru padma'i e waX lcog sgar du sbyar ba'o/ /
༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa dang mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/
༄tsho/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa dang / mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gam bla med gang rung gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gang zag la/ slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin te/ de'i nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / bsrung 'khor yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas ci nus byas la/ yi dam chos skyong che chung gang gi mchod gtor gyi rjes la/ sngon du 'di'i gtor ma byin rlabs/ yang na sngon la chos skyong bskyed na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐X yig las e chad pa las nam mkhar yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'bor/ raṃ las rakta'i
༄༅/ /rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ keX las keX rus kyi ri rab/ raṃ las nyi ma/ bhrūṃ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang / de'i nang du paṃ padma maṇḍal hūṃX gis padma'i gdan/ ma swārya maṇḍal hūṃX gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal hūṃX gis zla ba'i gdan gnyis su med par gyur/ gdan gyi steng du sa bon a las dung dang mgron bu hūṃX dang āXs mtshan pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba brtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs gar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas g.yon pa'i brla la brten pa'i skyil drung byed pa'i gar stabs kyis
bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'khor bcas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'kha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su med par gyur/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oX / mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang/ u rgyan nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐X/dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pa/ /dad pa dam tshig chen po yis/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi e hya hi/ ambha la sogs pas mchod pas mchod dzaXhūṃX baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes pas dbu brgyan pa la/ ambha sogs kyi mchod rgyal ba'i gzugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /oX badzra sa ma ya stom/ sa ma ya ho/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang / rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis ji ltar bka' bsgos pa dang / dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa bde
༄tshi/ /bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang / sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren tshar gcod pa dang tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcings ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas 'phrin bcol lo/ /gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma sha khrag dang dar dkar po'i cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa nang mchod chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ a mṛ ta'i bsangs/ oX stong pa aXthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūṃX dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur bar mos la/ yab yum gyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar dmigs la/ oX ghri rā dza ghri ra dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ shrī smra sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā bi sha bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces pa gsum mam lngas phul/ nang mchod/ andha mchod dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'bor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /baspra'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ sku ma g.yel/ gsung ma g.yel/ thugs ma g.yel/ rnal 'byor bdag gis brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung
bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par du yang chom rkun ma lus bcings ba dang / bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces 'phrin las bcol lo/ hūm̐X/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun ces pa nas/ dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /kyi bar dang / rnam dkar keX rus dag pa'i gzugs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par/ /gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod yang dag lam la gnyer gnas te/ /lus can bde la 'god mdzad cing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ /phan bde'i kun stsol khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod sgrub khyod mchod na/ /dam bca' ñtsu bzhin nyer dgongs la/ /ji ltar gsol btab ji bzhin du/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bstan bsrung 'khor bcas mchod 'phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bstod de 'phrin las bcol/ 'di'i sngags bzlas par 'dod na/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong lcam dral la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐X dang e la sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkug nas bdag
༄༅/ /la stsol bar bsam mo/ /gzhan yang chom skun la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod par mos nas/ oX ṅgha rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum zas swā hā/ ces ñtsu mang bzlas pa'i mthar mchod gsol btab gong ltar byas la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskong zhing / bris sku la sogs rten yod na de la bstim/ med na badzra muX gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas btab la sogs pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ / athi+-iX maṅga lam/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa bla mo'i ro ca nas gsungs bzhugs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag rnal 'byor ba dag gis/ bdag g.yin bsrung dang bzlog pa dang / /bsod nams spel dang dngos grub ster/ /de dag sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /dur khrod la sogs dben gnas su/ /maṇḍal mi 'gram zer ba rog go/ mchod gtor bshams nas ni/ /dang po rang nyid yi bde mchog bzang dam lha/ /sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ g.yas pas thod dbyug 'bar ba thogs/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gsol/ /'bar ba'i keX rus mche ba gtsig /brkyang bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ bsnyen rtags ma byung bar du bzlas/ rtags gzhan dang
'dra ba las/ mi dkar po dang bon po dkar po sogs 'ong ngo / /bsnyen pa song nas tshar gcig brjod pas bdag bsrung du gsol ba'i gsol ba gdab par bya/ gnyis pa gsum pa las sngags kyi grangs dang bdag ces pa'i gnas su che ge mo bcug pa ma gtogs brgya rtsa'i bar 'dra'o/ /tshar gcig brjod pas bdag nyid bsrung / /tshar gnyis brjod pas gzhan bsrung 'gyur/ /tshar gsum brjod pas grong bsrung gyur/ /tshar bdun rjod pas shes rab 'phel/ /brgya rtsa brjod pas yul 'khor bsrung / /gzhan gyi byad 'di sgrub pa bstan pa kha bzlog bsnyen rjes su pa ni/ /dur khrod thal ro bsregs pa'i thal ba chen blang nas su/ /chos skyong yab yum sku 'di ltar bzo bzhengs nas / / spyan 'dren rab tu gnas par bya/ /brgyad dang bco lnga gnam stong la/ /rme ba mi snyu lha zer ba dang rog me snyu la lha yang zer ba nag pa'i dud pas bdug /rigs sngags sbyor ba ga po'i bzlog ces gsol ba btab/ /de yis rigs sngags ba:rdzog par 'gyur/ /dngos grub myur du sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /brub khung khru gang khrag gis byugs/ /zur gsum nang du mchog phur mi skang gi zas blangs la sra sprin nas mi sngo bar gsum/ /gtsugs pa'i kha la thod pa bzhag / kha zas sna tshogs dag gis bkang / /'bru sna sman sna ras sna brdar/ /mdun dang zur du gzig la ba ling bzhag mi rang gang za ba'i/ dus drug dag du chang phud sogs/ /gtor ma'i bshags pa rta ru bzung / /zhag
༄tsho/ /bdun gag gtor cung zad gnyis 'bul thun drug du'am bzhi bar du smra bcad bya/ /dam tshig bsrung ba mchog du gces/ /sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub blangs/ /zhag bdun lon pa'i nang par ni/ /dpal ldan yab yum gus pa yi/ /tshul gyi dngos grub nas gtor ma'i byas steng drang bar bsam/ /rgyun gtor gcig pa gtsang sar skyal/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po'i las la sbyor ba'i ches/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /sna tshogs 'bru la byas nas su/ /bang mdzod bcug la gsol 'bru'aphel ba btab/ /de'i 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /ratna sna tshogs dag la byas/ /zhing dkyil bcug na lo mthong bas mi sleb sar sprin legs 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /thabs 'og bcug gong zer ba'ang rog na yo lang rang bde g.yos 'du/ /gser dang dngul gyi bris nas su/ /rab gnas byas nas chu ra'i zhabs/ /sbas na zas kyi spyan gzigs 'phel/ /ta la shing gi dag gi 'ordzo ma la/ /dur khrod bdag po'i sku bris la/ /gang gi mgul du btags gyur na/ /gang gi ming bar sar de la thams cad dad skye bo par gyur/ /yab yum sku ratna dag gis sna gis bris/ /rab gnas byas la dbang bar btags yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ /tsan dan gla rtsi dri bzang gis/ /sku bris rab gnas mchod pa bya/ /sgo steng btags na thams cad bsrung / /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /gsum du byas la rab
gnas bya/ /pha la btags shing ma la gcig /bu tshar gcig ni gdags par bya/ /chung sri tshangs shig gsol ba btab/ /sri'u gsos par bya ba'o/ /ras la bris la rab gnas bya/ /bla re byas la gsol ba btab/ /de yi bdag gzhan bar chad bsrung / /gser gyi sku bris mgul du btags/ /de yi rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nang bar tshar bdun yi dam bya/ /de yis shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mdun du chos skyong yab yum bsam la mchod gtor phul nas bdag gi blo rno bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ zhal nas sngags kyi 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas rang gi lte la thim par bsam nas sngags kyi sham bur/ prañdza puṣṭi ku ru a/ zhes yungs dkar dur khrod thal chen bsngags/ /zhing la sogs pa gang la gtor/ /de yi gdug pa'i kha 'ching 'gyur/ /'bu srin sogs btags nas bzlas na shes rab 'phel lo ras bal skud pa dkar po la/ /bsngags la mdud pa nyer gcig bya/ /phyug la btags 'gab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bsrung ba'i man ngag yin/ /lha khang gyo mo sogs la sogs sa blang la/ /gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod/ /phyugs la sogs pa'i lhas la gtor bsrung ba'i ting 'dzin gong bzhin no/ /chom skun 'ching ba'i man ngag yin/ /chu'am gseg ma la sogs la/ gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod/ /bdag dang rdzas la phyogs bcur gtor/ /mdun dang
༄tshi/ /rgyab kyi phyogs re nas/ /lha gnyis gar byed 'gro bar bsam/ /chom rkun 'chings shig gsol ba btab/ /gnas su phyin te ting 'dzin glod/ /de yi 'jigs pa kun las thar/ /rtag tu srog gi snying po bzlas/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /dang po gtor ma dkon mchog la/ /'og tu chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags nyid la ni/ /shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā yi sha tsi ba linta kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun brjod gsol bar bsam/ /shin tu gsang nas sgrub pa na/ /gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /dar dkar dag la bris nas su/ /dmags dpon sku bris nas btags nas thams cad mi gag gyi ma reg par byed gsad ba bya ba gces so dag la btags gyur na/ /des ni dmags rnams bsung bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /mar la byas te sgrom du bcug /thams cad 'bul te gsol ba btab/ /de yis dkar rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ / gzhan yang gsang sngags dag la ni/ /gang 'dod sham bu bsgyur la btags/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi/ /gdams ngag rigs sngags bzlog pa dang / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i man ngag ni/ /bla ma bee ro tsa na'i gdams pa khyad par can no/ /shin tu gsang ba gal che'o/ /maṅga liṃ/ shubhe/ gzhung 'di dang 'dra ba la rtsa ba'i sngags oX ghri rangs ghri rangs/ ku ma ku ma khum dris swā hā/ ces zer ba 'dug pas zhu dag
༄7/ /o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /rtsa ba las bzhi lhun grub bzhugs/
