༄tshi/ /mngon par brtan pa lhun po'i dpal ji lta/ /ji snyed las rab kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /legs par bshad pa'i man ngag rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /mun sel nyi zlas sked skabs brgyan pa'i brten/ /de yang rgyud las / 'di nyid sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gnas dag gam/ /zhes pa nas/ dngos grub blang phyir thod par bkang / / zhes dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i sgrub chen gyis tshul la 'jug par 'dod pa'i thabs/ dam tshig dang ldan pa dag gis gang du bya ba'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ sngon byon paṇa grub la sogs pa gong ma rnams kyis nges par bzung ba'am/ rang bzhin gyi chags pa ngo bo bam ro gsar rnying dur du 'debs pa dang / gtub sreg la sogs pa'i bya ba rgyun mi chad byed pa ni/ dur khrod ste bdag po'i blo rab kyi de dag gam/
༄༅/ /yang na las dang po bas gtso bor gyur pas lha rten la sogs pa yang rab tu gnas pa nges par chags shing / da lta yang mchod pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs kyis shugs las bstan zhing / rgyud ldan gyi phyag len mdzad pa'i yongs su grags pa'i mgon khang ni/ de yang bzhengs thabs kyi man ngag dang ldan dgos pas/ rdo rje gdan nam ri bo rtse lnga chu bo gaṅgā byang chub kyi shong / chos 'khor lha sa/ dpal gyi bsam yas/ mdor na dkar nag rgya dang bod la sogs gnas chen dang dur khrod bkra bzang zhing byin rlabs chags pa rnams kyi sa rdo chu shing gis mtshon pas gzhan yang chos skyong smyi dang 'di nyid mngon par brten pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la sogs pa'i sgrub gnas nas rnam grangs gang 'dzoms du bsags pa rgyur bsreg pa'i gzhir sdod du brtsigs pa'am/ yang na gur yol ba bla bres su
bcas pa rang gang 'dod kyi bshams chog pa'i mgon khang 'di ni gong ma gnyis skabs su yang rang nyid grub rdzas dang bcas pa gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i zur mchod dben pa'i gnas su khul mchod byed pa la med mi rung dmigs gsal du gyur pas na/ dbyibs dang bris bkod gur khang gi nang du bkram bde ba'i dkyil 'dzin gyi khyon du bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa/ de las gzhan pa'i nub phyogs dpal o rgyan gyi zhing bkod dur khrod dang bcas pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gnas yul dur khrod sogs phyogs mtshams dang 'brel chags g.yas 'gyed g.yon 'gyed bla re zhing lpags dang lha gnas nyi zla gzhan yang snod bcud spyi 'gro mchod rdzas bskang rdzas kyi rim pa dang / 'brel chag la nyams dga' zhing byin che ba'i tpū nang gi rgyan dang bcas pa dngos 'drar byas pa'i sgrub po dang zhal sprod dam/ g.yon phyogs su maṇḍal rgyar mda' gang pa ste/phyogs rer mtho bzhi dang ldan pa'i dpangs su mtho do pa gru bzhi'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du rgya phyed ni mtho do ste rgyar de lta ba nyid dbyibs zlum po dpangs su mtho gang pa'i dbus rgyar dpangs tshad de lta'i dbyibs zur gsum pa rnams rim brtsegs su brtsigs pa'i steng ma'i dkyil du gru gsum mtho gang dpangs su rgya byed sor bzhi yod pa'i thugs rngams sor re mthil dang 'khor yug tu yod par bzhag la nang cha snyoms su 'bru bar bya
༄༅/ /rgyu ri dpyad bzang po'am/ bkra shis yul nas blangs pa'i bzang mnyen 'dzoms pa'i 'jim pa dkar po dag gam/ shing la bcos pa khod snyoms la kha dog dkar 'jam gyis gzhir byung ba'i gdan khri'i logs la bkra shis rtag brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun/ de'i steng leb la/ 'khor lor me tog padma dkar po zlum tshigs kyis bskor ba'i steng gi lebs la bsnyen pa'i dus dbus su chos 'byung gi rgya zlum bskor lte ba dang / phyogs mtshams sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ yab yum gyi rten dung mgron gnyis zhal sprod du bris pa'i dkyil shog mtshams gnyis dang / phyi padma 'dab brgyad bcu ru 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu chung ngu re bkod par bya ba/ sgrub pa'i skabs mdun dang g.yas g.yon gsum du rang byung du byung ba ltar dmar pos zla gam ris su bcad pa dang / brub khung gi kha mtshams phan tshun re khas bcad pa'i bar la me ri chos 'byung mthing nag du byung ba'i nang la g.yul lam mtshon du bsad pa'i mi rta'i khrag gi rgyun bsres pa'i mthil du khrag mtsho'i ri mo dang kun du yang chag chag gi rnam pa yang cung zad btab par bya ba ni/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig tu dril ba'i zhi rgyas dbang drag 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi don dang ldan pa'i bca' gzhi'o/ /der bkod par bya ba'i chos 'byung gi zur gsum ni/ mchog ni mi ste skyes pa g.yul lam btsan thabs su bsad pa la sogs pa'i
rkang lag nya bzhi'i rten gyi rus thur la phur bar bshad pas/ rkang gi ring pa cha snyoms pa re re btsugs pa'i khar gdung 'gel la/ de bzhin du lag phur gsum bsnol mar bkal ba'i khri'i steng du mi las byung bas rin chen mchog tu gyur pa thod pa kha dog dkar la dum bu yang gcig par nges la gzhan yang bu ga la sogs pa brtag thabs las byung ba'i bzang po'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i kā pa la/ de yang rgyun gyi dam rdzas su ma nyams pa zhig nges par dgos pa kha khyer dang nang brlan gsher gyis mi gnod pa'i phyir/ rab gser dngul lta bu'i thod bzo bzhin gyi 'phrul ma'am/ ma 'dzoms na spra tshil mar gyis byug pa'i nang du chang bu can gyi dpal gtor bshams pa la/ dmar rgyan gyi khyad par ri bong ni shin tu dkar ba la blo ldan zhes bzang bar grags shing / lug dang g.yag rgod ri klungs su bdag med par rgyu ba'i 'brong/ /de dag rang lkaṃ min pa gsad sha bsngags pa la/ 'o ma zho mar steng dkar gsum kyang dngos sam gong ma gnyis khan ltar snying por bsdus pa shing las rang byung tu byung ba'i lo tog ni/ kha sur kriṣṭha sa ru sha ka/ ko nyon tsa/ yongs grags kham ltar laṃ sogs kha zas su 'os pa'i bzang la ro gda' pa ci tsam 'byor pa/ 'bru yang nas 'bras 'gro sran til nyung dkar nag la sogs pa sna tshogs mdor na lha'i zhal zas ltar yid du 'ong zhing / kha ba mngar skyur tsha ba rtsub
༄tsho/ /lan tsha sogs lhan skyes rang byung sbyar g.yos ji snyed yod do cog ma lus pa mtha' dag gi rgyu dang rgyan bkod du bgyis pas phyur bur gang ba nyid du bkang zhing / rin chen ni rgyas par dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor bsdus kha dog rigs dang sbyar ba'i mchog 'bring dman pa'i rim pa/ badzra hi ri/ inda ni la/ ke ke sa padma rā ga ma ra te ga ste dngas ma'i rang bzhin las byung ba dang / gser g.yu mu tig byu ru shel zhes spyir 'gror grags pa dang / lcags sna lnga la sogs pa dang chu shing gi dbye ba las byung ba'i dar dang gos la/ gser dngul gyi khyad par du byas pa'i zab chen ka sho ka dang / ras phal la sogs tshos mdog gi so sor bsgyur ba/ stag ni dkar gtsang dang dmar ser gyi gzhi'i steng nag po'i ri mo can/ gzig nag gtsang dang smug ser gi khar thig yod pa dang / sogs khongs su bsdus pa gung zhes lcags sgrogs gi ri mo can/ dom dkar dom nag sprel g.yi dang mtsha' mos ste/ mdor na gcan gzan spu sdug grwa 'dzum mdangs legs kyi rigs khyad par 'gro ba mi rnams kyis bdag gir byed pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i nor gyi rnam pa sna tshogs ma tshang ba med pa ltar bshams nas/ spyan gzigs dkor rdzas su yang 'bul ba dang / gnad dang ldan pas de rnams nas phud du bsdus pa la dngos grub blangs bar bya ba'i phyir/ rten gyi gtor ma'i rgyu dang snying por
'jug pa rgyan bkod du bya ba phung por spungs pa ltar ci mdzes su bshams pa ni thod pa bkang ba'i don no/ / gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gnas dang bca' gzhi'i dgongs don nges par gsal byed bsnyen sgrub kun gyi rtsa ba 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub zhes bya ba/ rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po sdes/ mdo khams byang gi rgyud/ 'dzing rnam rgyal gyi dbus/ gu ru padma'i e waṃ lco sgar du he ru rdzing rnam rgya la gyi dbus su gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / rmya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /sna tshogasag bi shwa'i nyam/sa yigabyed pa'i nyams yig bzhugs/dpal 'byor 'dod dgu yid la rtsol ba'i lha/ he ru ka nyid keX rus gar mdzad tshul/ /rnam sprul khams gsum zil gnon yid bzhin nor/ /gnyis med bstan bsrung dbang por phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dag 'di nyid sgrub par 'dod rnams kyis rten cing 'grel byed du 'byung ba phyi nang gsang ba'i sku rten gsum/ nges pa nyid du med mi rung ste/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po gsang ba snying gi 'khor los rgyud las/ de steng dur khrod bdag po ni rab ni rin chen lnga la bya/ /'bring ni ba so rus pa la/ /tha ma sa la rin chen brdar/ /zhes pas/ bsnyen bsgrub kyi skabs su bstan pa'i rten gtor gyi steng du gsang mgon yid bzhin nor bu yul gnas dur khrod
༄༅/ /kun skyong gi bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i rnam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bkod par bya ba'i rgyu'i khyad par rab kyai mchog ni/ lha dang glu dang mi'i rgyal po rnams kyi rgyan du mngon par bsngags pa kha dog rigs kyi dbye ba'i dwangs ma dang cha mthun rnying pa zhes brda' chad du bzhag pa ji snyed dang / nye bar bsdu na gser g.yu mu tig byu ru shel te rin chen zhes yongs su grags shing / yang gser dngul zangs lcags te ti tsha ste zhu ba'i khams las byung bar grags pa lnga lta bu sogs ji tsam 'byor pa mngon par 'dus pa las bsgrub par bya ba'i don no/ /'bring ni ba mchog glang po che pho mo'i mche ba dang / de bzhin nya bo che dang mi la sogs pa'i so rnams ni dwangs ma ste/ de las gzhan pa snyigs ma'i rigs mtha' dag las 'dir 'os pa mi dang ma he glang po rta la sogs pa'i thod pa dang / brla rkang rgyan drug gi rgyu ru bsngags pa cha dang mthun zhing / yab yum dngos la rta dang g.yag rgod lta bu'i mtshon pas/ dgra gshed du 'gyur pa dang / mer bsregs pa'i nyams pa can spangs nas/ nya phyis la sogs pa'i rus pa ji ltar 'tshams pa de dag kyang mkhregs shing 'jam mnyen gas grub med pa dkar ba'i gzhi las mdangs 'phro 'od ba'i bzang po nyid gtso bor bzung la/ tha ma khang pa yang rang bzhin gyi nag nag dang / phung shul 'dre can sngar longs spyod pa sogs ma yin pa las/ sa phyogs bzang zhing
dbyibs legs gzi byin che ba'i khyon las/ kha dog dkar dmar ba bzo'i rgyur 'os pa las sra bar gyur pa zhig la bya ste/ de rnams la ji ltar bzhengs tshul ni/ dman par gsungs pa'i khams la bsgrub na yang rin po che brdar ba'i phye ma btab ste bsres pa'i nges pa de'i rigs pas yongs su dpag nas mchog 'bring dman par bshad pa'i rgyu tshogs de thams cad ji tsam 'byor pa legs par 'bad pas sngon du btsal te/ bzhengs pa'i dus kyi khyad par yang rgyud las/ yar ngo'i skar ma rgyal la ni/ snga dro dang po'i dus su bya/ zhes pa lo gsar rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar ngo res gza' phur bu lhan gcig pa'am/ gza' zla ba dang lhag pa gang rung gi yar ngo de bzhin nam/ phur bu dben kyang dkar phyogs kyi tshes grangs kyi tha skar thig le nas grangs ba'i 'grangs yig bdun pa shar ba'i skar ma rgyal la longs spyod pa'i nam langs stag gi dus tshod ni snga dro nyi thun gyi dang po ste de nas dbu btsugs/ phyi nyin la sogs par yang sngar bzhin dang po'i dus de nas las kyi mgo nges par brtsams/ phal cher grub zin na yang 'phro can gyi rnam pa rten 'brel mtshon pa tsam zhig bzhag pa'i ring der bzo rigs lag cha'i bsrung ba dang lhan cig par tshags bya/ dang por tshugs ston spyan dbye dang mjug tu dga' ston gyi rim pas rig byed mkhan dga' ston gyi mgu bar byed dgos la/ bzod yar ngo la rgyu skar bab byung
༄tshi/ /ba'i tshe sngar ltar thun dang por las kyi 'phro yongs su legs par grub pa de la/ rab gnas zhal gso dang po gang rung gcig gi zhag sgrub te/ 'bring mtha'i skabs mchod gtor gang zin du 'bul/ thun drug gi dngos gzhi rtsa sngags kyi sham du sbyar ba brgya rtsa re bzlas pa'i ring rten sku la ba dam zhes brda tshig tu gab pa gu gul nag po'i 'dug pa rgyun mi chad pa phul ba'i mthar/ dpal ldan mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po sha za chen po yab yum sprul ba rang 'dra keX rus kyi gzug can las kyi gar mdzad pho mo'i sku las me rlung gi 'tshubs ma 'gyed pa bye ba dpag med/ 'khor lha ma srin sde brgyad sbas pa'i gzugs can dbugs len gyi bshan pa ro langs dang 'byung po phra men bran g.yog bgegs rigs nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang khyab par 'phur zhing lding la 'phyo zhing rgyug pa stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thams cad kyang dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha la dga' zhing khrag la rngams pa rus mur rkang ldag lha ba 'jib pa don snying dmar po la spar shad du 'debs par byed pa khyed rnams kyis sngon dpal chen po khrag 'thung he ru ka khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad chen po yab yum gyi spyan sngar rigs sngags bzlog pa'i mthu bo che zhal gyis bzhes shing / rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon padma badzra rtsal la sogs pa rgya gar gyi paṇa grub bsgyur mdzad kyi zhus chen
khams pa sga lo tsā ba la sogs pa bod kyi sngags 'chang rim par brgyud byin rlabs rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i mthar thug de rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po la ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid 'khor slob sbyin bdag mi nor dgon gnas su bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar sems pa ban bon sngags pa che ge mo yul ga ge mo nas ming che ge mo zhes bya ba'i mthu dang dmod pa rdzas sngags kyi nus pa dang / mdor na byad kha rbod gtong rbad 'dre'i sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad dam nyams byed pa po kho rang gi steng du bsgyur cig bzlog cig bhyoXbhyoX bzlog bzlog zhes dmod pa dang thal mo lan bdun nam gsum gdab po/ /thun mongs ma yin bsad bzlog sbrags mar byed na/ pha rol bzas pa po de'i liṅga dpe'u ris ltar rtse sor bzhi pa'i snying gar nni la ming / dpral bar rus/ brla la bla rtags bkod pa'i gzhi mya ngan gyi rnam pa can gyi mtha' la rtsa ba drag sngags kyi sham bur bcas pa'i yig mgo phyir bstan du bskor ba bsangs sbyangs byug 'gug dbye bdug rdzogs par byas zin nas mi pho mo tshad rims kyi nad drag pos shi shul la sogs pa'i phung sa'i rgyu las byas pa'i brub khung rgyar logs gsum la 'khyud re dang / dpangs su de'i phyed gung sor bzhi pa nang mi rta la sogs pa'i khrag la dug phye bsres pa dang / phyi dur sol sbyar bas nag por byug pa drag po'i shing la byas pa'i rtsang dug khrag gis
༄tsho/ /byug pa nyer cig srin mo'i 'gros su bskor ba'i nang du gong gi liṅga gan rkyal du gzhugs par bya/ de'i steng du tshwa tshwa rab gnas dang ldan pa snag mos byug pa'i pad gdan nas zhabs zang thal du gri lcags sam smyug sbugs kyi thun lam gtsug pas nag pos kha khebs su mnan nas rgyun bzlog gi skabs su sabastan pa ltar/ dkyil 'khosar sogs bca' gzhi dang 'brel nges par can gyi tshes la dbu brtsams nas/ thun drug tu bcad pa'i dang po nam langs nas bzung nyung dkar thal chen ra gad ma la sogs pa'i dug sna dang / khrag sna mi rta khyi gsum de dag sbal pa thun snod thod pa mtshan ngan du bsags pa la rtsa ba'i sngags kyi tatya thā dor nas dang por mgo drangs ste/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ de'i zhabs la sde brgyad dug sngags a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ byad ma ban bon sngags pa che ge mo'i rig sngags bzlog bzlog mā ra ya rbad/ zhes bzlog bsad kyi mtha' can sbyar bas nyin gung nyi myur mtshan gung tho rangs dus bzhir sngags shing thun gyis brab cing dmod mo thal brdab bya'o/ / lhe/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' kro che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /rten gsum bzhengs thabs lag len bzhugs/ rgyud las/ gzhan gyi rigs sngags bzlog pa ni/ /zhes pa nas/ dus bzhir thun gyis brab par bya/ /rigs sngags
bzlog par the tshom med/ /yab yum zhal ni dgra phyogs bstan/ /liṅga dug shing tsher mas bsregs/ /thal ba dam nyams phyogs su gtor/ /zhes pas gzhan gyi rig sngags la sogs pa'i byad kha dang / rbod gtong gi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phyir bzlog pa rgya mtsho rnam par g.yo ba'i rba rlabs zhes bya/ 'di nyid nyams su blangs pa la/ don gsum ste sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ gnyen po brten bya chos skyong gi ru pa bzhengs pa dang / de nyid rab tu gnas pa sgrub pa'i mnga' gsol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ khams sa bzang po'i gzhi la rin chen phye ma dang khyad par bla ma brgyud pa las byung ba'am 'on te sngags pa dam ldan nus pa can dang / rtag par bzhugs zhes pa'i dur khrod las byung ba dang / gri ro btsan thabs su bsregs pa'i thal chen rnams bsres pa'i rgyu 'jim pa dag la mthu chen dpa' bo yab yum gyi sku thun mongs ma yin pa'i rgyud don gsal byed legs par bshad pa'i man ngag las bzhengs tshul bi shwa'i nyams yig tu bstan pa ltar byas pa la/ gnyis pa ye shes sems dpa' dgug bstim rab gnas gyi cho ga yang rgya mtsho las byung ba rang bzhin lhun grub ltar gyi nas/ mchod bstod mnga' 'bul gyi mtsham sbyor man ngag rdo rje'i srad bu bzhin du bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i skabs der khyad par gyi phrin las bcol ba/ mthu chen dpa' bo'i rten sku 'di nyid gang du bzhugs
༄tshi/ /shing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus pha rol rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba la sogs pa'i mthu dang / byad kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsad mnan bskrad dbye rmongs rengs sel gyi nus pa thams cad dam nyams byed pa po kho rang gi steng du bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /zhes thun drug du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la 'ang gsum ste/ thun mongs rgyun bzlog tu bya ba/ thun mongs ma yin pa ban grwa nang 'gras la bsad bzlog sbrags par sgrub pa/ cha lag phur ba dang liṅga brub khung bca' tshul dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni sku dngos grub blangs don du spyan drangs la/ maṇḍal las bzhi lhun grub kyi dbus rten gtor dbal zur dod pa sha khrag kho nas rgyan zhing byugs pa'i drag por bshams pa'i mthu chen dpa' bo bzhugs su gsol ba'i mgo rtags 'dzin dang mchod gtor gyi mthar mchog chen gyi lag ngar rus pa las phur ba sor brgyad pa bcu phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og gnyis shar nub mdun rgyab du bskor la bkod/ rab gyi tshes brgyad nya dang stong chen la las kyi dbu brtsam pa dang mtha' gtad de thun drug du bcad nas zhag bdun phrag tu longs pa'i nyer gcig gam 'bring gsum ga'i nyin zhag phrug re re'am/ tha mas dus der dbu brtsam ste/ slar yang nan tan gyi dus tshes gza' skar byed sbyor khyad par dus sbyor tarka bzang po 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ ye shes bzhugs pa'i thabs
rgyas par bya'o/ de yang dbyibs ji ltar byed na/ rgyud las/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ zhes pa nas/ brkyang skums gar gyis legs par gnas/ /zhes pas/ yab yum mngon rtogs mong thun bar/ sbas don du bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ston byed rgyud de nyid kyi bstod bskul skabs las kyang / gnyis med shes rab yum chen mo/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /brkyang bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ dpal ldan chos skyong lhan skyes dngos nyams dang ldan pa'i bzhad zhal gcig kho na pa la/ spyan gsum rjes chags dbang po'i mthong byed gsal zhing / phyag sor sen mos mngon par mdzes pa/ gnyis ga'ang phan tshun mnyen lcugs gis 'khyud cing sha tshugs kyis slad pa'i rnam pa dor cing / sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags 'gying dang ldan pa'i dbu la nor bu rin po che'i dbyibs kha dog sna tshogs pa'i ci mdzes dang thod pa skam po lnga yi ni dpa' bo'i cod paṇa zhes grags pa ltar brgyan pa'o/ /brgya phyed de lnga bcu'i grangs kyis mgo phreng dang / rin chen phreng du bstar ba'i do shal dang /gzhan yang snyan cha mgur chu phyag zhabs kyi gdub bu sogs ci mdzes su rgyan pas keng rus khrol ba/ gzi brjid 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis bkod pa mi sgrib pa la/ tshems kyang rnyil gyis ma sbags pas cung zad ring zhing /
༄༅/ /mche ba babazhi bzhi rtse mo rab tu rno ba dgod bzhad kyi tshul tsam du gartsigs pas rngam pa/ phyag mtshan g.yas gnyis thod dbyug la 'bar ba ltar g.yo ba'i dar dpyang kyis mdzes pa steng phyogs su 'phyar stabs su sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas bsnams shing / phyag mtshan gaskurdzon pa gnyis thod pa khrag gi gang ba zhal du gsol ba'i dbyibs su 'dzin pas 'khyud tshul/ gnyis ga'i zhabs 'di gab pa 'dra/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs kyi dpe na g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs kho na yin g.yas brkyangs stabs rkang sor sen mos gdan khar stan zhing / g.yon gnyis cung zad bskum nas gar byed gdug pa 'dul mdzad stabs su 'khril sbyor can/ thabs shes rnam pa phra sbom bong tshod shan phyed par nges pa ni/ khrag mtsho'i dbus sna tshogs padma dang nyi zla'i dkyil 'bor rim par brtsegs pa'i steng mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan la me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil na phyi thod pa keX rus rin chen las grub pas gur khang tsam du mdor bsdu ba'am/ mngon par dad pas spros te bzhengs na/ 'og gzhi 'byung ba rim brtsegs rten gzhal yas khang phyi snod za ma tog tu bcas pa/ so sor dngos dang dngos 'dra gang la gang 'tshams su bkod pa/ rig byed mkhan yang smin byed kyi rgyud sbyangs shing khyad par 'di'i rjes su gnang ba nges par thob pas/ zhib mo'i blos ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa lta bu rgyu tshogs rnams grangs tshang zhing bzang ba las
gtor steng du bzhugs dgos pa'i don gyi dran pa yid la bzhag ste/ bkod pa bde ba'i chung legs mdzes bkra/ sngags 'chang sgrub pa po rang nyid kyang yid 'gro nges par byas pas dam can kyang rten la rang bzhin ye shes kyis gzigs pa gcig char 'jug pa dang / phyag tshad dang ldan pas rab tu gnas pa lhun grub du 'gyur par don gyis go bas na brkos su bgyi ba'am/ brdung ma'i lugs sogs gang ltar byed kyang tshul des shes par 'gyur ba gsang ba'i sku rten gyi man ngag go /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud las/ sna tshogs 'bru dang rin chen brdar/ /zhes pa nas nang gi rten du bzung bar bya/ zhes pas/ rgyu'i khyad par nas 'bras gro khre rgya sran la sogs pa kha dkar ba gtso bor gyur pa sna tshogs pa'i 'bru las gzhi blangs/ bye brag rnam grangs ci 'dzoms pa sngon du 'byor tshad bsags pa mtha' dag sad dang ser bas ma snad pa gza' skar 'grub sbyor 'dzoms pa'i dus der ngar btags su byas pa'i phye ma la rin chen sna tshogs brdar ba/ ga bur dang dza ti li sho ka ko la suṅgāl cu gang gur gum ste bzang po drug de ltar sman sna bdun lhan cig chu gtsang la sbyar ba'i khu ba de yis bsgrub pa las/dus tshod gza' skar bzhengs tshul dbyibs la sogs mtha' dag sngar rten gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i sku de la 'dir khyad par du byas ba rin chen 'brus sman du sbyar ba'i lde gus khu ba dri bzang
༄tshi/ /bdun pa'i chur dwangs sings ngad dang ldan pa'i tshon gdan la cung zad bsres pa byug tshon gsol spyan dbye rab tu gnas pa'i bar mthar phyin du byas la/ sgrub pa'i mnga' dbul/ gzi byin bskyed nas nang gi rten du bsgrub nas gnas gyi khang pa'am bang mdzod du bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bzung bar bya ba'i nges pa can te rgyun gyi gtor mas mchod pa'i yul nyid du'o/ /de ltar gsang ba dang nang rten rnam pa gnyis kyi thugs gar srog gzungs bla rdo rin chen gnyis dang bcas pa gzhug pa ni med mi rung ba'i phyir/ de'i lag len man ngag las 'byung ba chos skyong gzhan du mi 'byams zhing khu ldog 'da' la sogs pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung zhing 'gyur ba med par lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i gnad snying nang gi khrag lta bu 'dir gces pa bla ma dam pa'i zhal las shes par gyis shog gsum pa ni/ rgyud las/ dur khrod ras la sku bris te/ /phyi rten dam tshig lus la bcangs/ /zhes pas/ dur khrod kyi ro la bcings pa'i ras bri gzhir rung ba'i dkar po la/ yar ngo rgyal gyi snga dro dang po nas bzung / ras 'dul gyi cho ga sogs bgyis/ 'khor yug 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang yab yum sku dang rgyan bkod rnams rgyud don sgrub thabs mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin skya ris btab pa'i gtso po'i thugs gar dam rdzas dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i chus rtsa sngags phreng gcig gam/ /yig
mgo phyir bstan du dbu phyogs dang mthun par sbrul 'khyil ba lta bur gzungs bkod/ tshon legs par bkye/ rten gyi bya ba yongs su rdzogs nas rab tu gnas pa yang nang gsang gnyis dang mtshungs par bya ba'i bris thang la nye bar bsnyen te phyi rten rgyun du mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa po'i lus la za ma tog gi dar dkar gyis dril nas khyad par kyi rten dang lhan cig tu snying mi 'gyur ba'i don dang sbyar zhing bcangs/ dus dus su mchod la dngos grub zhu/ gnad kyi man ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes su go /rten gsum bzhengs thabs lag len sna tshogs byed pa'i nyams yig zhes bya ba/ rigs sngags 'chang dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po sdes/rgya bod mtshams kyi tshong 'dus chen po dar rtse mdo'i gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcog sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / bkra shis/ mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las khyad rten nyi zla skar gsum bzhugs/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor 'o'i rgyud las/ dar dkar dag la sngags bris la/ /bu med zhes pa nas/ dngos grub gang 'dod gsol ba btab/ /de ni mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rten/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don lag len du bgyi ba ni/ rgya dar dkar ba ci srab dag dri nags med pa zar ma'i dwangs ma'i dam rtsi byugs ba kyang ur byas pa'i gzhi la/ gser sbyangs kyi khu bas bri
༄tshi/ /bar bshad pa'i sngags ni/ rgyud las/ de nas dpal chen he ru gas/ /lags so dur khrod bdag po khyod/ /srog gi snying po bdag la phul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / tarya thā/ oX ghri rā dza swā hā: zhes 'dod gsol du phul ba'i 'bru gsum dor te/ oX nas swā hā'i bar yi ke dbu can 'phreng gcig tu bris pa dang / bud med kyi lag pa la sogs pas nges par ma reg pa'i gser rang byung sa le sbram sra mo sregs gtsub bzo brdar gyis ma gnod pa la so sor hūm̐X dang e zhes 'bru re re bris pa dang / yig mgo phyogs mthun sa bon dang oX yig zhal sbyar g.yas bskor du gser la dkris pa'i steng dar skud dkar pos bcings/ mdun dang steng gi mtshan ma nges par byas te/ rgyud las/ thugs gar hūm̐X e sngags kyis bskor ces so/ /de nas hūm̐X yig can dung dang de'i gcig shos gnyis zhes pa mgron bur e yig can te/ thabs rten gyi 'bud dung gi rig kha stod phyogs dbur bya ba dang / shes rab gyi rdzas kyang rgyan du 'dogs pa'i tshe mig 'bugs pa phyogs la zhabs su nges par bzung ba gnyis ga'i gshog pa'i nang du g.yas g.yon sa bon kha sbyor du yongs tshul gyi dran pa yid la bzhag nas dkar gyis dril la bcug dung mgron gnyis kyang so sor dar dkar gyi na bza' gsol nas de'i zhes pa gsang brten thugs gar bzhugs par bya ba ji ltar ba nyid 'dra bar bya ba nang rten la yang mtshungs
chab gcig ni gtor stengs su bsnyen sgrub skabs bkod pa dang / dung mgron gnyis nang sgrigs pa'i tshe sa bon yi ge gdong sbyor don yab yum zhal sbyor gyi dbyibs su rgyun du rnal 'byor ba'i lus phyi rten lhan cig snying ltar gces spras su 'chang bar bya ba'i thad du dngos grub bskul tshig rim par/ kye kyeX dpa' bo dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ye shes sems/ /gsang ba'i rten 'dir brtan bzhugs la/ /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dang / kye kyeX dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi/ /shes rab yum chen ye shes sems/ /tshig lhag ma gnyis gong ltar dang / yang kye kyeX dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po yi/ /sha za chen po'i ye shes sems/ / nang rten 'dir ni brtan bzhugs nas/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / kye kyeX gnyis med yum chen dur khrod bdag /sha za chen: nang rten: dngos grub: zhes so/ / yang kyaiXho/ dpal ldan chos skyong dur khrod bdag /dpa' bo yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ / rten 'dir 'gyur med brtan bzhugs la/ /yid la ci 'dod gsol btab bzhin/ / mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol/ /zhes dang kyaiXhoX dpal ldan: gnyis med shes rab yum chen nyid/ rten 'dir: yid la: mchog: zhes 'di dag gi dpe mtshon par so sor yid la gang 'dod gsol ba btab pa slad nas bgyi ba'i tshe na yang / 'dir
༄༅/ /'brel byed du 'gyur pa'i don gyis 'thus che la yig tshogs nyung ba'i 'jug sla ba yang / gong bzhin dar la gser gyi gzab chung legs dag bris te/ bla lda'i 'og rnams su dung mgron cha gsum ma nor ba so sor bzhugs de dag ni gsang 'khor rgyud las srog gi yang tig mi 'gyur ba bla rdo la bcings pa'i gdams pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i man ngag lag len du nges pa gsal byed khyad par gyi rten nyi zla skar gsum zhes bya ba sngon chad kun gyi rtogs byar ma gyur pa bla ma dam pa rje btsun ri khrod pa chen po'i brtse bas rjes su bzung ba'i mthu las bsrungs ma'i dbang po'i gnang ba nye bar thob nas/ rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes byang phyogs sna yul chu bo gser ldan 'gram gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las 'dod yon gaṅgā'i chu rgyun bzhugs/ /rgyud las/ gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya/ /de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /zhes pas/ bsham tshul gtor mas bgyi ba gtso che ba'i don gyis/ /rang nyid rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gang byed dang 'brel ba'i don bla ma dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron gnas la dmigs pa/ 'di yi g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi phyogs su'am/ nye bar bsdu na/ phud las bcad pa'i lha bshos gsum gcig gang rung
phyi mchod dang bcas pa/ steng gi char rten gyi drung du 'phreng du dngar la bkod par bya/ de'i 'og gam rjes su chos skyo gi sku la sogs pa'i mdun mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa bsrung ma'i dbang po dur khrod gnas kyi bdag po yab yum mchod pa'i gtor ma ni yig chung du bstan pa ltar mngon par bshams nas/ rgyud las/ mdun du bsam pa'i don gyi snying po bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X yig las e chad pas sogs nas/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pas bskor ba'i dbus zhes sogs/ rnam par badzra sa mā dzaX shri u ḍi ya na sogs/ dur khrod gnas kyi bdag po che/ /yid bzhin nor bu yab yum 'khor/ /bran bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /shri sma sha na a rnghi pa dhi e hya dzaXhūm̐X peṃ hoX ambha/ pa hūm̐/ pulgo dhu pe/ a lo ma ghandhe/ nai we te/ shasta āXhūm̐X / zhes mchod/ hūm̐X/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /bsrung phyir dpal chen he ru ga'i/ /rnam sprul keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /yab yum 'khor bran bcas la bstod/ /oX āXhūm̐X hoX stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa ye shes kyi bdud brtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa yab yum gyis gsol bas dgyes par bsam la/ dbul ba'i thabs ni/ rgyud las/ rtsa ba'i sngags la dur khrod kyi/ /sha za bdag po
༄tshi/ /yab yum sbyar/ /i dam ba liX ta kha hi/ zhes pa lan bdun dag gi dbul/ /gsol nas 'phrin las ci bsgo byed/ /zhes pas/ lag gnyis pad bskor dang bcas rtsa ba'i sngags/ oX ghri ra dza ghri ra dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā'i mjug la shrī sma sha na a ti ma hā pi sha tsi/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum khyed/ zhes dmigs gsal sngags kyi 'brel tshul rgya skad du sbyar ba la i dam ni 'di ltar zhes pa'i don/ thal mo kha che ba'i phyag rgya bstan la ba liX ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor ma bzhes nan tan du btags mthar se gol gnyis tog pa'i sgra dang bcas pa lan lnga'am/ spro na bdun gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa dag gis 'bul bar bshad pa bzhin dang /ba liX tshab tu ambha sogs go bsgyur ba gcig dang / yang de'i dod du oX āXhūm̐X sbyor bas bdud rtsi 'theb srin gyis lan gsum rnams phul ba bzhin 'od kyis sbu gus drangs drangs te gsol zhing dgyes nas 'dod don 'phrin las ci 'dod bcol ba bran bzhin byed par bsam pa'i mod la dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rdo rje bstan la bka' bsgo te/ oX badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra sa ma ya hoX kyai dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum 'bor dang bcas pa rnams kyis dpal he ru ka khams gsum zil gnon/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma slob dpon chen po padma badzra zhes sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mthar thug gi bar brgyud pa'i mtshan brjod la/ sogs pa
rtsa ba brgyud par bcas pa'i rigs 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi bka' ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu sku tshe ring ba dang / dge 'dun gyi sde tshogs dar zhing rgyas pa/ khyad par bdag dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gang yin sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mo zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur nas dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang ba'i bar gcod mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa/ 'dul zhing mos shong dbang du 'du ba/ bgegs dang log 'dren gdug pa can rnams drag pos tshar gcod pa dang / khyad par dgra jag chom rkun la sogs pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar sa lam gyi bar gcod sel zhing / bsam pa'i don rnams chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las stong grogs gnyan po nye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes rgyun du spyir btang dang / dmigs bsal ched du 'phrin las gang bcol ltar las kyi gnyer gtad/ hūṃX/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes dang / rgyud kyi bstod bskul las 'byung ba'i/ chos skyong thugs dam bskong ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs rkang pa dgu yis bsngos pa the tshom med pa nyid du 'grub par byed do/ /'dzam bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ snying gar hūṃX e sngags kyis bskor/ /
༄tshi/ /'od 'phros sems can sgrib pa sbyangs/ /brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyeragacig bzlas/ /zhes pas mdun bskyed chos skyong yab yum gyi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor la gnas pa'i sa bon hūṃX dang e yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis 'phreng bas bskor bar bsam zhing / rang ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs ba sogs kha bsgyur dang bcas pa gud nas 'byung la/las 'phrin gang la yang grangs ni rab brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bring brgya dang brgyad dam/ tha mar nyer gcig skams 'dir g.yal dang sgrib pa tsam gyi skyon kyang spangs pas bzlas nas/ 'phrin las su bcol ba kun la gces shing / rgyud las/ kun tu srog gi snying po bzlas/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /zhes rgyun bsnyen du bya ba chos skyong yab yum gyi sngon gyi dam bcas rang rtags srog gi rgyud las bskul ba'i phyir/ snying po rnams la gtor ma nam 'bul ba'i tshe bzlas pa'i grangs nges pa can dang / gzhan du yang khong gi dbugs bzhin 'bad pas/ rang nyid la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'brel ba med par 'grogs nas 'phrin las byed par 'gyur ba gsang ba snying 'bor rgyud las 'byung ba'i gtor chog gi don nges par gsal byed/ 'dod yon gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes pa/ rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyas dbang po sdes/ ldan klong thang sgrom me'i
gtsug lag gi gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / mya/ ca) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'phrin las dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma thog ma'i kun tu bzang / / dregs pa 'dul phyir he ru ka yi gzugs/ /khams gsum zil gyis gnon mdzad nyid kyi skur/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mas 'khyud der phyag 'tshal/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dbus ma ga dha rdo rje gdan la nub phyogs su dpal o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gsang sngags zab po'i gter mdzod kyi gnas dang / dha na ko sha'i pho brang chen po'i bsrung ma'i dbang po gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba yang gsang gab tu sbas pa'i bka' rgya can chos skyong gsang mgon dkar po 'di'i mtshan gyis nges pa/ rgyud las/ dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni/ /dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ste/ /zhes pa ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i ḍākki ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad bgegs rigs 'byung po kun gyi rje bo/ mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul kun gyi mnga' bdag tshe dpal longs spyod dbang phyug mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa/ dpa' bo chen po dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rgyud don man ngag du legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho las/ sha za yid
༄༅/ /bzhin nor bu yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas 'phrin las byang bu bskang bstod la sogs pa'i rim pa dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ste/ dur khrod kyi bdag po'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las / gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya/ /de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /ces pas rgyun gyi gtor ma 'bul/ thabs kyi rtsa bar bstan la de'i cho ga logs su shes shing / yang rgyud de nyid las/ dkon mchog yi dam chos skyongs la/ /mchod gsol dngos grub stsol bar byed/ /ces sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub dang 'brel ba'i gtor chog rgyas par bstan pa de'i dgos pa yang / rgyud las/ mgon po dngos su byung gyur na/ /gang 'dod dngos grub thob par nges/ /zhes pa nas dung 'bud rnga brdung rab tu bzang / /zhes pa'i bar rkang ba bdun gyis 'dod pa'i ltas byung ba'i tshe gtang rag dga' ston du byed pa dang khyad par du/ rgyud las/ dus bzang dus su mchod bya ste/ /gsol ba btab la dngos grub blangs / /thun mongs rdzas dang zas nor 'du/ /zhes dang / de bas gzhan du yang rgyud las/ nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon/ /rtsod pa byed dang zas ngan za/ /bande sngags pa byung ba ni/ /mgon po khros pas bskang bshags bya/ /zhes bshad la/ gzhan yang rgyud las/ byung ba'i tpū nang gsang ba'i rten gyi zhal sro ba/ bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi rang g.yin bsrung ma bsrung zhing byed kha bsogs pa/
nyams pa bsgral ba las phran mtha' dag khyad par dgra jag chom rkun bcings pa sogs mdor na byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du sa dang lam kyi bar chad sel zhing / gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs cig char du sgrub pa'i lhan thabs su dgos par/ rgyud las/ de nas dpa' bo chen po des/ /bdag gi las rnams gang sgrub kyang / / gdung ba chen po'i skad kyis ni/ /bstod cing bskul zhes bshad pas na/ /dang por mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mnyes par byas la gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo las bshad pa'i rjes gnang bka' bsgo/ rgyud las rgya gzhung sogs man ngag yig snar bcas lugs dang phyag len zhal shes kyis brgyan pa sngon du thebs la/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pas gnas dus dkyil 'khor yo byad thams cad tpū nang gsang ba de kho na'i rten dang / bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen/ sgrub dang sgrub chen/ bsrung bzlog las tshogs sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs bka' bsgo dam bzhag sogs dpa' bo'i rgyud don man ngag legs bshad rgya mtsho las byung ba'i yig sna so sor shes shing / 'dir las byang dngos la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ de nas mtshams bcad bshags pa bya/ /yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags nas/ /de rjes tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / shu n+ya ta yi stong bar bsgom/ /
༄tsho/ /de las bdag nyid hūm̐X las ni/ hūm̐X dkar bsam la mdun du ni/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsam/ zhes pas/ rgyun du bya ba sgrub pa po rang nyid zhing lpags sam gcan gzan lpags pa'i gdan sogs bde ba'i stan la/ kha 'chi bdag gam/ lho nub tu jahayata 79phyogs shing mngon par dam tshig can gyi 'khor dang bcas pa gral la 'khod/ gu gul dud pa btang / rol mo spar zhing 'khor bcas phyi nang gi mtshams bcad nas/mdun gyi nam mkhar buddhā bo dhi sa twa sarba ta thā ga gu ru de wa ḍākki ni badzra sa ma ya dzaXdzaX zhes yul du spyan drangs la/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i 'gro ba mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i la mchis kyi bar du/ zhes sogs spro'am bsdu na/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying po mchis gyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su 'chi/ /shes rab snying rje dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas drung du gnas byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /zhes dang rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs
gsol 'debs/ /bdag gzhan dge tshogs bla med kyi/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo 'o/ / zhes dang / 'gro kun rtag par bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal dag dang bral gyur cig /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /btang snyoms mchog la gnas gyur cig /oX ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na swā bha wa atpa ko3nya/ dngos 'dzin thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong zhing bdag med pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐X las skad cig gis bdag nyid dpal chen po he ru ka khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i sku/ mthing nag drang srong khros pa'i ngang tshul can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thong khrag thugs gar bsnol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas mnyam par yab la 'khyud pa 'khril sbyor ba brkyang bskum gyi stabs su padma nyi zla drag po lha chen pho mo'i gdan la gnyis ga'ang gcer bu dbu brgyan cod paṇa rus pa'i rgyan drug mgo 'phreng do shal gyis brgyan pa dur khrod chen po'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can du/ oX badzra shrī badzra he ru ka badzra yo kī ni hūm̐X phaṭa ces bzlas pa ni bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas rgyud las/ mdun du ni/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsam/ /zhes pas rten gtor khyad par can gyi rgyan can de/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bye brag las rim sgrub bya gang bkod dam/ rgyun du dmigs rten thun mong gi bris sku sogs spyir bshams la dmigs
༄tshi/ /nas / mdun bskyed ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X yig las e chad pas mdun du chos kyi dbyings mthing nag gru gsum pa'i nam mkhar yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang khu gzhu'i rnam pa la rdo rje rgya gram dang ba dan gyis mtshan rmya/ pa/ ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho dmar nag zlum po khrag zil gyi lbu ba dang rba klong 'khrugs pa/ sum̐ las zhing chen lpags pa ser po gcal du bkram pa'i sa gzhi gru bzhi pa/ keX las keX rus sna tshogs khral khrol du brtsegs pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'phro ba de'i phyogs mtshams su 'khor yug dur khrod chen po'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan par mgo dang yan lag dang / don snying dang nang khrol dang / liṅga dang / ro dang / shing dang / me dang / chu dang / sprin dang / mchod rten dang / phyogs skyong dang / zhing skyong dang / klu dang / ma mo dang / rnal 'byor grub thob pho mo dang / dpa' bo dang / ḍākki sha za dang / gdon bgegs 'byung po ro langs dang / srin po dang / phra men gaṅga dang / rgod dang / 'ol ba dang / 'ug pa dang / khra dang / ri skags dang / bya ma byi la sogs pa gnyis skyes kyi tshogs dang / lce spyang dang / wa dang / spyang ki dang / stag gzigs dom dred la sogs pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs dang / phag dang / ra rgod dang dug sbrul dang / ti'u lo dang / gzhan yang chu srin dang kurma
dang sil dang / dung mgron dang / nya dang srin po la sogs pa srog chags mi bsrun pa ji snyed rgyu zhing sa phyogs kun tu sha khrag pags rus klad tshil rkang zhun chu ba rgyu ma skra sen don snying nang khrol bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus su/ dhī las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang phyi mi mgo skam po'i brtsegs pa la sogs pa dur khrod kyi rang bzhin dang / nang rin chen las grub pa'i gur khang gru bzhi pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur ba/ rgya phebs kyi rnam pa can/ pha gye mda' yab pu shu tog dang bcas pa thams cad keX rus sna tshogs bkod legs su bkram zhing sgrigs pa'i thog rim par ldan pa la rgyu ma'i drwa ba dang / bar mtshams kun tu don snying la sogs dbang po nang khrol mgo rlon rkang lag skra yi phon po dang / chun 'phyang mang po'i drwa phyed du brgyan pa'i zur bzhir mchog dang mchog phran gyis lpags pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan 'phyar ba/ nang du khrag gi spa klong 'khyil ba'i khar/paṃ padma maṇḍal hūm̐X gis sna tshogs padma'i gdan/ ma surya maṇḍal hūm̐X gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsanda maṇḍal hūm̐X gis zla ba'i gdan/ ru tra ti ra bam gyis mi ro gnyis bsnol ba'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐X dang yaṃ las/ dung dang mgron bu hūm̐X dang e gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba keX rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig
༄tshi/ /phyag gnyis spyan gsum nyi zla ltar 'khyil mche ba gtsigs pa phyag g.yas thod skam gyi dbyug pa 'bar ba rdo rje phyed pa'i yu ba can/ nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang bar thugs gar bsnams pa/ zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad stabs su 'khril ba/ thod skams lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi phreng ba/ gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phrog zhu dang snyan cha mgur chu phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu do shal la sogs pas sku la mdzes par brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum gnyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' spyod dpa' po dpa' mo sprul 'khor bran g.yog dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs su oX āXhūm̐X hūm̐X e/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed yab yum gyi thugs gar phog de las kyang 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas chen mkha' spyod 'og min dang dbyer ma mchis pa nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gi dur khrod chen po nas/ dpa' bo sha za chen po dur khrod kyi bdag po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum sprul 'khor yang bran dang bcas pa ye shes sems dpa'i rnam par spyan 'dren no/ /gshegs su gsol cig badzra sa mā ya dzaXdzaX hūm̐X e/ sngon tshe khyod nyid dpal chen he ru ga'i/ /spyan sngar
sangs rgyas bstan bsrung zhal bzhes pa/ /dpa' bo chen po dpal ldan dur khrod kyi/ /bdag po yab yum 'khor bcas dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sa 'og sa steng sa blar spyod pa'i zhing / /smyi dang bye brag nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul kun nyal gsang ba'i bdag po keX rus gzugs/ /yid bzhin nor bu yab yum spyan 'dren no/ /khyad par gnas mchog rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /nub phyogs mkha' la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /ñtsarsha rgyan yul gyi dur khrod chen po nas/ /rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'byung ba rim rtsegs rin chen thod pa'i mkhar/ /'khor yug dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus/ /khrag zhag pad nyi zla steng bam ro'i gdan 'bar ba'i klong du dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs/ /bcom ldan he ru ka yi lha tshogs dang / /mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /spyan sngar zhal bzhes bstan bsrung mthu bo che/ /sngon gyi dam tshig nyer dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /rig 'dzin padma badzra rtsal la sogs/ /rgya gar paṇa grub brgyud pa'i spyan snga rtswa /dam bca' zhal: sngon gyi: bsgyur mdzad zhus chen khams pa zhwa lo sogs/ /rim par brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa'i tshogs/ /spyan sngar: sngon gyi: skyabs gsum kun 'dus rigs bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /spyan sngar: sngon gyi: (༷ e/ dpal ldan rab song gnas kyi bdag po che/ /chos
༄tshi/ /skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum la/ /sngags 'chang bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /dngos dbyor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /las bzhi maṇḍal khrag chen gyis byug pa/ /mchog phur khri la thod dkar dum gcig nang / /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs dag gis bkang / /dngos grub mchog gi sgrubs rdzas chen po 'dis/ thabs chen sha za dpa' bo du khrod bdag /shes rab e ka sa ra mthu rtsal can/ /rnam sprul mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad 'khor/ /stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bran bcas thugs dam bskang / /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛta/ /go gu da ha na sogs sha lnga dang / /dri chen byang sems klad khrag dri chu bcas/ /ma da na sogs sbyar ba'i dam rdzas 'dis/ /thabs chen: shes rabazo rnam 'phrul: stong phrag: blo ldan ri bong lug dang g.yag rgod sha/ /dkar gsum shing thog 'bru sna zhal zas sogs/ /rin chen lnga dang dar zab ras stag gzig yid la 'dod dgu'i mi nor 'di dag gis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong = rgyal la spyod pa dkar phyogs dang po'i char/ /dur khrod ras la dpa' bo yab yum sku/ /tshul bzhin bris nas rnal 'byor lus la bcings / / phyi rten sku'i dam rdzas 'di nyid kyis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong : sna tshogs 'bru la ratnar bcas pa dag /bzang po drug dang ga bur chur sbyar nas/ /khyad par dus la khyod kyi sku bzhengs la/ /nang ltar
rten pa'i dam rdzas 'di nyid kyis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong ca dar dkar gtsang ma'i gzhi la gser ldan las/ /snying po phreng du bris dang gsang ba'i rten/ /dman pas reg min rin chen sa le sbram/ /mi 'gyur srog gi bla rdo dam rdzas 'dis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong : nor bu dung dkar 'khyil dang mgron bur bcas/ /mchog tu bsngags pa'i thugs rten khyad par rdzas/ /yon tan rten gyi 'khor lo zur brgyad dang / /'phrin las nyer gcig so so'i rten rnams kyis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong: thod skam 'bar bas mtshan pa dbyug pa'i mgul/ /rab mdzes dar gyi cod paṇa rnam par g.yo/ /klad phor dgra bgegs snying khrag drod mos bkang / /phyag mtshan chom rkun 'ching byed zhags pa 'dis/ /thabs:shes: rnam: stong: rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil chu gnyis padma'i steng / /gu gul dud sprin nyin mor byed pa'i me/ /dung chos snod du sbyar ba'i dri bzang chu/ /bza' ba mchog dang sgra dbyangs sna tshogs 'dis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong : khrag gi ambha tshil spos dbang po lnga'i/ /me tog zhun gyi mar me dri chu'i chab/ /panyu la traṃ pas brgyan lha mi'i zas/ /thod rnga mi rkang gling bu la sogs pas / / thabs: shes: rnam: stong : rin chen thod par sman byugs dpal gyi b.regs/ /chang bu'i bskor ba sna tshogs sha khrag brgyan/ /thabs chen nor bu dar dkar cod paṇa can/ /rten rgyun la sogs dam can gtor
༄༅/ /ma 'di'i/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong za bdud rtsi sbyar dang 'bru bcud bzang po'i bcud/ /mtshan ldan dung zhal snod du legs bkang ba'i/ /rgyu tshad dmar chen rakta'i rgya mtsho che/ /lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan dhar bshams pa 'dis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong : phyi nang rnam par dag pa'i yul gnas shing / /spyi dang khyad par lha'i gzhal med khang / /mkha' spyod o rgyan rab song chen po'i byin/ /mtshungs 'drar bkod pa'i sgrub pa'i khang pa 'dis/ /thabs: shes: rnam: stong : kyiXhoX rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs/ /rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /yab yum 'khor bcas gsan dgongs mkhyen par gsol/ /bdag cag thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /ma rig las dang nyon mongs dbang gis ni/ nyes byas nongs par gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /gnong zhing 'gyod pa drag pos bshags par bgyi/ /gsang sngags dkyil 'khor chen po'i ༷rdzor zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag bar/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung bar khas blangs pas/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul gyur pa mthol zhing bshags / / bsnyen sgrub tshad du ma chol dam rdzas sman/ /lta ba'i gdeng zhan thugs dam rgyud ma thul/ /mchod bstod lo zla dus las yol ba sogs/ /bag med le lo'i dbang gyur mthol zhing bshags/ /phyi rten bris sku
lus la ma bcangs dang / nang rten sman sku gnas su ma bzung zhing / /gsang rten mya ngan bskyed rim ma gsal sogs/ / sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /srog snying rgyun du ma bzlas rten ma bcas/ /sngags sgra ma dag ngag 'chal lhag chad nyams/ /gsang ba gzhan du bsgrags pa la sogs pa/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams padzdza g.yo med rgyun gyi ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang / /dung mgron bud med ma reg sa le sbram/ /thod dbyug la sogs ma 'byor ma tshang bas/ /thugs kyi dam tshig: phyi nang gsang rten dkyil 'khor dam rdzas sogs/ /gzhan gyi mthong tshor reg par gyur ba dang / /bsnyen sgrub dus su spang bya bud med dang / /khyi dang rme chen 'phrad pa mthol lo bshags/ /chos nyid don la blang dor ma mchis kyang / /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis ni/ /rnam dag ye shes dgongs pa'i klong yangs nas/ /dag gtsang tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ /bstod bskul rgyud las byung ba 'di skad do/ / hūm̐X/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog na/ /zhes pa nas/ bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam bzhin du 'phrin las mdzod/ /kyaiX khyod gsol khyod sgrub bcol ba'i 'phrin las ni/ /bdag gzhan yul khams grong khyer bsrung ba dang / /shes rab blo 'phel bya byed rigs sngags bzlog /mchog thun dngosagrub stsol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phun tshogs 'byor ba kun gyi gzhi gyur
༄tsho/ /pa / / nas 'bras gro khre so ba til dang yungs/ /dkar nag rgya bod sran sogs 'bru mang pos/ /rnam thos gnod sbyin bang mdzod ltar gang mdzod/ /dkar bcud gangs ri ltar dkar lo legs shing / /bza' btung lha mi'i longs spyod lta bur rgyas/ /dgra jag chom rkun tshogs rnams bcings pa dang / /'gro rnams dbang du bsdu ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /rang phyogs rtag par g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa bsrung / /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs las skyobs pa dang / /lte bsgyur rigs bsgyud 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bu slob grwa tshogs 'khor 'bangs yongs 'du zhing / /rdo rje'i srad bus gang byed las la sngar / /stag gzig gcan gzan la sogs kha 'ching ba/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i 'bras bu mngon 'byin mdzod/ /pu dra gsod dang gso bar gang 'dod pa/ / gzhan yang sngar sbyor kun la nus ldan zhing / /mthu dang rdzas la rten 'brel bslu med pa/ / drang srong mchog gi bka' ltar bden grub mdzod/ /hūm̐X e/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling gi zhing skyong khyod/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan bsrung gtso/ /dpal ldan dur khrod gnas rnams kun gyi bdag /sha za yab yum 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /phyi ltar yab yum 'byung ba'i mkha' dbyings su/ /rtog tshogs rnam par dag pa'i dur khrod nas/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan 'jigs su rung ba'i gzhi/ /
phyogs mtshams ma lus yongs su khyab der bstod/ /de dbus keX rus gur phub thod pa'i nang / /skra lpags dbang po don snod kyis brgyan dang / /khrag mtshor 'khyil ba me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong / /rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal g.yas khang la bstod/ /khyod ni khrag 'thung thabs shes ngo bo nyid/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir sprul pa keX rus gzugs/ /la lar dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor gyi tshul/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug yab yum bstod phyir ni dur khrod kun gyi bdag po ste/ /khyad par nub phyogs o rgyan yul na bzhugs/ /dam tshig can gyi mchod yul rtag gnas pa/ /gnyer mdzod bsrung ba'i dbang po yab yum bstod/ /rang bzhin las grub sde brgyad dreg pa'i 'bor/ /yang bran bgegs rigs ma lus sprul pa'i gzugs/ /ro lang phra men 'byung po bya gcan gzan/ /sna tshogs bka' gtor ma yis 'khor bcas bstod/ /hūm̐X e/ rab dkar keX rus gti mug rnam dag sku/ /nam mkhar 'phar ba'i dbyug pa zhe sdang 'jom/ /'dod chags mtsho skam thod khrag zhal du rngub/ /sku gsum mngon gyur dpal ldan yab yum bstod/ /rigs lnga o rgyan dngos grub gter gyi mdzod/ /rgya phyed mgo bo'i dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod/ /rin chen rgyan phreng sgrub la dngos grub ster/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis gdug pa kun 'dul bstod/ /dgyes pa'i gad mo rnal 'byor spro ba bskyed/ /khros pa'i stobs kyis
༄tshi/ /dgra bgegs gdan steng du/ /gsang ba'i mgon po chos skyong yab yum bstod/ /gnyis med sbyor bas dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed/ /byang sems rgyun gyis sgrub la dngos grub ster/ /las mdzad stabs su bskyed pas 'phrin las sgrub/ /yid bzhin nor bu sha za yab yum bstod/ / sprul ba ru 'dren gar byed srid gsum 'gengs/ /'khor ni lha srin sde brgyad sbas pa'i gzugs/ /bgegs rigs bya dang gcan gzan tshogs kyi bran 'phrin las thogs med bka' bstod rnams la bstod/ /zhon pa rnams dang zhing chen steng gnas pa'i/ /phyogs mtshams zhing skyong mchod rten me chu srin/ /grub thob lha klu ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ / rnal 'byor grogs mdzad kun khyab zhing khams bstod/ /thabs chen rin chen 'od 'bar 'khyil ba yi/ /mngon par rab mdzes zur brgyad gzhal yas khang / /'khor yug dur khrod chen po rdo rje'i me/ /rnam dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bstod/ /hūm̐X e/ dpa' bo chen po dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /ma lus gnas kyi bdag po sha za che/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum sku/ /rab 'jigs zil gnon keX rus mche ba gtsigs/ /thod skam 'bar ba'i dbyug pa klad la bskor/ /dgra jag chom rkun 'ching byed zhags pa can/ /gar mdzad me rlung 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil na/ /stong gsum ma lus khyab pa'i sprul 'bor tshogs/ /'di gshegs rgyan gyi
gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bdud rtsi a mṛ ta dang sha lnga dang / /chang gi phud dang dmar chen rakta dang / /bza' dang bca' dang kha zas sna tshogs dang / /rab tu sbyar ba'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod spel/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog /jag pa chom skun dbang po yan lag bcings / spyir na snying 'khor gsang ba'i rgyud sde sogs/ gsang sngags bstan bsrung ting 'dzin skyes bu skyongs/ /khyad par 'dod pa'i don la gsol btab bzhin/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las gnyan po mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar dpa' bo rgyud don man ngag tu legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /'phrin las ngag 'don bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di yang rig sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shos stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes sbyar ba'o/ / lhe/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /tshogs mchod dpa' bo'i dga' ston bzhugs/ /dam tshig rdzas su bsngags pa'i sha dang chang / / rtag par gsol la dgyes mdzad mkha' 'gro ma/ /yongs kyi tshogs dpon dur khrod gnas kyi bdag /mchod phyir dpa' bo'i dga' ston 'dir bshad do/ /de yang dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po gsang ba snying gi 'bor lo'i rgyud las/ a mṛ ta dang sha lnga dang / /chang dang sna
༄tshi/ /tshogs zas kyis ni/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum mchod/ /ces gsungs pas/ nang nub mchod sprin gyi mngon par bstod zin pa'i skabs der rgyud las bsngags pa/ a mṛ ta ste bdud rtsi dang / sha lnga dngos sam gzhan pa phab rgyun gyis bran pa dang / myos byed kyi nus pa dang ldan pa'i chang bzang po ni/ gtso bor med mi rung la/ gzhan yang rung bar byas pa'i rigs ñtsu snyed dang / rjen btsos bsregs pa lga dang lan tshwa/ spos sman gyi kha tshar btab pa sha mong shing thog lo 'bras rtsi thog gi rigs kyang rang bzhin gyi ro bcud dang ldan pa dang / sbyar g.yos su byas pa sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i kha zas bza' bca' ji tsam 'byor ba lag 'bras kyis thon pa yid du 'ong bar byas nas/ tshogs rdzas su mngon par 'du bgyis nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum mchod byas pa'i phyir legs par bshams te/ a mṛ tas sngags kyi chus bsangs/ shu n+ya ta'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs/ phyag rgyar bcas pa'i oX āXhūm̐X ha ho hrīX bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dus sum sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dpa' bo yab yum mkha' 'gro 'bor dang bcas/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po la/ phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig
sgrib bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag gzhan dge tshogs bla med kyi/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo 'o/ /mdor na bdag gi bzung ba'i lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rgya chen kun/ / lhan cig bsdom nas dpal ldan dur khrod bdag /yab yum 'khor dang bcas la gus pas 'bul/ /bdag nyid rnal 'byor shes rab rten gyi rdzas/ /mnyam par lhan cig tshogs pa'i gral 'di rtswa /bza' ba mchog tu gyur ba'i sha dang ni/ /de bzhin btung bar bsngags pa'i myos byed chang / /gzhan yang g.yos sbyor rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgya chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod par 'bul/ /dpa' bo dam can rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rmad byung 'dod yon phung bo 'di phul bas/ /sku gsung thugs dang rtsa lag dam tshigs sogs/ /nyams chag bskong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpal ldan chos skyong dpa' bo dur khrod bdag /rab 'jigs yab yum 'khor bcas bden pa'i mthus/ /bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ /khyad par gnod byed dgra jag chom skun rnams/ /zhing bcu'i ngo bor bsdus la liṅga 'dir/ /'gugs chings bsdoms myos nga bdag dbyings su sgrol/ /hūm̐X ī bhyoX bdud sde 'joms
༄7/ /mdzad bcom ldan he ru ga'i/ /spyan sngar snyigs ma lnga spyod dar ba'i tshe/ /de dus lam mchog gsang sngags bstan pa 'di/ /dpa' bos bsrung bar zhal bzhes thugs dam bskul/ /dur khrod bdag po sha za dpa' bo che/ /mgon po yab yum keX rus khros pa'i gzugs/ /gar mdzad sprul ba bye ba dpag med tshogs/ /snal 'byor gdung bas bskul lo 'phrin las mdzod/ /'bar ba'i thod dbyug rdo rje yu ba can/ /'phyar zhing bskor la zhe sdang 'dzoms pa'i phyir/ /gnod byed mgo bo'i klad du rgyab la bzung / /gzugs phung myos par brdung shog da hā ya/ /thugs rje'i rgyun chags rdo rje'i zhags pa yang / /las la bskul phyir gnod byed steng du rgyob/ /bya byed ngan pa'i dgra jag chos rkun sogs/ /yan lag dbang po 'ching shog bhanta ya/ /rdo bsregs chu klung bye ma nyung dkar thun/ /grangs med sprul ba stong gsum khams rnams kyis/ /thams cad zil gnon rmug shog rgyal du chug /zhes las la sbyar/ de dag gi don rgyud las/ bza' ba po yi ming rus can/ /brub khung nang du gzhugs par bya/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la bstim/ /zhes dang / dus bzhir thun gyis brab bar bya/ / zhes sogs bzlog bsad kyi skabs rgyas par bstan la/ 'dir bcings pa'i dbang du mdor bsdus tsam ste/ de nas thun bskul ba ni/ hūm̐X āXbhyoX skye med dbyings las 'gags med
rtsal 'bor 'das dbyer med dur khrod che/ /dngos grub kun 'byung ting 'dzin klong / /dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang du/ /dpal chen srid gsum zil gnon gyi/ /spyan sngar srog snying mdongs gsol phul/ /dam bcas dpa' bo yab yum du/ /dbugs 'byung legs so gnang ba byin/ /rgyud gtad dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor skyongs/ /dam nyams dgra jag chom skun sogs/ /chad pas gcod pa'i gnyer gtad pa/ /tshogs kyi bdag po keX rus gzugs/ /sha za yab yum dus la bab/ /sprul pa rang 'dra bye ba'i tshogs/ /gar mdzad pho nya dus la bab/ /rang bzhin las grub 'khor sde brgyad/ /ro langs phra min dus la bab/ / bgegs bran dbugs len dur bya rgod/ /lce spyang ma tshogs dus la bab/ /sngags 'chang rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la/ /gnas skabs gnod 'tshe'i dgra dang bgegs/ /thar ba'i bgegs byed sdig sgrib rkyen dmag dpung dgra jag chom rkun sogs/ /mi mthun spangs byar gyur pa rnams/ /zhing bcu'i ru tra'i steng du bzlog /mtha' dmag gdug pa'i phyogs su bsgyur/ /gzhan yang bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub/ /rku 'phrog sems ldan ci mchis pa/ /de dag thun gtor 'dir khug la/ /thod dbyug zhe sdang mgo la bsnun/ /'dod chags snying khrag thod par 'thung/ /khram bam gyis thob nga rgyal choms/ /rdzu 'phrul zhags pas stobs nus
༄tshi/ /'chings / / gzi brjid 'bar ba'i mche ba brtsigs/ /dug gsum 'bor ba'i rtsa ba chod/ /zhal du stab po kha raṃ khā hi/ /mguladu bsgril shig a ra lam̐/ /sprul pa gar byed rdzas kyi chod/ /ro langs phra men nor phyir rgyug /'byung po bya spyang zas la snyegs/ /than srog gang mtshams chad pa chod/ /dkor nor khang khyim khor yug tshun/ /thub par bsrung shog sa ma ya/ /dpa' bo chen po yab yum la/ /ye shes las grub mkha' 'gro'i bskor sde brgyad 'khor dang bgegs rigs bran/ /'dir byon lhag phud mchod pa bzhes/ /lhag ma bshams la/ mchod 'os gtso bo gtsang ma phud kyi bdag/ tshogs rol ma mo mkha' 'gro sde brgyad 'khor/ /tha mar lhag ma len pa'i bka' nyan bran/ / rnam gsum chos nyid gcig par gtor ma bzhes/ zhes mchod gtor 'phangs lhag so sor nyi nub kyi skabs phyin nas/ /phyi rol du gnad stem la btang ngo / /rgyud don man ngag legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ tshogs mchod dpa' bo'i dga' ston zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / rmya/ja) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /yon tan rin chen rten 'khor 'azhugs/ /gu ru na mo bla mar phyag bya'i don/ /dpal ldan dur khrod chen po'i gnas kun gyi/ /
bdag po'i rgyud las yon tan rten 'khor lo/ /zhal las shes so gab don 'grel byed mtshan/ /paṇa chen bee ro tsa na rakṣi tas/ /man ngag logs su bkod nas zab pa'i phyir/ /lo tsār gcig brgyud yig rnying las byung ba'i sba ba 'di ni nang dang gsang ba'i skur/ /ces pas rten pa bzhengs thabs mdor bstan du/ ratna dang ni 'bru rig sna tshogs phye/ /lhan gcig bsres pa'i sbyar gzhi ming dang dbyibs/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas nyid las/ /byung ba'i sa 'dzin dkar po la sogs pa/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis kyi sku/ /byas pas dri bzang gis byug zhes gsungs don/ /bzhengs thabs lag len bi shwa'i nyams yig tu/ /rgyas par bshad zin skabs 'dir spro bya min/ /rten 'khor dngos ni ras sam dar dkar po/ /srab mtha' dam rtsi'i byugs phyir gzhi bdag la/ /dri yi gtso bo ga bur bzang drug sogs/ /drungs byas khu ba sbyar ba'i gser zhun gyis/ /snag mos tsakra mdzes byed dang ldan pa'i/ /re khā mu khyud lte ba bcas par bskor/ /lte ba'i dkyil du re khas gru bzhi gnyis/ /cha snyoms bsnol mar brtsigs pas zur brgyad pa/ /bris bcas 'khor lo'i rtsibs gyi don yin la/ /de yi dbus su khyad chos rin po che/ /dung mgron gzugs brnyan gan skyal 'jug spro la/ /sa bon hūm̐X e bkod tshul de snying du/ /de gnyis sdom yig athi+-i zhes bris pa yi/ /yig rgyun ma dag thams
༄khu/ /cad oX du 'khrul/ /lte nang log mtshams g.yung drung g.yon 'khyil bzhi/ /bar rtsibs phyogs mtshams zur gsum rnam pa brgyad/ /kun la nang du nor bu rin po che/ /'bar ba'i gzugs brgyan de'i phyi mu khyud la rtsa sngags sham bur bkod pa 'dra min du/ /'byung yang rnam pa sa bon oX yig gi /dbu rgyan dbyug tho'i snying po ghi yig nas/ /nyer tsam rā dza rgyal po gsum pa bzung / /ku ma mi ldan de nyid slar yang bzlos/ /khum this swā hā sham bur ras sna ghri/ /rtsa bar gab pa tsam bam yig 'bru gnyis/ /de bzhin che ge mo ces bye brag par/ /gang 'dod bsgyur rung 'dra bar bstan na yang / /spyi gnad yin phyir mi sems sgul sgul zer/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni thun mong ma yin te/ swā hā la sogs 'grel byed lo tswa'i gsungs/ /yi ge gzugs brnyan zhabs rngub tshul du bris/ /rdo phreng me ri bskor ba'i tsakra la/ /rab gnas byas te mthong rgyud lag len bzhin/ /ldeb dril dbu zhabs mgo phyogs ma log pa/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa ltar du 'khril sbyor can/ nang dang gsang rten sku'i lte bar ni/ /bcug zhes phyir la mi mngon bar du'o/ /nang gsang yon tan rten 'khor rten pa de/ /gnyis ka bsnyen sgrub la sogs skabs phye nas/ / rgyun du rang gi dkor nor longs spyod kyis/ /bang mdzod nang du bzhugs la nye bar mchod/ /spang bya'i gnas sogs gzhan la sba ba'i phyir/ /ke
tshang gur khang mdzes legs thabs bya'o/ /des ni skye 'gro mi rnams g.yo ba dang / /sris rme zas nor longs spyod dpal 'phel zhing / /sgrub pa po nyid 'bor dang bcas pa la/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las bsrung ba dang de bzhin tshe ring ba dang bsod nams dang / /snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs mthar spel ba sogs/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus thams cad kyi/ gtsug gi nor bu lta bur 'gyur ro zhes/ rgya cher bsngags mdzad rten la med mi rung / 'bad pas lhan tu legs par sba ba'i thabs/ brjod don yongs rdzogs gsang rgyud snying 'khor gyi/ /zhal las byung ba shes par bya ba'i gnad/ /bstan pa'i don du dam ldan snying gi dbus/ /gcig brgyud tshul du gdams ngag zab pa'i gnad/ /don 'brel byed po sngags 'chang dbang pos sdes/ /padma'i e waṃ lcog sgar du sbyar ro/ / mya/ nya) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /rten sku sba ba'i man ngag bzhugs/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rten sku sba ba'i man ngag ni/ rin po che'am bkra shis pa'i sa la/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku byas te dri bzang byugs/ ras sam dar dkar la byas pa'i 'bor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bris/ de'i dbus su oX rtsibs brgyad la rin po che brgyad bris/ mu khyud la oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma
༄༅/ /khum this rarna ghri rtse bam che ge mo'i sems sgul sgul byas la bris/ 'khor lo yab yum gyi lto bar bzhugs rten gyi dkyil 'bor gyi chas rnams gong bzhin byas la/ hūm̐X las e chad pa las nam mkha'/ yaṃ las rlung raṃ las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi keX las keX rus kyi ri rab baṃ las nyi ma/ bhrūṃ las gzhal yas khang de'i nang du/ paṃ las padma maṇḍal la hūṃX gis padma'i gdan/ ma surya maṇḍal la hūm̐X gis nyi ma'i gdan a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal la hūm̐X gis zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du sa bon hūṃX/ de las dur khrod bdag po chen po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku dog dkar/ /phyag g.yas thod phyug 'bar ba 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gsol/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs/ /shin tu 'jigs shing rngam pa'i sku/ brkyang bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ 'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /rang gi thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /o rgyan nas ni spyan drangs bstim/ /rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ /gang ltar bsnyen sgrub byas nas ni/ /rang gi bang mdzod phugs su sba/ /des ni mi rnams g.yo ba dang / /dkar po nor 'phel bsrung ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang / /kun gyi gtsug tu nor bur 'gyur/ /'di ni rten gyi man ngag go /sa ma ya/ ithigiX
da) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'bru 'phel ma rmos lo tog bzhugs/ /dgongs rgyud gsang ba'i gabor lo las/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /'bru sna tsan dan chus sbyar te/ /zhes dang / rgya gzhung las kyang / de nas las tshogs bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /sna tshogs 'bru la byas nas su/ /bang mdzod bcug la gsol ba btab/ /de yis 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ des na thun mong las kyi tshogs bsgrub pa'i thabs nyi shu rtsa gcig las/ 'dir sngon du bsnyen sgrub skabs mtshan ltas su snang ba'i 'bras bu myur du bskul ba'am slad kyi ched du sgrub par 'dod pas/ dpal chen po dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum nang gi rten sku dang rjes su 'brel ba/ 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa ngar brtags gtso bor gyur pa la chu dang lag gi bskor ba'i phyug po'i rang 'thag gi lte phye dang 'bru sna yang thabs kyi btsal nas cung zad bsres pa tsan dan dkar dmar chu gtsang ma la sbyar ba'i dri chus 'bras bu zan byas pa'i rgyud las/ mngon rtogs dang mthun pa khong stong du bgyis te/ de'i nang nas 'bras gro sran so ba khre til nyung dkar sogs 'byor tshad gong du so sor bsags la/ g.yang gi gza' skar 'dzoms pa dus bzang po la lhan cig du bsres pa/ khengs par bkang ba'i thugs
༄༅/ /gar dar dkar la/ gser gyi sa bon dang srog snying gi mthar che ge mo tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor/ khyad par du 'bru sna rnam pa sna tshogs pa mang po 'du zhing longs spyod pa'i dngos grub bzang po stsal du gsol / zhes pa'i 'dod gsol kha bsgyur cung zad dang / ma bsres pa'i steng du/ 'bru phyes byugs pa'i sgril ba'i phyir spro na 'bru zan gyi dung mgron zhal 'byor rnam par bcos pa dbu zhabs ma log par bcugs/gzungs sdom bsdams/ rab tu gnas pa legs par byas nas/ gzod zhag bdun gyi sgrub pa'i mthar khyad par gyi rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub blang nas 'bru'i bang mdzod khengs pa ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs sam/grub na las bzhi'i maṇḍal khog can yang 'bru'i bong ba ltar bkang pa'i khar 'bru'i tshogs gyi ngar phye'i rten gtor gyi steng du bzhugs su bcug la/ skabs su mchod gtor phul la gsol ba btab/ gsar 'phel gyi phud 'bul rnying pa sogs rang la dgos pa dngos grub tu zhus par bsam zhing / thabs des longs spyod 'bru rnams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur te/ kres stod du dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes sbyar ba'o/ /lhe/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /zhing bsrungs 'dod dgu'i so nam bzhugs/ /rgya gzhung las/ dur khrod bdag po'i yab yum sku/ /ratna
sna tshogs dag la bya/ zhing dkyil bzhugs na lo legs 'gyur/ /rgyud las/ mkhar ba'i sku gzugs zhing dkyil sba/ /lo thog thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum gyi gsang ba'i sku dang rjes su 'brel ba'i las phran 'dir rgyu'i khyad par gyi mkhar ba'am yang na sa 'dzin dkar po mi thub bzang gnyen 'dzoms pa la yang rung ba'i phyir/ gang 'thad gser sogs ratna sna tshogs brdar ba'i phye ma bsres pa la thabs shes kyi sku gzugs phyag tshad dang ldan pa gar bu lugs ma'am/ so btang ba byas pa dag tshon gsol spra tshil la chus byugs la rab tu gnas par bya/ bsgrub pa'i tshe 'dod don rang ngam gzhan gyi don gyi dbye ba so sor phye nas che ge mo'i zhing ga ge mo zhes sogs/ 'di rnams la rtag par brtse ba chen pos lo 'bras phun sum tshogs pa skye zhing smin pa'i mthar longs spyod ma gyur gyi bar du sad ser rtsa chu sogs 'byung pa'i gnod pa dang / 'bu srin bra byi bya dang bye'u ri bong sha rkyang la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba thams cad las bsrung zhing skyobs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'phrin las bcol ba sogs tshul bzhin du byas pa de nyid gang du bya ba'i yul de'i zhing gi dbyibs dang ming bkra legs pa/ yang na ma zhing gtso bor byed pa de'i dkyil du 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i tshe ma sa la thug pa thongs pas mi sleb par lud sogs bsal nas/ der
༄tshi/ /maṇḍal gyi tshad dang ldan pa bsregs blugs kyi dbyibs bzhin zab du brus pa'i nang / zhing gzhan lhag ma rnams kyis kyang sa sna bsdus la bting pa'i khar/ rdo sgrigs kyis las bzhi'i khang sgrom legs par byas pa'i dbus su/ rten gyi zhal bdag po'i phyogs la gzigs par bcug la zhal bsro'i gtor ma phul/ khyad par bzlas pa brgya rtsa gong bzhin 'phrin las bcol nas de'i mu kha'am/ rgud pa'i gtsang sa ser lam sogs gnod phyogs yod na/ der gtor ma zhal bstan la btang / sku rten la brtan bzhugs shis pa brjod sa rdo sogs nang du ma shor pa byas pa'i steng nas rdo leb kyi thog phub sngar bzhin zhing dkyil du sa rdo g.yog la sba ba'i thabs zab mo'i g.yin gyi mi rig pa'i lag tshags dam pos g.yog nas mi mngon par bsgrub na lo tog thams cad du legs shing 'phel bar 'gyur la/ phyis nas kyang kha gso ba'i tshul du lo dgra la sogs pa'i nyes pa'i tshe ched du dmigs pa'i gtor 'bul dang / skabs skabs su bskang bshags kyi rim par ma yengs 'bad pa'i sgo nas rtags tshan bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang dpal bkra shos stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes sbyar ba'o mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i ba mo bzhugs/ / rgyud las/ de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /dur
khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /dkar gsum dag la byas gyur na/ /dkar gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes le'u drug par bshad ma thag pa de nas le'u bcu bdun par las tshogs rgyas pa yang dag par bshad par bya ste / zhes dam bcas pas gang dag gong du bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs su mtshan ltas kyi snang ba thob pa'i thugs dam myur du bskul ba'i ched du mar la sogs pa'i dkar bcud 'phel par 'dod pas dpa' bo chen po dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku mar dkar gyi gzhi la shed 'dzin gyi spra tshil dang tshags su byas pamanyan gyod ji ltar mtshams pa bsres pa'i rgyu las rgyan sprod sogs mtshon gyis bsgyur ba las/ mngon rtogs bzhin phyag tshad dang ldan par bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs su dar dkar la gser gyis sa bon srog snying gi mthar/ che ge mo la tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor khyad par du 'o zho mar 'thud sogs dkar bcud 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i longs spyod kyi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes pa so sor sgril ba'i phyir spros pa la dga' na gnad che bas gong gi rgyud las nor bu dung mgron zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa thugs gar bzhugs/ gzhan yang dkar gsum snying por bsdus pa mtha' dag gis bkang la rab tu gnas pa byas zin pa nyid/ dkar bcud sna tshogs bsdus pa las rten gtor bzhengs pa'i steng du bzhugs/ 'dzin gtor rgyud sogs kyang de
༄tshi/ /mtshungs su bshams nas/ zhag bdun bsgrub pa'i mthar khyad par kyi don ltar dngos grub blang nas mar sgrom gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol ba la / kri dang 'o zho mar 'thud ci yod gsar byung thams cad chos skyong la phul/ rang la dgos dus dngos grub du blangs par bsam la zhusas shing the tshom mi bya bar ci dgos longs spyod/ gsar du 'phel ba thams cad kyi phud dang / rgyun gtor 'bul ba la brtson pas gsol ba btab de ltar 'khrul med du sgrub par gyur na/ dkar bcud kyi tshogs gangs ri'i phung po la longs spyod pa lta bu'i dngos grub myur du thob par gyur ba'i gdams pa gdon mi za ba'i gdams pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba'i gdams pa rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdo khams chen spri shod stod yul gyi sa'i cha gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' kro che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /gter mdzod rin chen 'bar ba bzhugs/ /tsaṇḍa li gang shes rab kyis bskul bas/ /thabs chen haṃ yig zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /myong byed longs spyod 'khor 'o1 rtags babs thabs/ /zab gter man ngag rin chen 'bar ba bshad/ /de yang rgyud las/ thab 'og mda' gang 'og tu ni/ /gru gsum mtho gang brus la bzhugs/ /zas kyi dngos grub ma lus 'phel/ /zhes pa me
thab gang du bca' bar 'dod pa'i 'og gzhi'i sa mthil dngos sam/ gdan khrir brtsigs pa'i rgyar mda' gang gru bzhi zabs su de'i phyed yod pa'i slar ni 'og tu rgyar ni khru gang / zabs su de'i phyed yod pa'i dkyil du gru gsum rtse gcig thab kyi rgyab phyogs la yod par gtad nas/ leb mdun sgo dang zhal g.yas g.yon du 'babs pa'i don yid la bzhag ste/ rgyar phyogs gsum la mtho gang gi zabs su de'i phyed yod pa rnams thur du rim can sar brus la/ dper na sgang gzar 'dra ba'i nang kun khod snyoms zhal ba 'jam por bgyis pa la/ ha shig dkar po'i phye ma'am zhu dkar gyi legs par byugs/ der bzhugs par bya ba dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po yid bzhin nor bu'i sku bya thabs bi shwa'i nyams yig las/ gsang rten gyi skabs su bstan pa'i sa 'jim la bzhengs tshul rin chen brdar ba de kho na ba las/ 'dir ba so sogs rus rigs mi bsre/ gzungs la sogs pa mi dgos te gar bur bsgrub pa po mthong bar byas pa zhu dkar sogs me thugs kyi dkar po byug gzhan spyan dbye rab gnas kyi mthar thug kyang 'dra bar bsnyen sgrub kyi mnga' dbul khyad par gyi gsol 'debs byed mtshungs su btab/ dngos grub ci 'dod pa gtor steng gi bza' bca' las blang zhing rol/ rdza sku spyan drangs/ thab dbus nas zhal sgo phyogs su bstan la/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ gru bzhi'i khyon
༄tshi/ /kheb pa'i rdo g.yam me thub kyi bkab/ steng nas sor tshad bdun gyi 'jim pas g.yogs/ de'i khar ji ltar 'dod pa'i thab sgo zhal phyogs dang mthun par bca'/ gza' skar bzang po 'dzoms pa'i thab 'dul gyi dus la bab pa'i tshe/ zhal spro'i mchod gtor bzang po gcig thab dang zhal sprod du bshams la phul/ tshogs kyi skabs dang sbyar de kha zas kyi bye brag bza' btung sna tshogs der g.yos sbyar du byas te longs spyod pa thams cad kyi phud/ tshogs bdag yid bzhin nor bu la phul pa'i mthus lha'i bza' banyung gi dpal ltar gang 'dod spyad byar gyur ba'i dngos grub stsol bar bsgrub pa po rang nyid lag len byan pho byan mo de yid la bsam pa kho nas rang bzhin gyi g.yang zhag chags la/ ro bcud yid tshim pa gyur pa'i dri ngad tsam gyis mnga' 'grangs shing spyad pas zag med du srid rme ba/ mdor na yid 'dod ma lus pa 'du zhing rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ba dpa' bo'i rgyud don legs par bshad pa man ngag rgya mtsho las/ gter mdzod rin chen 'bar ba zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba byang bdag dpal bkra shos stobs rgyal dbang pos sdes/ ga za'i yul thang skyar gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar du mdzad pa'o/ / lhe/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ chu gtor 'dod yon 'byung gnas bzhugs/ / bde
chen 'chi med babs pa'i bcud/ /stong nyid ro 'dzin 'bar ba'i rtser/ / myong pa ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /chu gtor 'dod yon 'byung gnas bshad/ /de yang gsang rgyud gyi dpe rgyun phal cher du brjod don 'di da lta mi gsal ba bar skabs nas chad dam snyam te/ ci'i phyir rgya bzhung las/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ / gser dngul gyis bris rab gnas bya/ /chu ru'i zhabs su sbas gyur na/ /zas kyi spyan gzigs 'phel bar 'gyur zhes dang / yang na/ gser dang dngul gyis bris nas ni/ rab gnas byas nas chu ru'i zhabs/ /sbas na zas kyi spyan gzigs 'phel/ /zhes pa rnam pa gnyis nas 〉rdzo bstun khrigs chags su byung bas/ bshad gzhi rtsa tshig snying 'bor rgyud du bzhugs par nges pas/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku gtso bor ka ra gu shu'am ma 'byor na ltar kha gang rung gi shing ngam/ lo ma shun pa'i byang bu ji ltar rung ba'i leb la/gzhi'i khyon gser gan 'jam dang yid bzhin nor bu thabs shes dngos kyi snang brnyan dang/ zla gdan thod dbyug gi mtshon kun dngul gyis gang 'jam du byugs te/ gzi ris kyi phyed pa'i rgyan sprod skabs thob rnams su dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i sgron tshon gyis mdzes par skye ba sogs de las gzhan pa'i tshes dus mngon rtogs sogs bris mkhan la bslab byar 'os pa mtha' dag spyan dbye nas rab gnas bya tshul gyi mthar phyin pa'i
༄༅/ /bi shwa'i nyams yig las/ phyi rten skabs su bshad pa ltar bzhengs nas/ brten gtor khar bkod bsnyen pas mnga' dbul/ khyad par gyi 'dod don sgo mtshungs su 'phrin las bcol/ bza' bca' la dngos grub blangs shing sku spyan drangs sta gon du bgyis zin pa'i khri phyi zur brgyad drug bzhi pa gang mdzes 'phrul sgo can phyi rol rgyan spros nang du gzhal yas khang gi ri mo sogs spra rtsis mnan pa nang du chu mi 'gro nges pa'i dbus su bstan pa sgo dang zhal khyim gyi phug mdzod dam thab la legs par bzhugs su gsol ba'i steng / chu ras snod gas chag bug brdol med pa'i zhabs su 'jug pa'i skabs dang sbas zin nas kyang kun gyi shing sku mthong rig tu ma gyur pa shig gal che bas na/ man ngag la brnyas pa mi bya/ de nas chu snod khengs par bkang ba'i phud kyi dang po'i zhal spro ba'i gtor mchod dga' ston tshogs rgya cher 'bul/ phyis kyang snod stong bar yun ring mi bzhag tshul 'dis zas kyi spyan gzigs zhes pa'i tshig 'di gnyis yi ge pas nor bar sems kyi 'dod pa ni g.yos rigs zer ba yin te/ de ltar 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i don to/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las chu gtor 'dod don 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ rigs sngags 'chang ba byang bdag dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang pos sdes ga zi'i yul du gu ru'i padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / rmya/
o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ / rgyan bkod yid 'phrog lcags kyu bzhugs/ /rgyud las/ zhing lpags ta la gang rung la/ /sku bris dpung par btags pa na/ / mthong ba'i mi rnams 'du bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di'i dgongs pa rgya gzhung las/ brjod pa'i don gnyis su bkrol te/ dang po bris gzhi ni/ zhing chen zhes mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mi lpags dang /gnyis pa shing ta la dngos nyid dam/ de ma 'byor na ka ra shing gi lpags pa gang rung ba de dag ngos 'jam por gzhi tha gru snyom pa la/ dpa' bo yab yum gyi sku mngon rtogs ltar bris rdzas kyi khyad par rin po che sna tshogs pa dag gi khu bas mtshon la sbyar ba/ dus sogs lag len spyan dbye rab gnas kyi mthar thug phyi rten bzhengs thabs kyi skabs su bstan pa ltar/ dpa' bo yab yum gyi sku mtheb mtshon gang ba bris pa las/ gzhi dkyil 'khor dbus mnga' dbul 'dod don gsol btab gyi skabs su gong 'og gi dbye ba yang dpa' bo chen po yab yum gyi sku'i snang brnyan 'di nyid/ bdag gam su zhig mgul du 'chang ba'i skyes bu de nyid mthong ba'i mod la 'gro ba mir gyur pa pho mo mtha' dag pa rnams ma bu gcig pa'i 'du shes sam/ dad pa can gyis slob dpon mthong ba bzhin du/ mos pa dang spro ba lhag par 'phel te/ yid nges par 'gyur nas dbang du 'du ba'i phrin
