༄tshi/ /las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang / gnyis par de bzhin las/ mgul du 'chang ba'i zhes pa'i don du dpung par brtags pa'i ces dang / dbang du zhes pa'i mtshams nas 'dus ste yid la gang bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i don de thams cad rtsol med lhun grub du 'grub pa'i zhes pa'i 'don pa bsgyur nas gong ltar 'phrin gsol gyi smon nas phul/ mthar bris sku dngos grub kyi rdzas su spyan drangs la na bza' bcas pa gab rtser bcug dbu zhabs ma logs par sngags 'chang rang nyid dam/ dam tshig dang ldan pa gzhan dag gis gnas so sor bcang pas bsgrub bya'i ji ltar yid gnyis the tshom med par de kho na nyid 'grub par 'gyur pa gnyis ka yang dbang gi las sbyor dpa' bo'i rgyud don no/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ rgyan bkod yid 'phrogs lcags kyu zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes ga zi'i yul chu de la zhes par gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / kyu/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' po che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ / rnam rgyal lha yi gtsug rgyan bzhugs/ /lha mchog dpa' bo'i gtsug gi rgyan bkod pa/ /dmag dpon rin chen dam pa'i dbang bskur ltar/ /rang phyogs rtags par g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /phas rgol lha min pham byed cho ga bshad/ rgyud las/ dur khrod ras la sku
bris te/ /dmag dpon spyi bor brgyan pa na/ /sngags 'bum bzlas na 'khrugs pa rgyal/ /zhes pas dpa' bor dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum mngon rtogs dang mthun par rab sogs nas byung ba'i ras gru bzhi byed dam / zur gcod du bris pa la gong pa phur lces mdzes par byas sku bris te ras 'dul dang bar gzungs ma gtogs gzhan tshes dus gza' skar spyan dbye rab gnas kyi mthar thug lag len mtha' dag phyi rten bzhengs thabs bi shwa'i nyams yig du bstan pa ltar byas la mnga' dbul de dag gi skabs la sogs pa 'diskad do/ /dpa' bo dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum mthu stobs can khyod kyi sku rten dar sku 'di nyid/ dmag dpon che ge mo zhes pa'am gang su zhig phru rgyan gtsug gi nor bu ltar 'ching zhing 'dzin pa'i gtso bo 'bor dmag mi sde dpung dang bcas pa rnams nye bar bsrung zhing skyobs pa khyad par phas rgol zil gyis gnon zhing / rang phyogs stobs dang gzi brjid dpa' rngams bgyid nas g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol zhes mos shing brtson pa lhur blang gis bsgrub na mtshan ltas thob pa'am 'dir khyad par rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum bzlas grangs them par byin gyis rlabs/ dmigs bsal yod na dgra phyogs der gtor ma phul dar 'phru dngos su spyan drangs/ gtso po de'i zhu'am rmog gi 'phru brgyan nam khyung gtor gyi nang du gong pa
༄tshi/ /phyogs nas sgril/ dar sku dngos la mi g.yin gyi reg mi 'jug par bsrung / g.yul 'khrugs gi skabs su 'bral med gtsug tu bcangs pas dmag dpung sde dang bcas pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs las bsrung zhing skyabs te rgyal ba thob par 'gyur la/ gal shin tu che ba na/ 'chang ba po des gtor 'bul bzlas dmigs byed par nus na gdams ngag sbyin pa'amade dag rgyab skyor du rim gro bas 'khrul med du bsgrub rung bslu med gdeng thob kyi gdams pa 'dod don 'grub nas gtang reg gi bskang gso rgya cher gtong / dpa' bo'i rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ rnam rgyal lha'i gtsug rgyan zhes pa rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes sbyar ba'o/ / rmya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo sgo bsrungs bzhugs/ /rgyud las / tsandan dang ni shug pa la/ /dri bzang dag gi sku bris te/ /sgo steng bzhugs na rims nad bsrung / /zhes pas gzhi'i khyad par rab kyi tsandan shin tu bsil ba'i reg bya can nges pas dkar po nyid dang / de nyid 'byor bas dben par gyur na tshab rung ni/ rgya shug gam bod skyes gang rung zhi ba'i kha dog can leb chags su byas pa la/ gla rtsi gu gul/ kha che'i yul nas 'byung pa'i gur gum/ tsandan dkar dmar sogs dri bzang de
dag gi khu ba'i drung chu ngad thon tsam bsres pa'i mtshal gyis dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag po chos skyong yid bzhin gyi nor bu yab yum gyi sku mngon rtogs las byung ba ltar gyi thugs gar bar gzungs dang ldan par bris/steng na chu'am spra tshil byugs la rab tu gnas pa dang / zhal spro ba'i gtor ma bzang sman gyi khyad par du brgyan par bya ba'i mchod pa 'bul 'dod don ltar gsol ba btab/ a ru gser mdog gam/ gu gul la dngos grub blang rjes rang gzhan rgyu lam gyi sgo steng du bzhugs nas khang bur byas pa'am/ yang na bsrung khrag dkar por bcug nas gzhan gyi mi reg pa'i thabs dang ldan pas zhal nang phyogs la bstan la btags/ 'phrin las bcol gyi gtor ma phul/ sku tshad ni sor gang nas brgyad kyi bar ji ltar 'tshams par sbas/ de bas khyad par du byas pa rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa yin la/ dang por bzhengs pa'i dus tshes sogs tpū rten gyi skabs bzhin las/ 'di'i bcas kyi skabs mgo 'bags nad dri can sogs spangs nas nad bsrung spyi'i don bzhin/ tho rangs kyi char byas na legs so/ /des ni tshad rims sogs nad mtha' dag gi 'jigs pa las skyobs par byed pa'o/ /rgyud don man ngag legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ stobs ldan dpa' bo'i sgo bsrung zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / mya/
༄༅/ /o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po gsang rgyun don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /yid bzhin tshe sbyin 'bor lo bzhugs/ /gti mug rnam dag rab spangs dpa' bo che/ /dpal ldan yid bzhin tshe yi dngos grub mdzod/ / ci 'dod sbyin mdzad 'khor lo'i rigs bdag can/ /don gnyis mthar phyin 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /rgyud las/ dur khrod ras la bris pa ni/ /dkyil 'bor steng du bla bre bya/ /rang gzhan gnyis kyi bar chad bsrung / /zhes pas dpa' bo rus can g.yul ngor bsad pa'i gos dur khrod nas blangs pa'i ras dkar po la yar ngo rgyal gyi dus tshod dang po nas rtsams 'dul sbyangs byas pa la che chung ji ltar 'dod pa'i phyogs zur mnyam pa la bris/ zhes gang bris pa'i nges bzung ma bstan pa yang sbas pa'i don te/ rnam pa ni mu khyud gsum ldan lte bar byas pa'i dkyil yangs bar gru bzhi gnyis brtsegs 'khor lo'i rtsibs ltar rang grub tu byung ba'i zur brgyad/ lte bar yid bzhin nor bu yab yum gdan pad khrag mtshor bcas pa'i 'bar ba'i klong du bskyed pa mngon rtogs bzhin dang/ rtsibs 'dra zur gsum brgyad kyi nang phyogs bzhir nor bu dbang gi rgyal po re re dang / mtshams bzhir mig gsum 'bar ba re re/ mu khyud nang mar yig mgo dbus phyogs nas brtsams nas rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ bdag sgrub po che ge mo zhes bya bas dam tshig can gyi
'khor dang bcas pa rnams dus ma yin pas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung zhing skyobs par mdzad du gsol/ ma ma rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ ces dang / bar la oX yig nas brtsams dbyangs gsal mthar swā hā/ gsum par rdo rje 'phreng ba'i phyir me ri 'bar bas bskor ba gser ram rgya snag gis byas te gnas kyi tshul du rnam pa sbas pa de nyid spyan dbye rab tu gnas nas rten gtor steng du thang pa stabs su bkram la/ bsnyen sgrub gyi mnga' dbul dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs tshe srog gi bar chad thams cad las bsrung zhing skyob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyi 'phrin las bcol / tshe ril la dngos grub blangs/ bla re spyan drangs/ dang po rten dngos bstan nyid gang du sdod pa'i mal steng du bkram la dar dkar zhal khebs sba ba'i thabs su byas/ 'dzul chog 'khor lo de'i phan yon ni sngags 'chang rang nyid zhes pa gzhan 'khor dang bcas pa gnyis ga'i dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs tshe dang srog gi bar chad sogs thams cad las nges bar bsrung bar 'gyur ba'i man ngag dpa' bo'i rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ 'dzul chog yid bzhin 'khor lo zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdo khas ga ze'i char gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du shing bya sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig la sbyar ba'o/ /
༄tshi/ /mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' rbo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /srid spel zla ba'i chu rgyun bzhugs/ /rgyud las/ gser dang g.yu yi bris pa'i sku/ /pha ma gnyis la bsnol mar btags/ /lte ba bsgyur la rigs brgyud 'phel/ zhes pa rgyu'i khyad par gser sbyangs kho na bas/ yab yum 'khril sbyor gcig dang / gser g.yu zangs gsum rigs gang yang rung ba brdar ba'i khu bas kyang de bzhin bris byas pa'i dpa' bo yab yum gyi bris sku bshad pa'i go rim phyi ma de skye ba dang / dang po gser gyi de shes rab ma gnyis la go ldog te/ bsnol mar dbu zhabs ma log par ga'u 'am phyin thum bsrung khug bzang por bcug nas so so'i mgul du 'bral med btags par byas pa'i bris gzhi dur khrod kyi ras la tshes dus sogs rab gnas kyi mthar thugs rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar/ dkyil 'khor du bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs khyad par can gyi gsol btab/ med pa btsal dang lte ba bsgyur ba sogs gang 'dod kyi 'phrin las bcol zhing rten la dngos grub blangs/ spyan drangs bsgrub bya la gzhan gyi ma tshor bar 'chang du bcug pas rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ba dpa' bo'i rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ srid spel zla ba'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes dmar khams go rgya'i yul
mtha' kho thang gi sar gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar du hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes drug gi nyin sbyar ba'o/ / rmya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'du byed chos kyi dung sgra bzhugs/ /rgyud las/ yab yum sku ni rgyab yol nang / /sbas na tshogs gsogs 'khor g.yog 'phel/ /zhes pas chos skyong yab yum gyi sku 'bur dod du bzhengs pa'i shes byed can de ni/ nges par gsang rten dang 'brel ba'i las yin pas/ de yang bi shwa'i nyams yig las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar/ zhes grangs dus dang gza' skar de nyid ji lta ba las/ rgyu'i khyad par yang 'di ni dman pa lta bu'i nyes skyon du mi 'gyur yang sgrub pa bde ba'i rgyud don dngos bstan/ rin chen sna tshogs pa phye ma 'jam dang slar tshon rtsis kyang bsres pa'i dbyibs kyang der bshad pa bzhin/ spyan dbye ba'i dga' ston rab tu gnas pa'i mthar phyin du bgyis te mnga' gsol/ mtshan ma thob nas dngos grub du dkyil 'khor steng nas rten blang la/ gzhan gyis ma mthong bar spyan drangs la sta gon du bgyis zin pa'i chos ris mdun pa'i gdan khri rgyab yol lam/ snyel 'bol gyi dbus sam/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng thad du skye tshang gi nang dri bzang gi byugs par bzhugs su gsol/ zhal pa byed dam kheb gyis bkab pa'i sgrib g.yog steng mdzes byed du/ chos kyi dung ngam 'bor lo gaṇḍi
༄tshi/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs ci rigs bkod pa sbas na/ dam ldan gyi slob bu grwa tshogs sogs khong du bsdus pa pho mo'i dbye ba dang 'khor 'bangs bran g.yog gang 'du bar 'dod pa'i bsgyur gang bde dper brjod na 'di ltar/ khyad par du yang rten 'di gang bzhugs kyi chos grwa chen po 'dir spyir 'dzam bu gling gi sa chen po'i 'khor yug tshun rgya dkar nag tu gtogs pa'i yul gru spyi dang bye brag khyad par kha ba'i ljongs stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum gyi yul nas las 'phro skal ba dang ldan pa skyes bu dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi snod du gyur ba'i tshogs rnams 'jig rten chos brgyad rnam g.yeng gi bya ba las blo ldog 'khor ba'i tshul las nges par 'byung ba skad cig la bskyed de/ dad cing spro bas brtson pa lhur blang nas gsang chen ston pa'i gdung gsob/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas sogs kyi rjes 'jug gsang sngags rnying ma'i bka' gter gyi bstan pa'i sgo der 'jug pa dang zhugs nas ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde chen po 'du ba dang dar zhing rgyas la smin pa'i 'bras bu yun ring du gnas pa'i dngos grub chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes pas dang po'i don te/ phyi ma rnams la yang des mtshon pa'i 'dod smon kha bsgyur bas ci bsam yongs su 'du zhing 'phel rgyas byed pa'i gdams pa bka' rgya'i zhal shes gcig kho
na ma gtogs pa yongs rdzogs ston par byed pa/ 'du byed chos kyi dung sgra zhes bya ba rig sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra lhas stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes ga zi'i yul gu ru padma'i e waX lcogs sgar du sbyar ba'o/ / lhe/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /kha 'chings gser gyi 'khor lor bzhugs/ / gu ru padma sirnyi hūṃX hrīX dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ stag gzig la sogs gcan gzan gyi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di la the tshom bya mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa dngos bstan stag dang gzig gzhan yang dom dred 'phar spyang khyi la drasnags pa'i gcan gzan gyi rigs mtha' dag ji 'dra zhig gis kyang / bdag dang bdag gir bzung ba'i 'khor dang nor phyugs su bcas par gnod cing 'tshe bas nyen par gyur pa na/ gnyen po rten 'brel gyi rdzas/ sha ba'i rwa yi mdun ngos su 'byung ba/ khyi len zhes brda' chad du grags pa g.yas g.yon gnyis la sdom byed skam pa'i dbyibs su byas pa'i khar/ bcings bya dug phre(ga gi gzhir stag la sogs pa gang byed kyi gzugs lte phyir byung ba'i kha mchu dang yan lag rdo rje'i zhags pas bsdoms te/ nyam thag pa'i rnam pa can/ bu ga nas khrag dang dri ma 'dzag pa'i dbyibs kyi lce'i dkyil du thod dbyug gnyis bsnol rgya grams gyi mtshan ma'i gzugs kyi khog par gnod cing
༄tshi/ /'tshe bar byed pa'i gcan gzan stag gi rnam shes 'dir khug dzaXdzaXgacan gzan che ge mo'i kha 'chings gcan gzan che ge mo'i kha bsdoms/ zhes gzugs dang mthun par ming bsgyur/ mthar dza khram gyis bskor ba bris/ 'byung bas bsangs sbyangs/ dmigs bya'i sbar rjes sam/ tshangs sgo'i sa brun la sogs pa rnyed na las rno zhing myur bas/ gzugs dang ming yig thad dang rang bshad kyi dug chus sngags dang thod dbyug zhags pa rnams la byugs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsgrub bya rnams yang yang bkug la ming gzugs bstims/ oX zhes pa'i 'tshams 'dir rtsa ba'i sngags zhes 'og tu bstan pa'i don yig 'bru gsum gnyis drug dang gnyis gsum drug dang / gnyis gsum tsheg bar bcu gnyis spras pa de dag bcug pa'i zhabs la sngon du bshad pa'i gcan gzan kha chings gcan gzan kha sdoms kha bsgyur du bstan pa sdeb pa'i mthar las kyi sham bu btags pa brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas/ thun rdzas nyungs dkar dug phye bye bsreg la mngon par sngags pas brab/ phyag mtshan gyi bsnun zhing bsgrub/ las la sbyar rjes so sor gan log tu btab/ rim par brtsegs pa'i phye rdo mthong ngam/ shing tshon nam gang rung gis byugs pa'i shog bu nar mo bris zin gyi gzhi la/ gser sbyangs kyi khu bas yi ge dbu can du byas nas snying po'i sngags/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum dris gcan gzan kha
chings / gcan gzan kha sdoms/ bhanta bhanta swā hā/ zhes phreng gcig tu bris pas bcings la ro ras kyi bsdum/ ras bal skud pa dkar pos dkris/ ro skam gyi khar ljags steng nas shing thim bcug go /phyin chad gnod pas nyen pa'i tshe'am gal che ba'i tshe/ las sbyor kha gso ba'i tshul du sgrub par bya ba gong ltar thun dang phyag mtshan sogs kyi rgyas par spro'am/ lag len sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin snying por dril ba gca' gzhi de nyid du btus rnams gnod bya dngos su gsal ba/ mun pa'i gling zhes lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du 'chang bar bsdoms la/ thim zhing ma gtogs mi mngon par sbas/ zhags pas gru gu ltar bcings nas 'gul du mi nus par bsam pa dang / bsam pa phyag mtshan dngos su thod dbyug du dmigs pa la tha na khu tshur gyi phyag rgya la rten pas mtshon te/ rang nyid dpa' bo yab yum sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yul phyogs 'di'i gnod byed/ so so bkag nas ming gzugs la bstim/ stobs nus bcings shing brdung bas myos shing rmugs par gyur te/ 'gul mi nus par bsam zhing / sngags brgya rtsa re bzlas la thim shing gi rdo rje rtse nas rdeg tshul kyi las la sbyar rjes rgyun chings su zhags pas bsdoms la tshegs bya/ khyad par sgrub pa po stag sogs dang thug phrad du 'dzoms pa'am 'di la brten nas khyi bsrung byed kyang the tshom mi bya bar thog brdzis byas la
༄tshi/ /steng du 'gro'o/ /de ltar gnad dang ldan pas lag len du 'bad par gyur na gcan gzan gdug pa can rnams kyi kha bcings/ gdod mi za ba nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ba 'khrugs sdebs gab sbas kyi don gsal bar lag len du gtan la phab pa/ rgyud don legs bshad rgya mtsho las mche sder gyi kha 'chings gser gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes gu ru padma'i e waX lcog sgar du sbyar ba'o mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'chings gsum don yod zhags pa bzhugs/ rgyud las/ chom rkun 'chang ba'i man ngag ni chu yi gseg ma la sogs pa/ /dbyug tho'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas/ / bdag dang rdzas la phyogs bcur gtor/ /chom rkun 'chings zhes gsol ba btab/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi nas/ /yab yum gar byed 'gro bar bsam/ /gnas su phyin nas ting 'dzin glod/ /de yi 'jigs pa kun las thar/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ keX rus gzugs can khro bo yi/ /phyag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon zhags pa/ /bsnams pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /cha byad can gyis stong gsum gang / /thams cad zil gyis gnon byed cing / /yan lag dbang po bcings bar bsam/ /zhes gong 'og tu tshan pa gnyis su 'thor ba bsdus/ dkrugs pa
bsdebs gab pa gsal nas chom rkun bcings pa'i thabs man ngag gi mtshan nyid nges par bstan pa ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blangs te/ dang por gtor ma phul/ chu yi 'gram gyi rdo seg gam/ bye ma gang rung la sogs kyi khong nas bsdus pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gzhan gyi ma reg par thabs bzang pos blangs nas dbyug tho'i snying po yig 'bru bco lnga ba'i sham bur tsheg par bcu gnyis ba sbyar ba/ brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis po bzlas pa sngags zin bdag des rten sogs nor rdzas dang 'bor g.yog tshun mdor na bsrung byar gyur pa kun la cung zad re phog par lhan cig steng 'og phyogs mtshams phyogs bcur 'thor ba'i tshe/slar yang rtsa sngags dang / chom rkun 'ching zhes gsol ba btab pa'i don/ ma hā tha nu chom rkun bhanta bhantaswā hā/ zhes pa brjod cing yi dam lhar gsal ba'i 'grub tshan sogs skyabs bya de thams cad dkyil du bcug pa'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi nas keX rus kyi gzugs can gtum khro rngams pa'i dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo gnyis ka phyag g.yas 'joms byed dbyug tho dang / g.yon 'ching byed zhags pa bsnams pa'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ brkyangs bskums gar gyi las mdzad ji lta ba dngos 'dra'i cha byad can gyi sprul ba bye ba dpag tu med pa stong gsum gang ba'i gnod byed dgra rkun jag pa thams cad ril gyis gnon par byed cing /
༄༅/ /dbang po lnga sgrib myos par byas shing yan lag nying lag stobs nus bsam sbyor 'gyur dran byed pa kun bcings par bsam/ dgra rkun gnyis kyis dbye ba tho rangs sam srod dus bgyi ba sngon 'gro'i bsnyen pa'i tshul gzod dngos gzhi sgrub pa rgyun chags kyi tshul rdzas gong ma nyer spyod kyi yul du ma gyur na/ de ga'i mdo skabs su ci bab pa'i sa rdo bye ma la sogs las phan tshun mi khyi'i ma rdzis pa gtsang ngam snyams pa zhig khyad par du bzung ste blang ba la sngags shing gtor bas/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum sprul tshogs gar byed kyi stabs su bskyod cing rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs ldan du 'gro bar brtson pas bskor ba'i sku las spros pa'i bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshub pas/ phyi rol lcags ri'i gur khang ltar bsgrigs pa'i dbus rang 'khor dang bcas pa bde bar skyobs shig sdong grogs kyi dbye ba med par 'grogs par bsam la 'gro'o/ /sngags bzlas byed thabs de kun shum bu dang thabs zab grogs kyis ma tshor ma rig par byed pa ni man ngag tu byed pa'i don/ rgya bod gzhung dang bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las rnyed go bder bkrol nas bshad pa'o/ /rjes sam las sbyor bsdu ba'i tshul la gtong thabs kyi gnas su slebs nas/ ting nge 'dzin glod zhes pa shin tu gces pas yig rnying sogs gang du'ang dngos bstan bshad par 'phangs te zhal shes su bzhag pa ltar re zhig bka' rgya can du bsam
nas de ltar nyams su blangs ba yis/ /'jigs pa de kun las thar ba'i/ /ngo mtshar lo rgyus bshad pa bzhin/ /dbang po sde yi nyams myong nas/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'ching gsum don yod zhags pa brtsams/ /maṅga lem/ / mya/ o rgyan gling gi zhing skyong che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las rgyun gtor 'phrin las myur bskul bzhugs/ /'doX da don 'khri ba rtsad nas ma chod pa'i/ /'doX da don rgyun gyi gtor ma la brten nas/ /'doX da pa'i yon tan ma lus sgrub pa'i phyir/ /'doX da don 'phrin las myur bskul cho ga bshad/ /de yang rgyud las/ gtor mas dkon mchog mchod par bya/ /de 'og chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la dur khrod gyi/ /sha za bdag po yab yum sbyar/ /i dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi/ /zhes pa lan bdun dag gi phul/ /gsol na 'phrin las ci bsgo byed/ /zhes pas rang nyid rgyun gyi rnal 'byor rim gnyis gang byed rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bas gtor mas mnyes par dka' ba dkon pa'i 'du shes kyi dran par nye bar yid bzhag ste/ mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin rtsa ba gsum mnyes pa'i mchod par bya sngon 'gror bgyis nas/ de yi 'og rol tu khyad chos su bstan pa chang bu'i bha ling gi chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu
༄༅/ /yab yum la mchod gtor myur 'gyogs su 'bul bar 'dod pas/ bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal bas/ /thugs ga'i hūm̐X las rim bzhin du/ /e yaṃ ra sum keX raṃ bhrūṃ/ /yongs gyur mkha' dbyings rlung gi dkyil khrag mtsho zhing gi sa gzhi brdal/ /keX rus ri rab lhun sdug po/ /raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /lte bar bhrūṃ las gzhal g.yas khang / /'khor yug dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /mtshan nyid ldan pas bskor ba'i dbus/ /keX rus thod pa'i gur khang nang / /khrag zhag sna tshogs padma dang / /nyi zla bam ro bsnol ba'i steng / /hūṃX dang e las dung mgron gnyis/ /sa bon mtshan pa yongs gyur las/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /'bar ba'i keX rus mche ba gtsigs/ /phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba 'phyar/ /g.yon pa thod khrag zhal du gsol/ /skam rlon cod paṇa do shal dang / /lhan cig rin chen sna tshogs las/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs mdzes par brgyan/ /gnyis med shes rab yum chen mo/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mtshungs/ /'jigs rung sha za yab yum ni/ /brkyang bskums gar gyi gdug pa 'dul/ /'bar ba'i dbus bzhugs sprul 'khor bran/ /gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs gnas su/ /oX āXhūm̐X dang sa bon las/ /'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems/ /rang bzhin gnas dang dur khrod brgyad/ /na lent+ra dang rdo rje
gdan rnga yab gling phran laṅga'i yul/ /o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas/ /dpal ldan chos skyong dur khrod bdag /yid bzhin nor bu yab dang yum/ /sprul 'khor bran bcas spyan 'dren gshegs/ /dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du/ /brtan bzhugs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhes/ /rdo rdze rnal 'byor mas rjes bzung / /padma badzra rtsal la sogs/ /paṇa chen rakṣa'i ta'i mthar thugs/ /grub brnyes rgya gar brgyud pa dang / /bsgyur mdzad khams pa sga lo sogs/ /rim brgyud rtsa pa'i bla ma'i bka'/ /nyer bsgos dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /ji ltar bcol pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /raṃ yaṃ khaṃ las me rlung chus/ /dngos 'dzin dri ma bsreg gtor bkrus/ /yang na a mṛ ta yis bsangs/ /oX āXhūm̐X hos rim bzhin du/ /stong bar sbyangs shing thod pa'i snod/ /yangs shing rgya cher dgra bgegs kyi/ /sha khrag sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ /phyag rgya bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/ /oX yig nas bzung rtsa ba'i sngags/ /yongs rdzogs mjug la dur khrod kyi/ /sha za yab yum bdag por sbyar/ /i dam ba lang ta khā hi/ /rgyud las dngos bstan de lta 'am/ /shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā bi sha tsi/ i dam ma hā bha linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes/ rim par dpal ldan chen po dang / /bzhes sam rol zhes nan tan du/ /spros pa rgya gzhung dgongs pa ltar/ / legs sbyar skad dam bsgyur ba nyid/ /ci 'dod lo
༄tshi/ /tswa'i yig rgyun bzhin/ /pad skor thal sbyar kha phye bas/ /lan gyi grangs bdun dag gis bsngos/ /rtsa sngags mjug la addhi sogs/ /phyag rgya bcas pas phyi mchod dang / /bha ling tshab du 'don pa bsgyur/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ /de bzhin ma hā rakta khā hi/ /sbyar nas lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis/ / mtheb srin rtse sbyar gyen gtor phul/ /yab yum zhal gyi 'od zer gyis/ /gsol nas 'khor bcas dgyes tshim gyur/ /dpal chen spyan sngar rang dam bcas/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes nyer dgongs la/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung der 'dzin skyong / /bdag nyid 'bor dang bcas pa la/ /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med bsgrub/ /khyad par yid la ci 'dod pa/ /bka' bsgo 'don bsgyur gang bcol las/ /byed par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ /dper na 'bral med bsrung zhing skyobs/ /gnod byed dgra jag chom rkun 'chings de bzhin bye brag tshig 'phrad sbyor/ /bstod pa dkyil 'khor dang zhing khams/ /tshul la sbyar ba rnams pa gnyis/ /'di sbyar rgyas 'bring bsdus skabs su/ /hūm̐X e/ srid gsum phyogs mtshams gnas dang yul dur khrod/ /bstan pa yongs kyi tshogs bdag gsang ba'i mgon/ /keX rus gzugs can rang 'dra'i sha za dang / /zung 'jug sprul pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mor bstod/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo ma lus kun khyab par/ /rgyu yi byed
po a haṃ 'bar 'dzag las/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen ye shes sems/ /mnyam nyid chos sku'i thig ler phyag 'tshal bstod/ / phyi nang las bzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor du/ /dpal chen yab yum gnyis med gar mdzad gtso/ /rnam dag rgyan bcas yongs rdzogs mthu stobs kyi/ /bstan bsrung chos skyong yid bzhin nor bur bstod/ /gtor ma phyir bzlog bzlas dmigs grangs/ /brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol la sogs pa/ /'jug don gnas skabs 'phrul shes bya/ /dpa' bo'i gsang rgyun snying 'khor don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ rgyun gtor 'phrin las myur bskul zhes/ sngags 'chang dbang po'i sde yis sbyar/ maṅga laṃ 7/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' kro che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /dur khrod bdag po'i bstod bskul bzhugs/ /bla ma lha la phyag 'tshal lo 'di yig rnying zhig yin pa 'dra/dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /g.yas pa dbyug tho 'bar ba thogs// g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang thogs/ /keX rus gar byed mche ba gtsig /brkyangs bskum gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par byed/ / log 'dren 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /dgra rnams 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rus rgyan mig khro zhing / /bzhad
༄tshi/ /cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las brtson zhing / /rnal 'byor bar chad sel la bstod/ /gang gi sgrub cing mchod pa la/ /shes rab spel zhing nor gter lha/ /bar chad chom rkun 'chings byed pa'i/ /dngos grub ster la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /e ka sa ra mthu mo che/ /yab dang seṅge 'khril rgyan gyis/ /shes rab chags pa'i nyams can la/ /gsang ba'i lha mo khyod la bstod/ /bdud rtsi'i sman dang rakta'i zor/ /dam rdzas sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra/ / sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan gyis/ /dur khrod gnas bsrung mnyes gyur cig /bstan pa der 'dzin skyes pu dang / /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bar chad log 'dren byed pa rnams myur bar dam bcas bzhin du sgrol/ /mdor na byang chub ma thob par/ /lam gyi bgegs sel chom rkun 'chings/ /mnga' thang bskyed la bsod nams spel/ /bcol ba'i las 'di bsgrub par mdzod/ /dur khrod bdag po bstod bskul lo/ /sa ma ya sra mi thi/ shu bhe/ / mya/ o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ / gab 'grol kun bzang sprin phung bzhugs / bla ma che mchog he ru ka nyid dang / /gnyis su med la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod bdag po gsang ba snying 'khor gyi/ /rgyud las dus bzang dus su mchod byas la/ /gsol ba btab la dngos grub
blang zhes pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu yab yum gnyis kyi sku/ /mdun du bsam par bya ba'i don ji ltar/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i tshad ldan bris byas la/ /de mthar mchod pa rnam lnga bshams pa'i tshul/ /khrag gi mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /a ka ru ni dkar dang nag gang rung / /du ru ka zhes dri ldan shing smug khra/ /de'i thang chu yin smra tshwa ba hya/ /gang rung nyid dang gu gul nag po dang / /bcas pa bdug spos bsgyur sngags zhun mar me tsandan dkar dang dmar po kha che sogs/ /bsags pa dri bzang sbyar ba'i dung chos chab/ /de rnams tshogs tshad legs bsags bdud rtsi'i zas/ /'o ma zho bzang mar te dkar sna gsum/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang ste mngar sna gsum/ /'bras gro sha chang la sogs g.yos su sbyar/ /rnam par dag pa'i tshogs rdzas rgya chen po/ /mchod sprin mngon par bshams shing khyad par du/ /gtor ma gsum zhes brten rdzas rgyun pa ste/ /mchod pa dus drug phyir na yig chung don/ /sman dang rakta chang phud bcas pa bshams/ /dkyil 'khor phal cher bsnyen sgrub dus bzhin la/ /bri ba'i khyad par mtshams bzhi rin po che/ /logs bzhir g.yung drung 'khyil ba re re bris bskyed chog dus su g.yung drung ris bzhi po/ /de dag re re la yang dur khrod kyi/ /bdag po yab yum gnyis po las byed bsam/ /bdag dang mdun bskyed steng gi bar snang la/ /sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi
༄༅/ /dam lha/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnam pa gnyis kyi tshogs/ / gtso bo g.yas g.yon bsam pa de dag rnams/ /spyan drangs mngon du bzhugs la yan lag bdun/ /las byang tshogs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ /tshar gcig bya zhing rang gi lus longs spyod/ /dus gsum dag du bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /thams cad dpal ldan dur khrod kyi bdag por/ /yab yum gnyis la dbul sogs de bzhin no/ /srod la tshogs 'khor phud rnams bla ma dang / /dur khrod bdag po yab yum rnam la 'bul/ /rang rang ngoms pa nyid du tshim par bya/ /gtor ma gsum ni rten la dngos grub blangs/ /bzung ba po de dngos btang rgyun ma yin/ /gnyis btang bzhi rol yig chung gab pa'i don/ /de gsal 'dod don sprin phung dag tu shes/ / gshegs su gsol ba'i brda chad de yin la/ /dus bzang nya stong drug ste de rnams la/ / mtshams re bya zhes gsungs pa'i don de yang / /dper na tshes gcig nyin par yo byad bshams/ /srod la mtshams bcad tshes gnyis nam langs nas/ /thun gyi mgo bzung tho rangs mthar zhag gcig /kun gyi nyi ma shar ma thag de nas/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i dmigs gnad la 'jug cing / /res gza' zhes pa bdun gyi grangs la dgongs/ / zhag gi nges pa gab pa de yi rigs/ /mdun bskyed dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyis/ /sbyor ba'i mtshams nas 'od zer kha dog lnga/ /'phro
ba'i byang sems dkar dmar gnyis re byon/ /de nyid rang gi lce thog tu byon nas/ /rtsa sngags bzlas pa zhag bdun bcu bzhi'am/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig dag gi bar du bgrangs/ /yab yum rgyud ltar mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i sku tshad sor gcig mtshan nyid ldan par bris/ /dngos grub blang zhing nu ma g.yon pa'i thog /mdzes pa'i snod bcug 'bral med nyid du btags/ /de nas rgyun du dus bzang brgyad ga'am/ /de yi gang rung skya rengs shar tsam nas/ /rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar gtor stegs bzhugs pa la/ /brgya rtsa gcig gi bzlas dmigs byas pa'i mjug /g.yas su bskor ba gsum nyid bya ba dang / /lha la phyag gsum byas la sngar bzhin bcings des ni chos skyong bdag la dga' zhing ches/ /'gu par gyur nas 'khu ldog 'da' mi nus/ /dbang du 'du ba la sogs thabs yin no/ /rgyun don dus bzang mchod pa'i yig chung gi/ /gab 'grol kun bzang sprin phung dpe gsal 'di/ /bsrung mas nyer skyongs sngags 'chang dbang po sdes/ /kaXthog rdo rje gdan gyi yang dben mgul/ /padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar gnas su sbyar/ / tha) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ / ngo mtshar spro ba'i rba rlabs bzhugs/ /gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐X hrīX gsang chen rgyud sde nor bu'i 'byung gnas las/ /khyad par spro ba'i lhag bsam gru bskyod
༄༅/ /pas / / rgyun mi chad pa'i rba rlabs 'phreng ba ltar/ /zung du ldan pa'i ngo mtshar 'di na ko /de yang dpa' bo'i gsang rgyud las/ rgyun du srog gi snying po bzlas/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /zhes pas/rgyun mi chad par dus drug du thugs dam bskang zhing / nyams chags gso ba'i las rim la brtson pa lhur len gyi sgo nas/ sngags thun bzung ba'i phyag khrid rgyud don legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng mngon par g.yo ba zhes bya ba nyams su blangs ba la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes so/ sngon 'gro sbyor ba bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i rtsa bar bstan pa'i lhun po'i dpal la 'dod yon gyi sprin phung rnam par spro zhing / dgos 'dod kyi char 'bab te/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i dgyes pa bskyed zin ma thag dngos gzhi gsang snying le'u dang po'i gleng gzhi'i skabs las 'byung ba srog gi snying po mdongs gsol du phul ba'i tsheg par bco brgyad pa'i 'bru gsum dor nas 'dzab dngos ni dmigs pa gsal 'debs kyi don du 'di ltar/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpa' bo chen po dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i sa bon hūm̐X dang e yig gis so so'i mdun nas brtsams te/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ zhes yig 'bru bco lnga'i 'phreng ba klog phyogs su bskor
ba la phog chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul bas zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol zhing khyad par bdag cag dpon slob mi nor rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag dang bcas pa bsrung bar gyur pa'i mdun rgyab 'khor yug kun du sprul pa'i keX rus kyi gzugs can/ las byed gar mdzad thod dbyug dang zhags pa 'dzin pa bye ba dpag tu med pa'i bka' 'khor yang sprul dregs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad 'jigs gzugs pho nya cho 'phrul sna tshogs su ston zhing bran g.yogs bgegs rigs bya dang gcan gzan rnams pa ji snyed 'phur lding 'dzul 'phyo'i rgyug par byed pa de dag kun kyang dgra bgegs kyi sha la za shing khrag dang chu ser 'thung ba rus pa mur zhing rkang dang klad pa ldag pa/ lha ba 'jib cing lpags 'then nang khrol dbang po 'dren pa/ stobs ldan me rlung 'tshub pa'i dkyil nas mngon par rgyu bar byed pa/ de dag thams cad kyis nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par spangs bya'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs las bdag cag dmigs yul rnams bsrungs zhing skyobs pa'i mel tshe la brtson zhing / gnod par sems pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod gdon bgegs dgra jag chom rkun bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa thams cad gang la gang mtshams pa'i chad pas gcod pa dang / stobs nus dbang po yan lag bcings pa'i 'phrin las thogs med du mdzad par gyur zhes
༄tshi/ /ting nge 'dzin de lta bu dang ldan pa'i snga dro'i bzlas thun 'dzin pa pos gung thun gyi 'phrin las bcol skabs la ma slob bar du skyon bcu spangs ba'i sgo nas sngags rgyun bzung / grogs bskang rgyun pas dgos pa 'dzab brgya rtsa re bgrangs nas 'phrin las bcol las mjug mthar brkyangs la/ mtshams der ci bde ba'i rigs nas gung thun gyi skabs la babs pa na/ gzhung bsrang sngags 'bul zin ma thag gung 'dzab len pa pos gong du bstan pa bzhin/ dmigs pa gsal 'debs kyi tshig ngag 'don du grub 'phral der 'phreng chen blangs nas gung thun 'dzin pa pos g.yal dang sbrid pa'i mthar thug tu skyon spangs ba'i sgo nas dgong thun gyi 'phrin las bcol mtshams la ma thug bar du sngags 'dren la 'bad/ grogs bskang rgyun pas dgos 'dzab brgya rtsa c-i 'grub rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bzlas mtshams dgong thun 'dzin pa po dang lhan cig 'phrin las bcol ba sogs mthar skyong / srod thun spod len rigs 'dre bar rtogs sla la/ de dag gi skabs sbyar tshogs mchod sbrel ma byed tshe bsgral las mkhan po sngon du bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams thems zin nam/ gsar bzhugs yin na bzlas thun bzung zin chog gzhung skyong ba po des bya la/ sngags dang skad rgyun chabs gcig tu dgos pa rgyud dang rgya gzhung dgongs don phyin ci ma log par lhag chad nor ba'i skyon dang bral ba'i 'dir
'jug pa'i sngags 'chang sgrub pa po ni bdun nam/ lnga gang mtshams kyis bdun phrag re re'i mtshams kyi bcad rgya la gnas pas/ 'di ltar 'khrul med du brtson pas phan yon ni/ lus dang grib ma 'bral ba med pa bzhin du dpa' bo yab yum gyi skad cig kyang 'bral ba med par sdong grogs tshul bzhin du mdzad pa'i mthus/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bzhed don yid la ci bsam 'grub par gdod mi za ba ste/ rjes kyi bya ba bsnyen bsgrub rnam bzhi las tshogs nyer gcig gong dang 'bral ba de lta nyid du rig par bya'o/ /bsgom ming ba phug 'dzin pa'i dgos ser can/ /bcu phigs sgra ltar sgrogs pa'i ngang tshul ba/ /thun rgyun 'dzin zhes dreg ldan mang mchis kyang / /shes byed rgyad gzhung khungs thub 'di ltar med/ /de skad ban khar zhes pa'i khams yul stod/ /gu ru padma'i e waṃ lcogs sgar du/ /dpa' bos rjes bzung sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /bkra shos stobs rgyal dbang pos sbyar ba'o/ / 7/ tha)) o rgyan gling gi dpa' kro che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /rnam bshad nyin byed 'bor lo bzhugs/ /rgyud don rgya zhung lo tsā ba'i/ /da la'i bris bkod sbas dkrugs kun/ /ma nor lag len 'di lta ste/ /rgyud las dbus kyi gru gsum pa/ /thun mong tsam du bstan pa des/ /bsnyen bsgrub dngos grub blang skabs su/ /rnam snang gsung gi
༄tshi/ /zhal gdams las/ / rgyu ni rin che sna tshogs pas/ /dngos sam bsres pa'i bris bkod dbyibs/ /re khā gru bzhi'i rnam pa gnyis/ /bsnol mar brtsigs 'dra'i zur gsum pa/ /phyogs mtshams rtse bstan rtsibs lta bu/ /brgyad la nang du rin po che/ /phyir bstan 'bar ba'i gzugs re dang / /lte bar khyad chos rin po che/ /bye brag dpa' bo yab yum rten/ /dung dang mgron bu dngos sam gzugs/ /bris bkod kha sprod blos blangs te lha gnyis zhal sbyor don yin phyir/ /dung mgron gan skyal 'jug dbus 'dzoms/ /sna tshogs 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru'i steng / /nyi zla bam ro brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /log mtshams zur bzhi pad 'dab la/ /dga' ba g.yon 'khyil g.yung drung ris/ /dkar bo mngon par 'bur don dam/ /che chung cha snyoms re re bris/ /rtsibs mtha' rten pa'i mu khyud la/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng ba las 'phros pa'i/ /ye shes me ru 'bar bas bskor/ /nas 'bras la sogs 'bru dkar gyis/ /dbus dang mtshams bzhi'i lha mtshan steng / /tshom bu gnyis gnyis dbus zhal sprod/ /tshul du rnam pa bcu bkod zhes/ /rlon tshon gyis bris skabs la dgongs/ /rdul tshon nyid dang dngos 'dra bar/ /'bur dod blos blangs lag len sogs/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo can gyis/ /bgyi 'os mkhas pa'i zhal bcud longs/ /de skad dpa' bo'i gsang rgyud kyi/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /
maṇḍal dkyil gyi ji lta'i don/ /rnam bshad nyin byed 'khor lo zhes/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba dbang pos sbyar/ / mya/ da)) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /jag pa srung ba'i man ngag bzhugs/ / jag bsrung la sogs 'thor bu/ rgya gar skad du/ tso ra rakṣa/ bod skad du jag pa srung ba'i thabs/ bsrung bar byed pa'i lha la phyag 'tshol lo/ /rang gi sngon dang phyi nas ni sha med keX rus pho mo gnyis/ /thod dbyug thod khrag g.yas dang g.yon/ /gnyis ka gar byed bya ra byed/ /tso ra bsrung bzlog byed par bsam/ /oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ rkang 'og nas ni sa blang la/ /phyed ni sngon la gtor bar bya/ /phyed la gsum byas cha gcig ni/ /rgyab kyi phyogs su gtor bar bya/ /cha gcig grogs dang rdzas la gtor/ /gsum cha gcig la las sngags ni/ /brgya bzlas mthe'u chung zer ba'ang 'duga mdzub mo'i ston la gtor/ /de ni mthu chen rgyab du'o/ /des ni tso ra'i 'jigs dang bral/ /mal gnas brten par de ltar shes/ /rta phyug la sogs de ltar bya/ /'di la the tshom spangs ba'o/ /bla ma 'dzin lo tsā bas bsgyur ba yin/ / sgrigiX da)) yang khyad par lam bsrung byed par 'dod na/ 'gro khar gtor ma sbyin la chom rkun 'chings bar gsol ba btab/ gtor ma 'gro phyogs su btang/ rang yi dam du gsal btab nas/
༄tshi/ /gseg ma'i bye ma gtsang ma la/ rtsa sngags chom rkun bhanta bhanta ces btags nas mang du bzlas la/ 'gro ba'i phyogs thams cad du gtor zhing / rang dang 'khor g.yog nor rdzas kun la rang gzhan gyi ma tshor bar cung zad phog par bya'o/ /rang 'khor bcas kyi mdun rgyab tu chos skyong yab yum sku che zhing yan lag rags pa rngams pa'i sku las de 'dra ba mang po 'phros/ phyag g.yas pa'i dbyug pa klad la bskor bas/ dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du brlag par byed/ g.yon pa'i zhags pas dgra bgegs kyi yan lag sdoms pa rnam shes dang dbang po thams cad nyams par byed par mos nas/ ma hā tha nu chom rkun bhanta bhanta swā hā/ ces btags pa bzlas shing / rang gi thog mar sna drangs te 'gro'o/ /de nas ci bder bya/ des lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas btsan sar slebs dang ting nge 'dzin glod/ da)) yang gzhan la lam bsrung ster na/ man ngag gter ba'i yungs dkar la/ rtsa sngags ci mang bzlas la thum dkar po byas te/ rtsa sngags sham bu la 'chang ba po la chom rkun rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ oX ghri rā ja ghri rā ja rakṣa ku ma ku ma khumathis swā hā/ zhes btags la mdun du bskur nas/ ces pa la chos skyong bskyed bstims byas nas yungs dkar thum bu dang lhan cig tu lus sam mgul du btags pas lam gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ / 3steX yang rang zas za ba'i dus zan chang gnyis sprad la/ dpal dur
khrod bdag po yab yum mchod par bzhes shig ces brjod/ jag 'chings 'di las zab pa med do/ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i gtor 'bul lugs dang / bsnyen pa lam bsrung bya thabs dang bcas pa'o sgriXmaṅga liṃ/ lhe/ da) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /mngon spyon drag po'i las mtha' bzhugs/ /na mo gu sa dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sha za chen po yab yum gyis nyams pa bsgral ba'i thabs/ dur khrod dben gnas su mi pho mo rims kyis shi ba'i sa blangs nas/ de la brub khung khru gang bya la/ nang du dur khrod sol ba byug dur khrod sol ba la ran brdar nas khrag gi sprus la/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku sor brgyad pa byas la/ zhal dur khrod kyi bdag po dug khrag gi che ge mo'i ming rus bris la/ de'i bar mgo thur la bstan la bzhag /steng du dar skud nag po phub/rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig la dur sol gyis byugs la srin mo 'gros su btsug sha khrag dang chang la bha rlang bshams/ thun rdzas ni zangs lcags kyi phye ma dang dug sna tshogs bsags la yi dam bsgom/ de'i mdun du skad cig gi dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum bsgom sku mdog dkar po nag po mche ba gtsig pa/ g.yas khram shing dang g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i brkyang bskum kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor sha za'i bdag
༄༅/ /po dang bdag mo dpag med bskor bar bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa bstim/ yang gtor ma sha khrag gi bdud rtsir dmigs la/ rtsa sngags bdun gyis phul/ thal mo brdab/ 'phrin las bcol/ de'i rjes su/ thun rnams dur khrod bdag po nyung 'bru tsam las/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza/ chom rkun ting ting / ku ma ku ma khum this/ dgra bgegs ma ra ya sbad/ ces bzlas so/ /de zla ba phyed phyed smra ba bcad la / mtshan ma ni nges pa med do/ /cho 'phrul ci ston te skrags par mi bya'o/ /de nas liṅga dang sku de rnams dar nag tu dril la lho phyogs kyi dur khrod du mnan na/ lo mi 'gor bar chad pa'i las kyi 'chi'o/ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sha za chen po'i las mtha' rdzogs so/ / athi+-iX 7/ da) o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ / dur khrod bdag po'i man ngag sgrib shing zabamo bzhugs/ /na mo gu sa sgrib shing ni/ dang po bon gyi yul na rnal 'byor pa byin rlabs shin tu che ba zhig rgyal po'i bla mchod byed kyin yod pa la/ yul dus yu ba der rgyal po de la g.yin gyi dmag khri tsho 'bum yod la/ rnal 'byor ba des mi mthong ba'i sngags bzlas pas/ yul de'i dmag mi kun gyi ma mthong te/ sgrib shing kun gyi nang nas mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /sngags ni oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ zhes pa
༄7/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub dkyil las tshogs phran tshegs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen pa dang / mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gam rnal 'byor bla med gang rung gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par thob pa'i gang zag la/ slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin te/ de'i nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / bsrung 'khor yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas ci nus byas la/ yi dam chos skyong che chung gang gi mchod gtor gyi rjes la/ sngon du 'di'i gtor ma byin rlabs/ yang na sngon la chos skyong bskyed nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐X yig las e chad pa las nam mkhar yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/
༄tshi/ /ra rakta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keX las rus pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ raṃ las nyi ma/ bhrūṃ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang / de'i nang du paṃ padma maṇḍal hūṃX gis padma'i gdan/ma srurya maṇḍal hūṃX gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal hūṃX gis zla ba'i gdan/ ru tra ti ra bam las ro'i gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūṃX dang a las dung dang mgron bu hūṃX dang āXs mtshan pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus lhan tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba brtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs gar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskums pas brla la brten pa'i
skyil drung byed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ stod g.yog dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'khor bcas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'kha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oX/mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang/ u rgyan nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐X/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pa/ /dad pa dam tshig chen po yis/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi e hya hi/ ambha la sogs pas mchod pas mchod/ dzaXhūm̐X baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'bor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes pas dbu brgyan pa la/ ambha sogs kyi mchod/ rgyal ba'i gzugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /oX badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams dang / rje btsun bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang
༄tshi/ /bcas pa rnams kyis ji ltar bka' bsgos pa dang / dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang / sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa dang tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcings ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas 'phrin las bcol lo/ /gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma sha khrag dang dar dkar po'i cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa nang mchod chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ a mṛ ta'i bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyang oX stong pa aXthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūṃX dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ha ho hriXye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur bar mos la/ yab yum gyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar dmigs la/ oX ghri rā dza ghri ra dza ku ma ku ma khum cas swā hā/ shrī smra sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā bi sha tsi sarba sa pā ri wa ra i dam bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas gsol te dgyes par bsam la/ ambha la sogs pas mchod nas/ nang mchod 'thor zhing / oX ghri ha ra dza ghri ha ra dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ oX āXhūm̐X / dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchod sbyin gyi
gtor ma rgya chen po 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /mgron no/ /bsngo'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ sku ma g.yel/ gsung ma g.yel/ thugs ma g.yel/ rnal 'byor bdag gis brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring / bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul/ rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par du yang chom rkun ma lus bcings ba dang / bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces 'phrin las bcol lo/ / hūm̐X/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun ces pa nas/ dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /kyi bar dang / rnam dkar keX rus dag pa'i gzugs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par/ /gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /yang dag lam la gnyer gnas te/ /lus can bde la 'god mdzad cing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ /phan bde'i kun stsol khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod sgrub khyod mchod na/ /dam bca' ci bzhin nyer dgongs la/ /ji ltar gsol btab ji bzhin du/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bstan bsrung 'khor bcas mchod/ /'phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pas bstod de 'phrin las bcol/
༄tshi/ /'di'i sngags bzlas par 'dod na/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong lcam dral la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐X dang e la sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkug nas bdag la stsol bar bsam mo/ /gzhan yang chom skun la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod par mos nas/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ ces ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod gsol btab gong ltar byas la/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskong zhing / bris sku la sogs rten yod na de la bstim/ med na badzra muX gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas btab la sogs pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ / athi+-iX maṅga lam/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i las tshogs thun mong ma yin pa bla mabee ro ca nas gsungs bzhugs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal 'ordzo/ /gang dag rnal 'byor ba dag gis/ bdag gzhan bsrung dang bzlog pa dang / /bsod nams spel dang dngos grub ster/ /de dag sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa dur khrod la sogs dben gnas su/ /maṇḍal mi 'gram zer ba rog go/ mchod gtor bshams nas ni/ /dang po rang nyid yi bde mag bzang dam lha/ /sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po ni/
zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ g.yas pas thod dbyug 'bar ba thogs/ /gaskurdzon pa thod pa khrag bkang gadrarshal/ /'bar ba'i keX 〈cos mche ba gtsig /brkyang bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum cas swā hā/ bsnyen rtags ma byung bar du bzlas/ rtags gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ mi dkar bo dang bon po dkar po sogs 'ong ngo / /bsnyen pa song nas tshar gcig brjod pas bdag bsrung du gsol ba'i gsol ba gdab par bya/ gnyis pa gsum pa las sngags kyi grangs dang bdag ces pa'i gnas su che ge mo bcug pa ma gtogs brgya rtsa'i bar 'dra'o/ /tshar gcig brjod pas bdag nyid bsrung / /tshar gnyis brjod pas gzhan bsrung 'gyur/ /tshar gsum brjod pas grong bsrung gyur/ /tshar bdun rjod pas shes rab 'phel/ /brgya rtsa brjod pas yul 'khor bsrung / /gzhan gyi byad 'di sgrubpa bstan pa kha bzlog bsnyen rjes su pa ni/ /dur khrod thal ro bsregs pa'i thal ba chen blang nas su/ /chos skyong yab yum sku 'di ltar bzo bzhengs nas/ /spyan 'dren rab tu gnas par bya/ /brgyad dang bco lnga gnam stong la/ /rme ba mi snyu lha zer ba dang rog me snyu la lha yang zer ba nag pa'i dud pas bdug /rigs sngags sbyor ba ga pa'i bzlog ces gsol ba btab/ /de yis rigs sngags bzlog par 'gyur/ /dngos grub myur du sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /brub khung khru gang
༄༅/ /khrag gis byugs/ /zur gsum nang du mchog phur mi rkang gi zas blangs la sra sprin nas mi sngo bar gsum/ /gtsugs pa'i kha la thod pa bzhag /kha zas sna tshogs dag gis bkang / /'bru sna sman sna ras sna brdar/ /mdun dang zur du gzig la ba ling bzhag mi rang gang za ba'i/ dus drug dag du chang phud sogs/ /gtor ma'i bshags pa rta ru bzung / /zhag bdun gag gtor cung zad gnyis 'bul thun drug du'am bzhi bar du smra bcad bya/ /dam tshig bsrung ba mchog du gces / / sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub blangs/ /zhag bdun 'ordzon pa'i nang par ni/ /dpal ldan yab yum gus pa yi/ /tshul gyi dngos grub nas gtor ma'i byas steng drang bar bsam/ /rgyun gtor gcig pa gtsang sar skyal/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po'i las la sbyor ba'i ches/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /sna tshogs 'bru la byas nas su/ /bang mdzod bcug la gsol ba snyu 'phel ba btab/ /de'i 'bru rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /ratna sna tshogs dag la byas/ /zhing dkyil bcug na 'o1 mthong bas mi slob sar sba na legs 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /thabs 'og bcug gong zer ba'ang khrug na lngardzo lang rang bde g.yos 'du/ /gser dang dngul gyi bris nas su/ /rab gnas byas nas chu ra'i zhabs/ /sbas na zas kyi spyan gzigs 'phel/ /ta la shing gi dag gi 'ordzo ma la/ /dur khrod bdag po'i sku bris la/ /gang gi mgul du btags gyur na/ /gang gi ming bar sar
de la thams cad dad skye bo par gyur/ /yab yum sku ratna dag gis sna rgas bris/ /rab gnas byas la dpang bar btags/ /yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ /tsan dan gla rtsi dri bzang gis/ /sku bris rab gnas mchod pa bya/ /sgo steng btags na thams cad bsrung / /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /gsum du byas la rab gnas bya/ /pha la btags shing ma la gcig /bu tshar gcig ni gdags par bya/ /chung sri tshangs shig gsol ba btab/ /sri'u gsos par bya ba'o/ /ras la bris la rab gnas bya/ /bla re byas la gsol ba btab/ /de yi bdag gzhan bar chad bsrung / /gser gyi sku bris mgul du btags/ /de yi rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nang bar tshar bdun yi dam bya/ /de yis shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mdun du chos skyong yab yum bsam la mchod gtor phul nas bdag gi blo rno bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/zhal nas sngags kyi 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas rang gi stse la thim par bsam nas sngags kyi sham bur/ prañdza puñtsa ku ru a/ zhes yungs dkar dur khrod thal chen bsngags/ /zhing la sogs pa gang la gtor/ /de yi gdug pa'i kha 'ching 'gyur/ /'bu srin sogs btags nas bzlas na shes rab 'phel lo ras bal skud pa dkar po la/ /bsngags la mdud pa nyer gcig bya/ /phyug la btags 'gab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bsrung ba'i man ngag
༄tshi/ /yin / / lha khang gyo mo sogs la sogs sa blang la/ /gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod/ /phyugs la sogs pa'i lhas la gtor/ /bsrung ba'i ting 'dzin gong bzhin no/ /chom skun 'ching ba'i man ngag yin/ /chu'am gseg ma la sogs la/ gsang sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad brjod/ /bdag dang rdzas la phyogs bcur gtor/ /mdun dang rgyab kyi phyogs re nas/ /lha gnyis gar byed 'gro bar bsam/ /chom rkun 'chings shog gsol ba btab/ /gnas su phyin te ting 'dzin glod/ /de yi 'jigs pa kun las thar/ /rtag tu srog gi snying po bzlas/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /dang po gtor ma dkon mchog la/ /'og tu chos skyong yab yum mchod/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags nyid la ni/ /shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā pi sha tsi ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun brjod gsol bar bsam/ /shin tu gsang nas sgrub pa na/ /gzhan yang yon tan bsam mi khyab dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /dar dkar dag la bris nas su/ /dmag dpon sku bris nas btags nas thams cad mi gag gyi ma reg par byed gsad ba bya ba gces so dag la btags gyur na/ /des ni dmag rnams bsrung bar 'gyur/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /mar la byas te sgrom du bcug /thams cad 'bul te gsol ba btab/ /de yis dkar rnams 'phel bar 'gyur/ / gzhan yang gsang sngags dag la ni/ /gang 'dod sham bu bsgyur la
༄tshi/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i mchod bstod bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub pa nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gtor ma sha khrag dang dar dkar po'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa la / nang mchod chu nang gi sbyangs la sngags kyis oX stong pa/ āXthod pa dkar po yang shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐X dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun du hūm̐X las e chad pas nam mkha'/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rakta'i mtsho/ sum las thod mkhar gyi sa gzhi/ keX las keX rus kyi ri rab/ raṃ las nyi ma/ sum̐ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang / de'i dbus su paṃ padma maṇḍal hūm̐X gis padma'i gdan/ ma swārya maṇḍal hūm̐X gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal hūm̐X gis zla ba rnams kyi gdan gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi steng du sa bon hūm̐X dang
༄༅/ /āXlas dung mgon bu hūm̐X dang āXs mtshan pa las/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum sku dog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ keX rus shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / phyag g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs gar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba / zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i rting ba g.yon brkyangs ba'i brla la brten pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang / rin po che'i dbu brgyan snyan chas brgyan pa/ye shes kyi me rab 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'bor dang bcas pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su med par gyur/ de gnyis kyi
spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āX thugs gar hūm̐X/ hūm̐X las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas dur khrod nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐X/ dpal ldan sogs gshegs su gsol/ /shrī sma sha a dhi pa dhi e hya hi/ ambha/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaXhūm̐X rba hoX gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pas dbu brgyan pa la ambha sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐X/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /ces bstod oX badzra sa ma ya stam/ sa ma ya hoX dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'bor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs dang / rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin/ bka' dang dam las ma 'das bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs khyad par du yang rnal 'byor ba bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la 'tshe ba dang / chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal
༄tshi/ /te zhi bas ma 'dul bar ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang mtshams pa chad pas bcad pa dang / bsad pa dang / bskrad pa dang / bcing ba dang / gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / rengs ba dang / rmug shing lkugs pa dang /sdigs shing dpa' skong la sogs pa drag po'i 'phrin las kyi tshar bcad mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag g.yin sems can thams cad la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol / khyad par du yang chom rkun thams cad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces 'phrin las thams cad bcol lo/ /gus pas gsol bar gyur ces mos la/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ka khum this swā hā/oX āXhūm̐X/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas/ zhes sogs gong bzhin 'phrin las bcol/ hūm̐X/ rgyal pa'i: bdag por bstod/ /rnam dag keX rus dag pa'i sku/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /yang dag lam la nyer gnas te/ /lus can bde la dgod mdzad cing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod gang gis khyod sgrub khyod mchod na/ /dam bcas ji bzhin nyer dgongs te/ /ji ltar gsol btab ji bzhin du/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /dngos grub kun 'byung
dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bka' bsrung 'khor bcas mchod/ /'phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /zhes pas bstod/ de'i rim pa ni/ sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong yab yum lcam dral la phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul/ yab gyi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐X dang / yum la āXlas sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus par bkug nas bdag la zhu zer 'ang phrug stsol/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod par mos nas/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hāX ces ci mang bzlas pa'i mthar/ ambha la sogs pas mchod do/ /gsol 'debs gong bzhin bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskong zhing / bris sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na de la bstim/ med na badzra muXs gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas gdab smyi ltar bya/ bsnyen pa song nas dpal gyi las tshogs ni/ khyad par du lam bsrung bar 'dod na sngon 'gro ni/ 'gro khar yab yum la gtor ma byin la chom rkun 'chings shig bar gsol ba gtab/ gtor ma dgra phyogs su btang / rang yi dam du gsal btab nas/ gsog ma 'am bye ma gtsang ma la rtsa sngags la/ chom rkun bhanta bhanda ces btags la mang du bzlas la 'gro ba'i phyogs dang
༄༅/ /phyogs mtshams thams cad du gtor zhing / rang dang 'khor g.yog nor rdzas kun la gzhan gyis ma tshor bar cung zad phog par byas nas/ rang dang 'khor sogs kyi mdun rgyab du chos skyong sku che zhing rags pa rngams pa'i sku las de 'dra ba mang po 'phros/ g.yas pa'i dbyug pa klad la ba〈snar bas dgra bgegs rnams rngul du brlag par byed/ g.yon pas zhags pas gnod byed kyi yan lag bsdoms/ rnam shes dbang po thams cad nyams par byas par mos nas/ oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum zlos swā hā/ ma hā tha nu chom rkun bhanta bhanta swā hā/ ces bzlas shing rang gi thog mar sna drangs te 'gro'o/ /de nas ñtsu bder bya/ des lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par nges shing / bsam sar phyin pa dang ting nge 'dzin glod/ gzhan la lam bsrung ster na man ngag sbyin pa'o/ /yungs dkar la sngags ci mang bzlas la thum dkar po byas pa dang / sngags bris pa la sham bur 'chang ba po la chom rkun rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ zhes bris pa la chos skyong bskyed bstims byas pa yungs gar gyi thum bu dang lhan cig lus sam mgul du btags pas lam gyi bar chad bsrung zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan la sogs pa mang po mchis pa rnams/ bla ma bai ro tsa na dang / bla ma sa skya ba chen po'i gsungs dur khrod bdag po'i be'u bumargyas pa dang bsdus pa gnyis logs su yod zer 'tshol/ stobs 'phrogs dbang po'i gsung 'di la be'u buma'abring po zer lags/ las shes par
༄tshi/ /o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /'khor lo'i man ngag la sogs bzhugs/
༄tshi/ /oX swā sti/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas de'i phyi la thod dbyug bzhi bsnol ba bris la/ lte bar oX shrī ha ha hūm̐X hūm̐X phaṭa swā hā/ mu khyud la dur khrod bdag po yab yum kyi snying po spel tshig can bris te/ pho 'bor yig mgo nang du bstan/ mo 'ber yig mgo phyir bstan no/ /pho mo'i sngags ni rā dza ra dzrī khyad par yin no/ /de ltar bris pa'i 'ber lo gnyis kyi dbus su/ gnod byed kyi liṅga sngags dang spel tshig gis bskor ba dgug gzhug byas la bcug ste/ man ngag ltar lteb par bya'o/ /de nas sang nyin 'jigs pa che sar 'gro ba'i tshe/ de ring nas dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba yang yang btab/dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po dang gzhi bdag la gtor ma phul/ bar chad mi 'byung bka' bsgo'i bsnyen pa cung zad tsam bya/ sang tho rangs bya rog sgra ma grags pa la sngags brgya 'am/ stong man ci 'grub
༄tsho/ /bzlas nas gtor ma phul/ 'gro ba'i dus su dur khrod bdag po yab yum gzhung ltar bskyed la chom rkun la sogs pa tshar bcad par dmigs la bzlas pa mang du bya/ mchod bstod gsol ba btab/de nas 'khor lo ling ga dang bcas pa rang gi lham sgrog)sa kyi bar du bstim la 'gro zhing / dgra jag byung na 'khor lham sgrogs kyi bsdams la klad la phyi bskor zhing sa la brdab po 'jigs pa las thar pa dang nyes pa bshags shing bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ / athi+-iX mo e na bi sa nya li byi kuṭi/ a sha bsrung ba'i gsod pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa ni/ ras sam gro 'am shog bu la/ /dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku/ /legs par bris pa'i lte ba tu/ /mu khyud rim pa gsum du bskor/ /lte bar gnod byed gang yin liṅga bris/ /phyi rol rtsib bzhi la rtsa sngags sham bur che ge mo gaXgaXṭaXṭaXces bskor rim pa gnyis pa la ye
dharma gsum rdo rje'i rwa/ phyi rim me ri'o/ /snying khrag thig pa'o/ athi+-iX oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum dris swā hā/ shrī sma sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā bi sha tsi ba liX ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ athi+-iX zhal shes/ oX swā sti/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i skabs su/ dur khrod kyi 'dre ngan pa pho mo gnyis kyi dngos grub bar chad byed pa yod pas/ de la dang po mtshams dam bcad sar bcad skrad kyi gtor ma gcig byas la/ bdag nyid dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po sgrub pa yin gyi khyod kyi dur khrod bdag po la bar chad ma byed par mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rang gi gnas su songs shog /dpal chen po'i bka' ma bcag cig /oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma ud tsa ṭa ya phaṭaX ces mtshams drag tu bcad la gtor ma khung nang 'phangs/ liṅga byas la sgo them zhabs su mnan/ yi dam gyis gzir bar bya'o/ / athi+-iX de ni gnad kyi zhal gdams gsang ba/ athi+-iX sarba maṅga laṃ/ khiwa wa
༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i yab yum gyi rjes gnang bzhugs/
༄tshi/ /oX swā sti siddhi/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ zla ba yar ngo'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi gang rung la mkha' 'gro la phyi nang gnyis mnyes pa'i mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi yo byad sta gon bya/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi rten maṇḍal mda' gang ba gru bzhi pa'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su lag len bzhin rin po che'i rten kha sprod pa bris/ de'i steng du mchod rkang gi khri'u shing la rin po che'i snod du dpal bshos bshams/ sha khrag sna tshogs dang dar dkar po'i cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa bzhag /de'i steng du yab yum gyi sku tsa kka li'am thang sku gang yod pa bzhugs su gsol/ maṇḍal gyi mthar mchod pa sna tshogs dang kha zas sna tshogs pa gang 'dzoms bshams/ phyi tho rangs kyi tshe sterdzob dpon 'khor bcas gral la 'khod de rnal
༄tshi/ /'byor la gnas pas gsol ba btabs/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rim gnyis mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ chos skyong yab yum bskyed/ gtor ma 'bul zhing mchod bstod bya gsol ba btab bsnyen pa cung zad byas/ de nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gam rnal 'byor bla med gang rung gcig gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob pa'i slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas maṇḍal phul te / gong nas gsungs pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du gzhugs/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing / /yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ ji ltar gsol ba btab bzhin dpal dur khrod bdag po'i byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ slob ma chos skyong yab yum du
bskyed / slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong yab yum bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkug slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyis mes 'od du zhu bas/ yab yum gyi mkha' nas chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur nas slob ma'i lus la thim par mos la/ sngags la/ pra be sha ya hūm̐X āXzhes mang du bzlas shong dril bu dkrol la byin dbab pa de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du bskyar nas dbabs sam brtan par bya ba'i phyir gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ sngags gong bzhin bzlas shing dril bu dkrol/ tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐X āX tiṣṭha badzra ces brjod/ slar yang gtor ma de gsos nas bdud rtsis byin gyis brlabs la phul nas/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'bor dang bcas pas/ slob ma 'di dag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag gi las bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs la sogs ji ltar bsgo ba'i las sgrub cing / sangs rgyas dam tshig gi rjes dran mdzod/ ces pa'i rjes la sngags bzla zhing dril bu dkrol / mgo bor gtor ma bzhag dam bzhag lan gsum byas te dam tshig bsgrags/ gtor ma maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhag mdun du bskyed pa'i chos skyong yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phros/ slob ma'i thugs gar
༄tshi/ /hūm̐X la thim par bsam la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig gi bar bya'o/ /rjes su gnang ba la gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang yon phul/ 'di'i sgrub thabs las tshobma la rgyas par sbyin/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod/ mjug gi cho ga rnams gzhung bzhin bya/ bris sku dang tsa ka ñtsā yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs gsol gtor ma dngos grub ṇāzos la dben par bzhag /yang na dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo / /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang gi tho/ bla ma'i bzhugs gnas dpal g.yu mkhar mo sgron ma lha khang du bris pa'o/ /sa ma ya thā/
'tsho/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgo nas rdzas sngags la bsten nas smyon pa 'dul thabs bzhugs/
༄tshi/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyog 'jag yod khrag pa/ smyo 'dre 'dul na/ rdzas ni/ sha chen/ yungs dkar gu gul nag po/ so ba phag/ rgya skyegs/ ldong ros/ mu zi/ ro bsreg pa'i thal ba rnams nad pas ma tshor bar bsogs/ rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis nad pa'i mdun du sol mes rdzas brgyad pa bsregs pa'i dud pas phyir mi 'chor bar byas la bdug /yugs sa'i skra shad kyi nad pa'i ske nas bcings pa rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste/ sngags bzlas shing khas ma blang bar du lag pa g.yas pas yungs dkar dang sol bas brab/ sa phag /sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rnam 'gyur byung bar bya/ des ma byung na 'dre ma yin pa'i sman bcos bya/ 'phar ba dang / 'dar ba dang / ngu ba dang / dgod pa sogs byung na 'dre yin pas sngar bzhin gzir zhing mi gzhan gcig ci yin 'dri bcug pas thul lo/ /bla ma bai
༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gi dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsgrub pa la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro/ /dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dur khrod dam/ lha khang ngam/ dben pa'i gnas su bkra shis pa'i sa nas sa blang te maṇḍal mda' gang gi rgya dang dpangs su ldan pa brtsigs/ de'i dbus su zlum po khru gang bris/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mtho gang gri khrag gis byugs pa'i dbus su rin po che'i sna tshogs bsres pa'i reg gi gru bzhi bsnol ba'i zur brgyad la rin po che'i 'bar ba dang / lte bar rin po che'i rten sprod gnyis bris/ steng du tshom bu bcu bkod/ zur gsum gyi zur la mchog phur gsum/ sgo'i khri steng du ka pā la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs kyi gtor ma dpal batherdzos can mtha' la chang bu bdun gyis bskor/ dkar
༄7/ /gsum mngar gsum dang / 'bru sna tshogs shing thog zas sna/ ri bong lug dang g.yag rgod kyi sha dang / sha khrag sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i bzlas gtor/ rin chen lnga dang dar zab sna tshogs dang /stag ras gzigs ras sna tshogs dang gzugs de'i gsang rten dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku/ rab rin po che'i/ 'bring ba so'am rus pa/ tha ma zangs rin chen brdar la bya/ dar dkar la sngags bris pas gser bzang bud med gyis ma reg dril la/ snying gar gzhugs/ skar ma rgyal gyi snga dro la rab gnas tshar bar byas la bzhugs/ nor bu dung dang / mgron bu bu ma gnyis kyang bzhag nas/ steng du dar dkar gyi gur phub pa rnams mi 'gyur pa gsang ba'i rten no/ /'bru sna tshogs la rin po che brdar ba ka bur dri bzang po'i bzang drug gis chu yis mgo btus te yab yum kyi sku byas la dkyil 'khor kyi
steng du bzhugs pa ni nang gi rten no/ /dur khrod kyi ras la yab yum gyi sku bris la snying gar rtsa sngags bris pa rab gnas byas nas rang gi lus la bcang ba pa phyi'i rten no/ /rang gi mdun gyi maṇḍal gyi khar chang bu'i rgyun gtor gcig bya/ chang bu g.yon bskor du mdun bdun gyi gang ba'i tshar byas la nang dang nub gnyis la gtong / dkon mchog dang yi dam la mchod pa dang / gtor ma bzang du bshams/ g.yas zur du thun mgo la 'bul / de nas mtshams bsdams la bshags pa bya/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ rang he ru ga'i yi dam gang 'thad kyi bsgom bzlas bya/ de nas dang po bla ma dkon mchog dang / yi dam la mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la/sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba dang / myur du 'grub pa'i gsol ba btab nas/ rten gtor de sha khrag gi ri bo/ bdud rtsi rgya mtshor byin gyis rlabs so/ /de'i steng gi rten gyi sku de'i skad cig gis dur khrod brgyad kyi dbus su keX rus thod pa'i gur khang rakta'i rba klong 'khyil ba'i dbus na mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan la/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ keX rus khrol ba/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'bar ba 'phyar ba g.yon pa thod pa'i khrag zhal du gsol ba/ rin po che dang thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang / thod pa'i do shal dang ldan pa/ zhabs brkyangs bskums kyi gar stabs kyi sna tshogs mdzad pa/ de lta
༄༅/ /bu'i 'khor dang sprul ba dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bskyed/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūm̐X las 'od zer 'phros/ rgya gar gi dur khrod brgyad nas yab yum spyan drangs la bstim mo/ /rten gtor la sngags byung na 'bul bar khas blangs la/ sgrub pa'i rten du bzung / rgyun gtor byin gyis rlabs la/ sma sha na a dhi pa dhi ma hā pi sha tsi bha lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis thun drug du phul la chang bu bdun gyis gang ba'i tshar byas la btang / bstod pa byas la gang 'dod gsol ba btab/ de nas rang yi dam gyi thugs ga'i hūm̐X dang sngags las 'od zer 'phros pas yab yum gyi thugs ka nas srog gi yi ge rtsa ba'i sngags yod pa bskul bas las ñtsu bya rang dbang med par bsam zhing / oX ghri rā dza sogs this swā hā/ zhes rgyun chad med par bzlas te zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrub/ gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas zer yang rtags mthong gal che ste/ 'grub pa'i rtags ni/mgon po yab yum dngos su byung ste gtor ma byin nas 'phrin las bcol na gang bsgos pa byed do/ /dngos grub chen po byung ngo / /'bring rmi lam du keX rus kyi sku khrab pa'am/ mon nam/ a tsa ra'am/ bon po 'byung ngo / /gzhan phan sna tshogs pa ste gtor ma byin na bzang ngan sogs rtags dpyad shes par bya'o/ /dung 'bud rnga brdung rol mo byed na grags pa thob/ ratna'i tshogs byung na nor gyi dngos grub thob/ ba dang ma he ba glang byung na
dkar thob 'phel lo/ /til dang 'bras dang 'bru spyod byung na 'bru tshogs 'phel/ rmi lam du bza' btung ster ba byung na zas 'du/ rgyun tu 'khor ba'i rtags rmi na bsrung ba'i las 'grub po/ /ngan pa'i rtags ni/ rmi lam du nyi ma rgas pa dang / gos nag po gyon pa dang / rtsod pa 'gyed pa dang / ban de nag po khro ba dang / zas ngan za ba dang mdze pho la sogs pa ni mgon po khros pas tshogs dang gtor ma dang / 'di'i bskang bshags la 'bad ba bya'o/ /bsnyen pa 'thon pa dang rten gtor de phul la gtsang sar gtong / rten rnams mdzod phug du sbas pa'i tshe mi'i ma mthong bzhag cing sba'o/ /sgrub pa ni sngar gyi maṇḍal gyi steng gru gsum rgya dang dpangs su mtho gang yod pa rtsigs shing / 'bru maṇḍal gyi phyogs bzhir dkar gtor re re chang bu bdun bdun gyis gang ba la gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams/ rten gtor steng du rang dga' ba'i zas kyi phud gcig bzhag rten dang bcas gzhi thams cad sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas mtshams bcad bshags pa bya/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ yi dam bsgom bzlas bya/ mchod pa dang gtor ma sngar bzhin bshams/ mgon po bskyed pa dang / gtor ma sngar bzhin bya/ khyad par gtor ma bzhi po de/ sha khrag gi rgya mtshor byin gyis rlabs yab yum la 'bul la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab dus drug du gtor snod re re bsnan nas byin gyis rlabs te/ phul ba
༄tshi/ /bdun tshang ba dang thun tha ma la gtor ma bshams bstod la tshogs re bya/ de nas smra bcad byas la ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas rgyun ma bcad par rtsa ba'i sngags kyi srog snying drag du bzlas shing / zhag bdun bsgrub po/ /zhag bdun gyi 'tshams thon pa'i nub mo thams cad 'bul/ tshogs byas la rol/ rten gtor steng gi rang la dga' ba'i zas de chos skyong yab yum kyis dngos grub byin par bsam la rang za'o mi la mi sbyin 'bul/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang / rjes rnams bsdu/ rten 'dus la mchod khong du mdzod phug tu rten gtor dang bcas pa'i mi'i mi mthong bar sba'o/ /dam tshig ni/ sgrub pa btang ba'i tshe/ mtshams khungs su bud med rme can dang / gcan gzan mi btang khyad par yug sa mo la 'dzems/ gal te byung na sgrub pa bskyar la bya'o/ /gnas skabs thams cad du gtor ma dang bzlas pa la brtson par byas nas/ lus dang grib bzhin tu 'grogs nas snying nas sgrub pa'o/ /las sbyor ni las tshogs rnams bsgrub pa ste/ dus der gtor ma phul nas/ las de'i 'phrin las bcol nas/ las so so'i bzlas pa dang / rten bca' ba dang / bsrung ba 'dogs pa dang bzlog pa dang / bsad pa la sogs pa dang / rang rang gi yi ge bzhin byas pas 'grub bo/ /las tshogs kyi yi ge logs su bstan no/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsnyen sgrub kyi lag len 'di shin tu gsang
༄༅/ /o rgyan gling gi dpa' bo che/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gsang rgyud don/ /legs bshad man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /yig chung 'dod yon sprin phung bzhugs/
༄tsho/ /spyi dang khyad par brten la rab bsnyen cing / /nang gsal sgrub pa chen po'i skabs kun tu/ /sngags 'chang sbur oṃ zhes pa'ang yod gcig pu'i byed las rtogs dka' bas/ /gtor ma'i yig chung 'dod yon sprin phung spro/ /'dir skal ldan gyi dam tshig can gyi nges pa'i yid stabs su bya bar 'os pa'i gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ chang bu'i gtor ma phul nas ni/ /zhag bdun bar du sgrub par bya/ /zhes pas 'di'i khyad par lag sor lnga'i rjes gsal dod mgo mjug phra rbom ha cang che bas ma yin pa snyoms shong mdzes pa'i chang bu'i mtheb phyogs gyen rtse phyir bstan du mdun nas sbyar/ dbus dpal bshos stod zur gsum brjid chags smad zlum po man chang bu'i spyan ris dang mnyam pa dkar dang sha khrag chang phud/ kha zas 'bras bu rin chen dar zab dang stag gzig gi spu rigs rnams kyis brgyan cing btsug
༄༅/ /go / gtor bzo 'di ni kun gyi rtsa ba rgya bod kyi gzhung dang / bla ma'i tshig brgyud phyag rgyun ma nyams pa'i khung btsun spyi thub yin la/ de yang dang po nyid nas chang bu mdun gyi dbus su gcig de'i g.yas g.yon du re re ste gsum la sogs pa g.yas g.yon du gnyis gnyis rnams khod snyoms par yongs su bdun gyis bskor gang zin ni/ mchog khri'i khar thod pa bshams pa de/ paṇa chen rakṣi ta'i rgya gzhung las kyang / gru gsum nang du mchog phur gsum/ /brtsegs pa'i kha ru gtor ma bzhag /kha zas sna tshogs mchog gis bskang / 'bru sna sman sna ratna brdar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rten gtor de yi mdun gyi leb chen dbus su/ nor bu dung mgron gnyis dang / rtse steng phyi rten bris sku bkram la bzhugs su gsol ba'i gtor ma 'og gzhi sha khrag gi ri gling rgya mtshor bsam par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gong ma las cung
zad chung pa la bzo dbyibs de 'dra ba zas sman dri bzang 'bru sna tshogs gtsor bor bsres pa dkar dang sha khrag chang phud kyis brgyan pa'i chang bu gcig pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin du rtags sam mtshams ma grol bar byin gyis rlabs/ mi bsngo bar bsrung bas rgyas btab ste rtags 'dzin pa lta bu'i nang / der ming du bzhag pa'i gtor ma ste gta' gtor zhes smros kyang ming gcig la/ de las cung zad chung ba gtsang ma'i rgyu kho na las sgrub pas dpal bshos rtsa ba 'gyur med dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa cha snyoms te/ chos 'byung ba'i zur g.yas dang g.yon rgyab gsum/ mdun dang g.yon g.yas kyi zla gam khams gsum la ba linta thams cad zhal lta phyogs su mthun par bzhag pa ni rgyun gyi gtor ma rnams bshams pa'i tshul te/ 'dzin thun gyis gtor ma de dag gis lag len rakṣi ta'i rgya gzhung las/ zur dang mdun la ba ling bzhag /dus drug chang sprad g.yon bskor sogs/ /gtor ma mi gshegs rtag tu bzung / /zhes pa'i don/ de nas yar ngo'i tshe nam langs nyin thun gyi dang po rten gtor la dmigs nas bskyed/ 'dzin gtor byin gyis rlabs nas 'phrin las bsgos la bsam pa yid bzhin nam grub pa'i tshe gtong bar khas blangs/ nges par bsrung bas rgyas btab/ rgyun gtor shar mdun gyi bshams zin de nyid sman rag gis bran la bzhag ste bsngo/ de bzhin nyin phyed thun
༄tshi/ /gnyis par shar lho g.yas zur dang / nyi myur thun gsum par leb g.yon byang ma/ sa srod thun bzhi bar g.yon byang shar zur/ nam gung thun lnga bar rgyab zur nub/ tho rangs thun drug par g.yas leb kyi rgyan gtor rnams bsngo'o/ /rgya bod gzhung dang yig rnying du/ /de yang nyin mtshan dus drug du/ /dkar dang sha khrag chang phud kyis/ /brgyan cing bran pa'i rtsa ba chang bu re re'i gtor ma nyin zhag phrug gcig la yang de 'dra ba'i chang bu bdun bdun gyi rta gtor dang rgyun ma phyogs mtshams kyi drug dang bdun du bsnan nas/ kha gso ba'i tshul gtor ma re re'i go rim ni zhag dang por bstan pa de kha bsgyur med/ zhag gnyis pa la sogs par mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rta gtor du zhag la chang bu re bzhag pa'i go mal rgyun gtor la/ spyi byed dang mtshungs pas gung thun la sogs pa thun lhag ma lnga la rta gtor du sman raka gis bran pa tsam las mi dgos/ chang bu ni zhag gnyis pa'i snga thun la rtsa ba'i chang bu'i g.yas su gcig re gcig re bzhag pa nas mgo brtsams de bzhin du zhag gsum par rtsa ba'i chang bu'i g.yon du re re sogs rim par bskor bar bya'o/ /lar chang bu bdun gyis gang ba'i tshad bya zhes gab pa'i phyir 'dir shin tu rtogs sla ba'i ched zhib tu bkrol ba zhag gnyis pa'i snga thun nas bzung ste thor thun bar rta gtor dmigs su gong ltar gsal nas rgyun gtor rnams kyi rtsa ba'i chang bu'i g.yas
mdun du re re bzhag la dus drug sman raka bran zhing bsngo'o/ /zhag gsum pa'i thun drug la rta dang par rgyun ma rnams gyi rtsa ba'i chang bu'i g.yon du re re bzhag zhag bzhi par de'i mur gtor ma'i g.yon leb 'og tu bdun khar re re bsnan/ zhag lnga bar kyang logs re khar kun la re rer gsol/ zhag drug par rgyab nas bskor ba'i de'i mur gtor ma'i g.yas kyi leb 'og tu re re bsnan gzod zhag bdun pa'i snga thun tshe/ rta dang rgyun gtor mdun ma'i g.yon leb 'og gi mur chang bu'i bdun gyis ma zin pa'i rta bzung rgyun ma bsngos la bzhag khyad par gyi rim pa de bzhin gung thun la yang mdun ma'i g.yas mtshams kyi gtor ma yang chang bu'i g.yon bskor du gang zin kyang bsngos la bzhag dgong thun la dkyil 'bor log g.yon gyi gtor ma gang zin de bsngos nas nyin thun mthar sgrub khang gi phy-i rol gtsang ma'i steng khar bskyal nas btang / srod thun la mdun ma'i g.yon mtshams kyi gtor ma gang zin de bsngos la bzhag mtshan gung gi thun la rgyab phyogs kyi gtor ma gang zin de bsngos la bzhag gzod tho rangs kyi thun la dkyil 'khor g.yas log kyi gtor ma gang zin de nyid bsngos la mtshan thun mthar dpal 'bar btsugs la gong bzhin phyir bstan/ mtshams grol dga' ston gtang rag gi tshogs rdzas kyang rgya cher bshams la mtshan rtags kyi nges pa'i slad gtor ma gang zin kyang ma
