༄༅/ /bsngos par thun drug du byin gyis rlabs nas steng bar bzung ba'i bsrung ba'i rgyas btab bsdus nas sman raka gis bran/ slar yang byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bskang bshags kyi rim pa'i gzhung bsrang / gtang rag gi spel tshig tu smos nas rgyas par bsngos/ bstod pa zin pa'i skabs der rta gtor rgyun ma bzhi ste rnam pa lnga/ gzhung gi rim pa ltar tshogs phud nas bcad pa/ rta gtor dang rgyun gtor mdun ma'i rtsa ba'i chang bu'i steng dang bcas sogs 'bul 'os rnams g.yon bskor tshul du phyur bar bkang ba nas/ sman raka bran nas mchod/ de bzhin tshogs bar pa nas g.yas mtshams rgyun gtor du phud gnang ngo / /'gyod bshags du phud gtor tshog gsum pa nas bcad pa la gnod byed kyi liṅga bcas rnam shes bkugs brgyal g.yon mtshams rgyun mar btab nas bskul rjes dmigs phyogs la 'phangs/ rten gtor nas ci 'dod pa'i rdzas la dngos grub blangs tshogs la rol/ phyi dang khyad rten spyan drangs nas lhan cig du lus la bcang / gong du gtsang lhag tu bcad pa rgyun gtor nar mar sbran/ 'bags lhag snod nang bsdus nas kha 'phru btab pa'i khar bzhag pa so sor sman raka bran pa nyin thun gyi khyad par phye la mtshan yin na grib gnon gyi bgegs sel phyir me sgron btsug nas phyir bskyal/ de bzhin du rta bzung dang rgyan gtor mdun ma gnyis po yang sman raka bran pas phyir gzhung
bzhin stabs/ dbyangs gyer nas gtsang ma'i sar stegs su bskyal la phul/ dam tshig bris sku la bsnyen phyi rten du/ /'bral med rang lus la bcings lhan cig par/ /thabs shes nor bu sa mchog su war gyis/ /bla rdo snying po 'phreng ldan nye bsnyen rdzas/ /zhes so/ /de nas rten gtor sngar gyi de ga la byed na kha zas sna tshogs pa'i ril bu nor bu lta bu chang bu'i mtshams mdun du bshams/ rin po che'i sogs kyi yang bran pa'am/ yang na rnying pa nas kyang ru mar cung zad sres shing snying por bcug nas sngar bsnyen pa'i dus ji bzhin par gsar du bcas pa'i mdun gyi leb chen dbus su dung dang mgron bu bla rdor bcas pa sngar ltar bshams pa la/ dar dkar kyi zhal khebs gsal bde bar bya/ steng du nang gi rten bzhugs su gsol ba'i slad nas gur dkar po'i rdul bsrung phub/ chos 'byung khar kyang bsnyen dus bzhin 'dzin gtor dang de'i 'og g.yas g.yon rgyab zur gsum gyi rtse thams cad zlum po'i khar mdun dang g.yon g.yas kyi zhi ba'i zla gam gsum dang drug tu rgyun gtor drug bshams pa thun drug gi tshe chang bu rnam pa'i rim pa bskor ba sogs bsnyen dus skabs dang 'dra bar zhag bdun sgrub nas dngos grub blangs pa'i bar mtshungs la/ tshogs la rol nas khyad rten bsnyen dus ltar spyan drangs phyi rten dang mnyam par dar dkar gyis dril bas lus la bcangs nas lhag ma gtong skyong gi
༄tsho/ /mthar tshang / bsnyen dus bzhin sgrub mtshams nang gi rten 'bru bang gi steng dkar po mdzod du na bza' dkar po dang bcas der mchod pa'i gtso bor bzung la bzhugs su gsol/ rten gyi gtor ma'i phyi rnying pa rnams dngos grub longs spyod rjes/ snying po ru ma sgrub thod dang bcas pa phyis kyi btsas su gtsang mar tshags bya dri bzang sman 'bru'i 'dam las sku gnyis pa nang gi rten la sgrub par bya/ de nyid rtag par rang gi bang mdzod gnas su bzhugs/ mchod bshams 'dzin par bshad pa'i skabs de'o/ /phyir stegs bu 'og ma rgya spang tshad ldan gyi khar zlum bskor gyi nang du re khas bcad pa'i gru gsum rtse gcig rgyab rten mdun dang g.yas g.yon zla gam rang shugs su 'byung ba'i e dbyibs kyi dbus dkyil gyi sbas don sogs bris su byas pa 'byor ba dman zhing mjug pa bde ba'i don tsam ste/ maṇḍal blos blang ba 'dzin pa las mtshan bzhir byas pa 'bring po / rab ni gse shing rin po che sogs/ rgyu bzang las stegs bu maṇḍal khru lcogs ltar bcos pa'i chos 'byung nang du bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin las rnyed par gyur ba'i zhal shes kyis mngon par brgyan pa'i yang steng du rten gtor kyang lag gcig 'bad pa kho nas dzee srid yun gyi ngo mtshar yid rten du rung ba bcas pa'i rtser gsang rten bzhugs su gsol ba'i steng nas rdul bsrung gdan khri dang mtshams pa'i gur khang gzhan 'og tu rtags
'dzin dang / zur leb gyi thun drug skabs su bgyi 'os gong du bstan zin la/ gru bzhi'i steng du mtshams 'dzin la sogs pa'i phyi mchod phyogs bskor du bkod pa'i zur nang gru chad bzhir nang mchod gnyis mdun gyi ka pā la gnyis la thod dbyug dang zhags pa zlum po'i steng lho nub dang byang du sman raka bshams pa'i thabs 'di bsnyen sgrub sogs la yang shes par bya zhing / gzod lhun po'i keng skabs su nyi zla skar gsum mngon par gsal bar rgyan te/ bdun phrag gsum pa mthar phyin nas dngos grub blangs tshogs la rol khyad rten lus la bcangs / lhag ma gtor skyong sogs sgrub pa'i skabs su bstan pa ji lta bar bgyis nas gsang rten gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub rdzas de rnams gces dgu thams cad kyi bang mdzod kyi yang phugs su yid bzhin nor bu'i gsang ba'i gur khang du bzhugs su gsol/ nang nub rgyun chags su mchod gtor dbul ba la brtson par bya'o/ /sku gsum nang nas mchog gyur gsang ba la/ /brten nas sgrub chen grags rtags mthar phyin pa/ /'di ltar rnam pa kun tu mchod pa'i yul/ /yin phyir brgyud gzhung kun gyi bstan bya'i gtso/ /de ltar gtor ma'i yig 4 4 'a da nga nga 4 shen da nga 4 0 4 4 0
'tsho/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen bsgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam kyi rgyud mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄tshi/ /oX swā sti sirnyi/ bla na med pa'i gsang gsum yon tan dpal/ /mi bzad mdzod 'chang chos kyi bkra shis dbyings/ /snyan pa'i 'gro la legs pa'i lam chen ston/ /'phrin las lhun grub bla mas dge legs stsol/ /chu bdag ngal bas sdig dang sa 'dzin dbang / /bskyod pa'i thub chod las 'ga' brtsams min par/ /legs pa'i dpal bskyed gdams pa'i bcud kyis len/ /dngos dang brgyud nas sbyin mdzad kun la 'dud/ /bde gshegs yongs kyi mkhyen brtse rdzu 'phrul stobs/ /gar gyi nyams rtsal ldogs pa'i keX rus su/ /mngon par brdzus nas las bzhi lhun gyis grub/ /dpal sbyin dur khrod bdag pos dge la sbyor/ /gsang rgyud sprin gyi gdung skyob lha dang mi/ /kun gyi bla na 'phyo ba'i khung rum nas/ bsam kun rdzogs mdzad bsrung ba'i nang so gang / /sngags brjod tshig gi dbyar skyes rnga gsang ldir/ /
༄tshi/ /gang gi thugs brgyud legs bskul thun mong mchog /zung gi bsdus pa'i dngos grub skyes bzang gis/ /rang gzhan yid kyi lhang rta 'gongs pa'i thabs/ /bsnyen bsgrub bya tshul gtam gyi rgyud mang 'brol de la 'dir skabs su babs pa'i gleng bar bya ba nyid ni/ gangs ldan gyi ri bo'i 'phreng ba'i yongs su bskor ba'i yul gru chen po 'di nyid du skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lugs bzang ji snyed pa bgyi bar bya ba rnam gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me dam pa dpal sa skya ba chen po zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid la gdams pa'i bka' srol babs shing thugs nyams su bstar ba'i zab chos bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i bka' bsrung thun mong ma yin pa/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa dang / las sbyor ro/ /
dang po bsnyen pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ thog mar sgrub pa po bde dgyes la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'bor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan par/ slar yang chos skyong 'di nyid kyi bka'i rjes su gnang ba man ngag sgrub skor gtor ma dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i gong du sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ gzhung las/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag gang / /lha khang la sogs dben gnas su/ /zhes gsungs pas 'dir las dang po'i gnas ni phyi ma ste/ de'ang bla ma gong ma la sogs pa'i byin gyis rlabs shing / rang dbang du 'du shes pa/ de la phyag dar la sogs pas yid 'jug par bya ste/ der rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i gdan bshams yid du 'ong bar byas pa'i mdun du maṇḍal mda' gang gi tshad tsam yod pa la zhal khod snyoms par byas/ de'i dbus su yig rnying phal cher la gru gsum bya ba sogs bshad kyang phyag len bde ba'i phyir du/ dbus nas mtho tshad tsam gyis zlum por bskor ba'i nang du rdul tshon dkar po la sogs pas dung dkar dang mgron bu kha sprod kyi snam pa legs par bris pa'i steng du 'bras sam nas kyi tshom bu dbus su gcig dang phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du ram ste tshom bu dgu bkod la tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du mchog rkang ngam mchog phur zhes bya ba mi rkang gi khri'i thod skam sgal tshig dang bcas pa'i rnam pa shing
༄tshi/ /las byas pa la dkar rtsi'i byug khri'u bya/ de yang ma 'byor na bcangs pa'i khri'u bya/ de yang ma 'byor na mañdzi bzhag pas kyang rung / de'i khar ka pā la dum bu gcig pa'i nang thams cad mar gyi khyad par bskus la bzhag de'i nang du dpal bshos zhes pa gtor ma stod zur gsum ha cang ma rno bar/ smad zlum po/ chang bu bdun gyen du bslang ste sbyar ba la mar gyi btags sam/ yang na spyir 'di dag gi rigs la zlum gtor bya ba sa paṇa gyi dgongs pa dang mthun pas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yang de bzhin bshad do/ /de dag gang la mos par bshams pa'i mthar mdzo drel sha ma gtogs pa gtso gi sha dang / gzhan yang lug dang / g.yag rgod la sogs pa'i sha sna gtsang ma dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum dang shing thog dang 'bru sna dang rin po che dang dar zab la sogs tshogs tshang bsags te/ phyur bur bkang ngo / /de'i khar nor bu gnyis zhes pa de dung dkar dang mgron bu che ba gnyis dang / yab yum kyi sku rten gyi skabs bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi gsang ba'i zhig par bya ste/ de yang / ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ yang ngo'i skar ma rgyal la ni/ /snga dre'i dus su brtsams par bya zhes pa nas bya ba'i dus bstan/ /rab ni rin chen lnga las bya/ /'bring ni ba so rus pa las/ /tha ma sa las rin chen brdar/ /zhes pas gang las bya ba'i rgyud don/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis sku dog dkar zhes pa
nas brkyang bskum gar gyis legs par gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar rnam pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rnams bstan pas dang por lha bzo ba dbang thob cing dam tshig sdom pa ldan pa'am de ma byung na yang bri ba'i yul der gso sbyongs sogs la gnas par bya ste/ sku mdog la sogs pa ni/ gzhung dang mngon rtogs las 'byung ba ltar bzhengs grub pas ci skad du dar dkar dag la sngags bris la bud med ma reg /gser dum gnyis de'i thugs gar bzhugs par bya/ zhes pa'i sngags ni/ oX ghri rā dza sogs kyi snying po ste/ gser la sogs pas yi ge dbu can bris pa nang du bstan pa dbu nas dril nas mgo gshams ma log par de dang mnyam du gser dum re la na bza' ser bos g.yogs la sku rten de yab yum gnyis kyi thugs gar bzhugs go /slar yang steng gi sku sna man ngag las 'byung ba'i 'khor lo yang bzhugs par bya ste/ de nas ras sam dar dkar la dri bzang ngam/de dang tshon mtshal bsres pa la sogs pa'i 'khor lo rtsib brgyad la mu khyud dang bcas pa bris de'i dbus su oX ghri rtsibs brgyad la rin po che'i brgyad bri/ mu khyud la oX ghri rā dza ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this/ ratna ghri tsi waṃ mi sems bsgul bsgul swā hā/ zhes pas g.yas bskor du 'bor bar 'khod pa'i 'khor lo de yang na bza' ser po dang bcas te yab yum gyi lte bar bzhug go /de ltar byas pa'i sku rten de la bya ba khrus dang rab gnas
༄༅/ /rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ sngar gyi thod pa'i khar maṇḍal la sogs pa'i steng / rten nas bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du dkar gdugs phul/ de bzhin du nang gi rten 'bru sna tshogs la rin chen brdar ba byas pa dang / phyi'i rten ni dur khrod ro ras kyi zhig la bris pa'i sku gnyis kyang bya ste/ de gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi steng la sogs pa ci bder sgrom/ maṇḍal gyi mdun nas brtsam te chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas bskor gyi rim pas bshams/ dbang ldan nas me lha'i bar du yi dam chos skyong mkha' mgro spyi gtor rnams bshams pa'i mdun du rgyun gtor 'bul/ rgyun gtor 'bul rgyu sngar dang 'dra bar byas pa thod pa'i mdun thad du 'ong bar bya'o/ /rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod ḍā ma ru me tog rnams bshams so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ /mtshams bcad gtor ma btang ba/ yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba/ mdun bskyed mchod gtor 'bul ba/ bzlas pa'i thugs brgyud bskul ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa drug las dang po mtshams bcad gtor ma btang ba ni/ gzhungs las de nas mtshams bcad/ ces pa'i don ni/ phyi 'tshams nang 'tshams bcad pa ste mtshams g.yogs la sogs dgos nges pa lnga'am bdun tsam las mang ba 'tshams 'og tu mi 'jug pa dang / gal te 'jug dgos kyi dgos pa yod pa dang / yo byad gsar du len dgos pa
sogs kyang dmigs 'og du chud nges pa bya/ khyad par du sgrub khang na bud med mi btang ba dam tshigs yin pas lhan tu gces/ phyi mi mi 'jug pa'i ched du sgo mtshams tho brten par brtsegs/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan dang ldan pas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsam kyis mi khyab pas gdams par dmigs la de dag ldan pa'i dpang po na bzhugs bzhin pa'i spyan sngar bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam gang la byed pa'i de'i dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs brtsams te/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod pa'i mthar/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog dang thun mongs gi dngos grub 'grub pa'i ched du/ bsnyen sgrub tshul bzhin du bgyis bar 'tshal na bsrung ma'i dpang po khyed rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar gcod thams cad bsrung ba dang / deng nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / sdong grogs mdzod cig /ces pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba'i mthar muX zhes pa dpal lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas te sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu gshegs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa
༄tshi/ /bon gyi 'od zer gyis gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsam/ ngag du gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i sogs brjod cing / gu gul gyi dud pas bdug /rdo rje gsor la dril bu drag du dkrol ba dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags brjod la gtor ma gtsang sar gtor ro/ /gnyis pa yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ yi dam gyi dkyil chog nas 'byung ba'i gnas dang mchod pa'i yo spyad byin gyis rlabs dang / garnye ra ni rol mo bcas pas lan gsum gyis byin dbabs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba ni/ gzhung las snga ma'i rjes thob de ma thag par bshad pa dang / /yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs bsags nas/ /snying rje tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /shu n+ya ta yis stong par bsgom/ /de nas bdag nyid hūm̐X las ni/ he ru ka bsam/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'di nyid du shes pa'i yi dam ni 'khor lo bde mchog gam kyai rdo rje pa dang / nā ro mkha' spyod de gsum gang rung zhig mdzad par phyag len to/ /de'i nang nas kyang sngon du bsnyen pa song ba zhig ces kyang dgos shing de dag gang ltar yang rung/ thog mang 'khor ba las yid 'byung dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las 'bras blang dor la sogs pa bsam pa'i sgo nas tshe 'di snang gi khe dang grags 'dod kyi rtog pa thams cad thag bsring te/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas
pha mar gyur ba'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral 'dod kyi blos kun nas bslangs nas skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor bsdus pa man chad kyis bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgoms mo/ /bzhi pa mdun bskyed mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs te/ bsangs sbyangs/ ha ho hrīX lan gsum brjod pa'i bar gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ thog mar yi dam la rang rang gi gtor ma'i tshogs gtor ma 'bul/ dgong thun lta bu la gur zhal las mgon sogs chos skyong gzhan rnams 'bul na'ang / 'das gtor thams cad sdebs gcig tu skabs 'dir phul na bde bar mthong /de rnams kyi skabs su yang sgrub pa 'di la bar gcod mi 'byung ba'i gsol gdab 'phrin las zhu/ de nas dgos kyi chos skyong bskyed cing mchod pa gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa'i ci skad du/ rgyud gzhung las/ yab yum mdun du bskyed byed de/ /mchod bstod gtor mas mnyes byas la/ /gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas/ zhes pa'i don ni/ dbus kyi rten gtor la dmigs te/ rdo rje nang mchod nas gtor ba dang bcas/ oX badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐X hūm̐X hūm̐X phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bgegs bsangs / lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis gas bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan te/ oX stong pa nyid do bsam/ āXthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐X dgra
༄༅/ /bgegs kyi sha khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga/ hoXye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i gyur bar mos la slar yang / ha ho hrīX lan gsum brjod byin gyis rlabs nas nor bu gnyis dang sku la dmigs te ngag du/ swā bha wa sogs kyi stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar hūm̐X yig las e chad pa'i nam mkha' rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keX las keX rus kyi ri rab raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sum̐ las thod pa'i mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po las grub pa gru bzhi pa/ mi rus kyi rkang dang rtsib rus sna tshogs kyi steng thog phub pa thod skam gyi mda' yab dang pu shud brgyan cing/ rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba dang dra ba phyed pas 'phyang ba/ 'og tu rus pa dang sha khrag sna tshogs gcal du bkram pas de'i nang du paṃ las padma maṇḍal hūm̐X gis padma'i gdan sogs nas/ chom rkun thams cad bcings pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas 'phrin las bcol ba'i bar yar klung pa dang rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen la sogs pa'i gtor chog ltar bskyed cing / sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa dang / dgug gzhugs bya ba gdan dang mchod pa 'bul/ dbang bskur zhing rgyas gdab mchod bstod dam bzhag rnams dkyus ltar bya ste/ rten gtor ni bsnyen pa nas grol gyi bar du 'bul ba med la/ mdun gyi rgyun gtor ni/ gang
gi yi dam sogs kyi skabs su byin rlabs rgyas par byas/ de nyid slar yang de nyid nas 'byung ba'i byin rlabs mdor bsdus pa gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas ljags rdo rje sbu gus gtor ma la zug te/ gsal bar mos la sngags kyi rjes su/ shrī sma sha na a dhi ba dhi ma hā pi sha tsi ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ ambha sogs kyis mchod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu nang mchod 'bul/ dur khrod bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol/ hūm̐X/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las sogs nas/ 'phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod ces pa'i bar gyis bstod do/ /lnga pa bzlas pas thugs brgyud bskul ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pa'i mdun gyi chos skyong yab yum la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐X dang /las sngags bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkugs nas bdag la rtsol zhing / chom rkun la sogs pa'i gdon dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad par bsam la/ thog mar yi dam gyi snying po brgya phrag tsam gyi thog drangs de nyid kyi gsang sngags ni oX ghri rā dza ku ma ku ma khum this swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi ste/ rang yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po
༄tshi/ /dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mi tshig gis bar ma chad pa'i smra bcad dam po'i sngags dag par bzlas pa dang / gong du bstan pa ltar thugs brgyud bskul ba'i dmigs pa dang ma bral bar bya ste/ mdor na sgo gsum tha mal gyi dbang du skad yig kyang ma song ba'i ngang nas bzlas na ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ba ni nges pa ste/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ mnyam bzhag bzlas dang bsgom pa yin/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces dang / rdo rje gur las/ mkha' mgro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni byas pa'i phyir/ /sngags kyis snyan gsan dbabs par mdzod/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ro'i bos pa bzhin/ /mngon gsum tu ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs kun gshegs/ /zhes gsung la/ gzhan du na/ da lan bdag gis 'di sgrub na 'dis 'grub bam mi 'grub/ bar chad 'byung ngam mi 'byung dog po'i yi ge nyams pa'i the tshom dang / rtogs pa thams cad rgyang bsring ste/ sems rtse gcig pa nyid du bya dgos kyi/ de ltar ma yin na yun ji tsam ring yang phan pa chung ste/ spyod 'jug gi bsam gtan gyi le 'ur/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun rigs dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yengs par gyur pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs mang du gsungs pas/ spyir yang dge sbyor thams cad byas blo
tsam min par gnad du smin pa gtso che'o/ /drug pa/ rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa ni/ de nas thun bsdu ba ni/ slar yang ambha la sogs pa'i mchod bstod gsol gdab gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar dgong thun lta bu la/ 'jig rten par gtogs pa'i bsrung ma gzhan la gtor ma 'bul dgos yod na 'bul/ mgro spyi gtor ni/ thun thams cad kyi mjug tu 'byung na legs par gsungs/ de rjes rdo rje glu bkra shos smon lam bya/ he ru ga'i yi ge brgya ba lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ma 'byor pa dang sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ phyi dang khyad par gyi rten rnams brtan bzhugs dang / med pa rnams la/ oX khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /la sogs pas gshegs gsol bya/ rang gi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams gsal btab cing / bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya ste/ de ltar thun gcig go /de bzhin du thun gzhan rnams la mchod pa gsos pa dang mdun gyi gtor ma chang bu sogs la/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa nas brtsams te/ bkra shis kyi bar la dgong thun gyi bya ba/ chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo dor ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /de yang thun bzhir byas pa'i nges pa ni/ sa chen gyis thun bzhir bskyed bstim bya/ zhes gsungs pa dag gal te ma lcogs pa dang sngags kyi grangs ma song gis dogs nas bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir/ thun
༄tsho/ /gsum pa nyid byas kyang chog go /de lta bu'i rim pas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs bar grub par bya ste/ sngags kyi grangs ni/ rgyud gzhung dag las/ gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas/ / zhes gsungs kyang rtags thon pa nyid gtso chen po'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ mgon po dngos su byon gyur na/ /gang 'dod dngos grub thams cad grub/ /ces bya ba sogs pa 'grub pa'i rtags rab 'bring rnams ni/ gzhung gi yi ge rnam pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /de yang rmis gtad sogs su dge ba'i ltas kyi skad bstan pa re byung na dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par nges pas gzhan la med pa'i dga' ba bsgom pa dang / gzhan la mi smra ba'i gsang ba dam par bya'o/ gal de cung zad ngan pa yang 'byung srid de/ de yang nyi ma thal dang gos nag gyon/ /zhes bya ba la sogs ltas de dag byung ba yang bden med kyi ngang skyongs pa'i rgyas 'debs pa dang chos skyong gi bskang bshags sogs la brtson par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i rim pa'i bsnyen pa song nas nam zhig grol ba'i tshe/ rten gtor chos skyongs yab yum la gtang rag gi tshul du phul la/ sa gtsang sar gtong ba dang / nor bu gnyis dang sku rten mdzod phugs la sogs par mi mthong bar sba bar bya ste/ de dag gi bsnyen pa bstan zin to/ da ni gnyis pa sgrub pa bstan par bya ste/ de yang bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i gang zag gis 'di sgrub par bya
ba la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sbyor ba ni 'dir bsnyen pa dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod na sngar gyi maṇḍal dkyil du zlum bskor/ de'i dbus su gru gsum rtse mo phyir bstan pa mtho gang gi tshad dang ldan pa bris pa'i nang du/ gzhi mar gang dmar po la khrag mtsho'i ri mo dang / dbus su dung dang mgron bu kha sprod bris pa'i steng na nas kyi tshom bu rnams 'god pa dang / gru gsum gyi zur gsum du chog phur gyi rkang pa gsum bstan par btsugs pa'i sngar gyi thod pa bzhag la/ de'i nang du sngar dang 'dra ba'i gtor ma mar khu sprus nas bshams/ 'di'i mtha' bskor nas gong du smos pa'i zas dang rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs dang / khyad par rang gang la dga' ba'i zas kyi phyur bur gang ste bzhag go /dkyil 'khor gyi zur gsum mdun dang bzhi la/ 'bul gtor lag pa g.yon pa'i sbar rjes dod par byas pa'i chang bu bdun re gyen du bslang ba/ de yang sbom phra che la 'gyel ba'i nyen yod pa'am/ sbom phra cher med pa la gzer gyis bsdams pa bzhi/ phyi nas kha gsos pa'i chang bu dang bcas pa bshams pa'i tshan gyi snod rnams bshams so/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya bar byed kyang ji lta ba bzhin 'grig mi thub pas/ dpa' bo'i ston mo'am rtsa rgyud bza' tsam grub na legs gsungs pas/ de'i yo byad dang sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams/ gzhan sgrub rten bzhugs pa dang / mchod pa bshams
༄tshi/ /tshul sogs ni bsnyen pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgrub pa ni/ snga thun nas mgo brtsam te/ 'tshams gcod pa nas bkra shis kyi bar la bsnyen pa dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par 'di thun bzhi pa dang / gtor ma 'bul tshe snga thun la mdun gyi gtor ma phul/ dgong thun la g.yas zur gyi gtor ma/ srod thun la g.yon zur gyi gtor ma/ sang gi thor thun la rgyab kyi gtor ma 'bul lo/ slar yang gtor ma thams cad la chang bu bdun gyis kha gso ba sogs bya'o/ /dbus kyi gtor ma ni byin rlabs bya ba tsam ma gtogs sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar 'bul gso bya mi dgos/ de lta bu'i rim pas zhag bdun gyi bar du sgrub khang du bud med dang khyi dang sme can rnams mi btang ba dang / sgrub rdzas rnams gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas la shin tu gsang ste bsgrub po/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba dngos grub blang ba la sogs pa ni/ zhag brgyad pa'i snga dro'i thun gcig po de la/ dbus kyi gtor ma 'ang kha gsos la chos skyong yab yum la 'bul lo/ phul grub pa'i rjes su dbus kyi thod pa'i nang gi rang dga' ba'i kha zas 'di nyid chos skyong yab yum dgyes bzhin pas dngos grub du bstsal bar bsam la/ gzhan la mi ster bar rang nyid kyi longs spyod par bya ste de ni dngos grub blang ba zhes bya'o/ /'bul gtor bzhi po ni/ dbus kyi de dang dus gcig du 'bul lo/ /yang tshogs sam tsa ru la
sogs pa dang 'brel na de dag gi skabs su tshogs la mchod kyang bya ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams dngos grub gyi tshul du longs spyod par bya'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dang / bkra shis rgyas pas mtha' brgyan pa dang bcas te/ de dag rang gi mchod khang la sogs pa'i phugs su gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas la bzhugs su gsol te/ nya stong tshes brgyad la sogs pa'i dus bzang rnams la mchod gtor bsngo la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab na rang gi ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ sgrub pa thon nas bang mdzod sbas/ /dus bzang mchod gtor 'bul bar bya/ dngos grub gang 'dod gsol ba gdab/ /ces dang / sku de bang mdzod phur su zhugs/ /dus bzang gsum du mchod bya ste/ /gsol ba btab la dngos grub blang / /thun mongs rdzas dang longs spyod 'du/ / zhes sogs gsungs te/ de dag gi sgrub pa bstan zin to/ /da ni gsum pa las sbyor bstan par bya ste/ de yang rgyud gzhung dag las/ bsgrub pa chen po'i rtags thon nas/ las tshogs nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /sgrub na gang sgrub myur du 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas/ gong du bstan pa'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i sgrub pa pos/ 'di'i rgyud gsang ba snying gi 'bor lo dang / bee ro tsa na'i rgya gzhung dang / sa skya pa chen po'i mdzad pa rnams gtso bor smos pa'i bod gzhung dri ma med pa rnams nas/ ji skad bstan pa'i las
༄༅/ /tshogs rnam sgrub na rang gzhan gyi don mtha' dag 'grub pa ni mi bslu ba ste/ da ni smras ma thag pa'i gzhung de rnams su shin tu gsal bas 'dir rgyas par spro mi bya ste/ des las tshogs mdo tsam bstan zin to/slar yang smras pa/ de lta'i rgyud gzhung dka' gnas nor bu'i khams/ /brgyud pa'i zhal lung sa lam rdzas sbyor gyi/ /drang ba'i mig phug tshig gi 'bras bu la/ /mtshar du mngar ba'i bzod pa bla ma'i drin/ /rgyud dang rgya bod yongs su grags pa'i gzhung / /'gal med dgongs pa'i phyag len ming tshig dang / /yi ge 'dus pa'i gsal byed 'di mthong tshe/ /'phyang mo nyug gi blo de yul gzhan bros/ /bstan 'gror phan bde'i skya rengs sngon 'gro las shes rab nam mkha' mthong nas bya grub gyis/ /bstan bsrung nyin mo'i mgon po dgug nus na/ /don g.yin zhal las 'byung ngo snying gi grogs/ /'phags bod grub dbang rim par byon pa'i mthus/ /snying rjes yongs su bgos las skyes pa'i bcud/ /bsdoms pa'i mchog 'di skal bzang kun gyi yid/ /rab dga' bskyed phyir dam pa'i mgrin par yob/ /rkang drug 'phur lding gser du bsgyur ba dang / /mgrin pa'i rnga chung brdungs la 'dab gshog dag /yongs su ma rdzogs nongs pa 'dab rgya'i kha/ /rnam par rgyal ba gang des bzod par rigs/ /legs pa'i dge tshogs ma lus bsdoms ba'i mthus/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan dang
bstan 'dzin bcas/ /nyi sdusad dran pa'i 'tshams sprin gastu1na nu bzhin/ /sa steng snang bas khyad par bsten khu/ra cig /gzhan phan bsam nas kun bslang tshul 'di la/ /rngatshergan 'khru/sa khru/ zhig rjesags sangs rgyas sku1na tan/ /rgya malhan 〉glub phyir ye gokes spyan mnga' ba'i/ /dpal ldan dur khosad bdag 21sa zlasangs khu/ra cig /de ltar dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen sgrub gsal bar byed pa'i gtam gyi rgyud mang zhesabya ba 'di ni bsrung ma'i dbang po 'di nyid gyi rnal 'byor ba dbu mjad sangasargyas rgya mtsho dang / ye shesadapal ldan chosagrags zung gisasnga phyir bskul ba'i ngor/ rje sa chen gyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang / bee ro tsa nas mjad pa'i rgya gzhung las/ gzhan bla ma phy-i ma rnams kyi yigacha gang rnyed rnams la 'grigs par brten zhing / khyad par rigs brgya'i khyab bdagardo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer med pa 'jam mgon bkra shisalhun 'grub gragasapa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas grub dam pa rnamasakyi zhabs kyi padmo gcugagi brgyan du bsten cing man ngag dang phyag len gyi gsung sgrosadri ma med pa ji ltar thosapas legs par brgyan de bande chul khrims rin chen zhesabagyisapas sa pho rta'i lor sde dge
༄khu/ /byang gter chos skor phyogs bsgrigs kyi par byang smon tshig bzhugs so/ / swasti/ 'di na rgyal ba nyid lhag bka' drin can/ /37 rgyan rje des brtse bas gangs can pa'i/ /skal ba kho nar zab mo'i chos gter gyis/ /mtha' dbus kun tu nam mkha'i mdzod ltar gtams/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ma yal ba/ /bskyed rjesags rdzogs pa'i man ngag gzhan las kyang / /khyad 'phags lha brag mdzod chen lnga yi gter/ /chos tshul 'di yi dza gad nying bcud la/ /spyod pa'i skal chen du ma nyams rtogs kyis/ /rab myos do ha'i rgyang glu len dang bcas/ /'pho chen 'od sku'i gar gyis gshegs par grags/ /bstan 'gro'i srog rtsa bzung ba'i las tshogs kyang / /sna mang dgos pa kun tshang 'dir mchis pas/ /bod kyi blon po lta bu'i gter yin zhes/ /che thang nyid du padma'i lung gis bsngags/ /de phyir thugaX bstanaX 'dren la zla med pa'i/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas zab chos 'di'i nyi mbaX / /mi zad chos sbyin par gyi mkha' dbyings su/ /drangs par mdzad la snying nas rjes yi rangs/ /rlabs su che ba'i bstan pa'i bya ba la/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang ḍākkis kyang / /dbyings nas gzigs shing dga' ba'i gar dang bcas/ /bsngags pa'i me tog char du bsnyil bar nges/ /legs byas 'di yis rgyal bstan spyi bye
brag snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs rgyas/ /de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs zung srid mthar brtan/ /phrin las rab rgyas bzhed don yongs 'grub shog /dge 'dun sde yi rol mtsho rgyas pa'i dbus/ /thugs mthun khrims kyi lhun po rmang nas brling / /bslab gsum la gnas bang rim rnam par brjid/ /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i rna chas rtag mdzes shog /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par swa la'i ljongs/ /mi zad dus kyi rgud pa kun bral zhing / /snod bcud dge mtshan lang tsho dar drag pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /'dir 'bad 'brel bcas skye bar dam pa'i chos/ /chos bzhin spyod dang dge ba'i mthun rkyen yang / /yang dag 'byor sogs rten 'brel phun tshogs la/ /la 'ur 'jug nas byang chen myur 'thob therdzog /lam mchog 'di yang yongs 'du'i 'khri shing ltar/ /phrin las yal 'dab nam mkha'i bla brer bres/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i char gyis nor 'dzin khye1na/ /'gengs pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar rtag brtan phregag /ces pa'i par byang smon tshig g.yar khral tsam zhig rdo brag rig 'dzin bla ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs tsam phog pa'i mañdzu'i ming can nas shin tu dga' gus yi rangs kyi ngang nas bris te zla tshes bzang po la phul ba dge legs 'phel// //
